note: "근저당 채권최고액과 선순위 보증금을 합친 금액이 집값을 넘으면 ... 계약을 다시 검토": an unsourced risk threshold that is too lenient, since it ignores the tenant's own 2억 deposit and auction discounts (judged from general knowledge).

「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ、つまり更新の必要があっても借主負担分は生じません」: the guideline sets the residual value at 1 yen, not zero, and a tenant who caused intentional or negligent damage can still be charged labour and work costs after the useful life ends. A minor overstatement.
「学校行事」「急なお願い」「○日と○日は空けております」：学校の行事であること、急な依頼であること、代替日の確保は相談者から示されていない。
「子の看護休暇は病気・けがの看護」「学校行事そのものを保障する法律はありません」は、2025年4月改正で子の看護等休暇に入園・入学・卒園式や学級閉鎖等が加わったため、やや古い説明（私の知識で判断）

Quoted wording attributed to '人社部办公厅的相关通知' ('在正常发放的当日工资（100%）之外，再额外支付300%') has no document number; the only link goes to a Changzhou bureau reply, so the attribution to a national notice cannot be checked
Says re-enrolling after CMS-1763 disenrollment is "more complicated" without detail. The form number CMS-1763 is real.
"$1,220–$1,240 still forfeits" mixes 2025 and 2026 caps; the 2026 maximum produces $1,220, and a lower plan cap could produce a larger loss.
“집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호” introduces an unsupported numerical risk threshold.
称旧标准“基数要先按正常工资的70%计算”，所以“4480元，并非6400元”：将70%折扣说成必经步骤，与答案键的基数及满4年计算口径冲突。
'He is 22' is assumed. Born in 2004, he could be 21 or 22.
Gives no 退休时一次性补缴 or 延缴 figures (743.60 and 443.75 yuan/month). It only says the option exists.
"He is 22" is an assumption, since he could be 21.
"all $1,900 is gone December 31": loose. The cutoff is for incurring expenses; claims for 2026 expenses can still be filed during the run-out (minor).
Cites ft22.com, a third-party reposting site, as the 'full text' of 10号; it is not an official source and could not be verified here
"Some plans take two to four weeks" supplies a processing estimate without identifying a plan or substantiating that range.
“잔금 영수증 지참” presents an additional move-in registration document as necessary without support.
"계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다" is a frequency claim with no source.
“Risks forfeiting roughly $1,220–$1,240”: mixes 2026 and 2025 caps and inadequately reflects the branches; loss could be $0 with qualifying grace-period care or $1,900 with neither feature.
"워크넷 구직등록 후 관할 고용센터에 수급자격을 신청": wrong; WorkNet registration has ended and moved to 고용24
“通过‘浙里办’搜‘医保补缴’或‘灵活就业参保’” and “最好在11月新单位增员前”: specific procedural steps and timing not covered by the key; unverifiable (judged from my own knowledge; 12393 is the real medical-insurance hotline).

"If the money lands in January, it generally counts for 2027, and the 2026 room is lost": wrong per the key. A rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027 (2026 Form 5498 instructions, 219(f)(3)); only plan processing varies. This treats December 31 as the legal deadline.

"the unused balance on December 31 is forfeited" / "$1,220+ evaporates on January 1": imprecise. Forfeiture is measured after the run-out period, and 2026 claims filed during run-out still count. B elsewhere says run-out is for submitting 2026 receipts.
"'자발적 퇴사'로 보지 않고": imprecise. Legally it is still 자기 사정 이직, but 정당한 사유 lifts the bar (제58조 제2호 다목).
"省内换工作不用转移，跨省才需要办医保关系转移接续": unverifiable. Zhejiang cities are separate pooling areas, and the key did not verify Zhejiang rules.
'1차로 반려될 수 있어요' if the employer reports a voluntary quit: case-dependent, needs checking (not penalized).
Grace period "through March 15" is stated as fixed. March 15 is the legal maximum, and a plan may set a shorter period.
The HR message quotes "세전 약 1,040만 원 안팎" although A's own ordinary-wage floor gives about 1,200만, so the message understates the claim.
“경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 권리는 생기지만”은 조건을 빠뜨린 단정입니다. 선순위 담보권과의 관계에 따라 경매 매수인에게 대항하지 못할 수 있습니다.
The sentence 你的年限会从8年变成8年 is garbled, and the table row 少7个月 muddles how the 7 months relate to the existing years.
"你已有8年，还差12年，正常上班到退休只会超过，不会不够": assumes all 8 years are in Hangzhou and that she keeps paying there until retirement; the 24-month gap in actual Hangzhou years is never stated.
“本人工资=实得工资70%”：包内依据未支持这项额外的历史规则；4480元及3680元算术正确，但规则依据未获验证。
「本則62万円＋特例42万円」の内訳: 合計104万円は正しいが、内訳は未検証。
Same 4480 row (8000 × 70% × 80%) for the old base. It conflicts with the key's 6400 under 83号 and is unverifiable.
“실제로 짐 들이고 사는 상태여야” overstates the physical moving requirements for delivery and possession.
「民法90条で争える」 is a weak, unsupported add-on, though hedged as 「余地」.
“法定节假日的工时不计入……总工时”表述过度：避免重复计算150%加班费，不等于这些实际工作时间不计入总工时。
The 2019 Beijing typical-case quote and 157号 articles 4, 15, 18 are consistent with the key and with the 157号 text I opened.
少額訴訟 「費用も数万円程度です」 is wrong. The key puts the filing fee at 3,500円 (paper) or 2,400円 (electronic) for claims up to 100,000円 from 2026-05-21, and the old fee was 1,000円 plus stamps.
The specific Form 1099-Q “Box 4b” instruction is not verified by the packet.
Calls the Fengtai court article '北京丰台法院2026年的案例解读'. The link is given, but I could not verify the 2026 date.
手順に「来年1〜3月に申告」と書いている。直前に5年間申告できると述べており矛盾はしないが、時期を3月までに限る印象を与える。
「有給の話を同じメッセージで出すと話がこじれることもあります」は根拠のない見立て。キーは年休請求として書くことを最良とする
Length is well beyond what is needed: extra sections on 摇号 and an offer to compute by age, which the key penalises as over-long.
"If you've already submitted it, call Social Security now - you may be able to withdraw before it's processed" is an unverified procedural step
“전입세대 열람 … 선순위 세입자도 볼 수 있습니다” overstates what registered-household information establishes; it does not itself establish tenants’ legal priority.
“상여·연장수당이 전혀 없어서” invents the absence of overtime allowances; the request excludes only bonuses.
「社会保険料控除 約20〜40万円（国民年金・国保など）」: the request gives neither the amount nor the insurance type. The answer presents this assumed range in its table as fact and uses it to reach a firm 所得税0円.
“확정일자는 주민센터에서 무료” is wrong: the packet specifies a 600-won visit fee.
Says 网上很多答案还在写旧标准，是因为那些页面发布在2026年8月15日之前. This is speculation presented as an explanation.
Gives 'within 63 days' as the Part D enrollment deadline; the key specifies two full months, distinct from the penalty threshold.
"K-12 tuition (up to $10,000 a year)" is outdated for 2026; the federal annual limit is $20,000. Checked [Washington's official 529 FAQ](https://529invest.wa.gov/resources/faq/).
「先に『休ませてほしい』と頼めば、欠勤ではなく休暇の相談になります」：その言い方だけでは、実際の欠勤扱いや有給扱いは決まらない。
“基数要先按正常工资的70%计算” incorrectly imposes a universal 70% reduction; the resulting 4480元 entitlement and 3680元 shortfall use the wrong premise, although their arithmetic is correct.
“The Summary Plan Description states all three” is an unverified assertion about this employer's document.
“전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만” asserts blanket superiority; protection depends on priority and circumstances, and registration requires landlord cooperation.

"The 529 plan will issue Form 1099-Q to you as account owner": wrong. The IRS Form 1099-Q instructions (irs.gov/instructions/i1099q, opened) name the designated beneficiary as recipient for a direct trustee-to-trustee transfer to a Roth IRA maintained for the beneficiary.
将2192元直接定为“应发”底线，并称实发800元可能已达标，却不说明争议及多数口径要求实发不低于2192元。
“大病保险等可能另计几十元”：标准答案明确相关个人费用从补划个人账户扣减，不另交现金。
Says '按现行口径，也不会缩短重新参保后的等待期'. The key says it is unverified whether 补缴 exempts the waiting period. This is stated as settled, with no 'ask 经办' hedge.
"준비물: ... 도장(서명)" is not a required item, though harmless.
'K-12 tuition (up to $10,000 a year)' is out of date for 2026. From my own knowledge, the July 2025 law raised the K-12 cap to $20,000 a year starting in 2026. Minor error, off the main topic.
“连续缴费年限：断缴超过3个月……重新计算”：把等待期、生育连续缴费条件概括成统一的职工医保连续年限重算规则，标准答案不支持。
"按现行口径，也不会缩短重新参保后的等待期": stated as certain; the key says whether 补缴 exempts the waiting period is unverified.
“회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우”: conflates company retirement-pension arrangements with the worker’s IRP and obscures IRP requirements for ordinary severance payments.
Premium given as "roughly $185–$210/month" rather than the 2026 figure of $202.90: vague, though not wrong.
Run-out is "usually ~90 days after Dec 31": typical but plan-specific, and not sourced
"워크넷 구직등록 후 관할 고용센터에 수급자격을 신청": wrong. 워크넷 has ended and was merged into 고용24.

Scenario B: '如果这32小时全部构成周期超时，约2482.76元，合计约6206.90元'. The key says the 150% amount cannot be computed from the facts given. The arithmetic is right (413.79/8×1.5×32 ≈ 2482.76), but the figure is speculative.

Question 4, whether the full $1,900 is available now or only what has been contributed: the uniform-coverage point is correct, but it is aimed at the current year, where the person already says $1,900 is left, and not at the 2027 election. It is a minor misdirection, not a false claim.
Says to apply at retirement with 'CMS-40B plus CMS-L564' and gives no Part A caveat. CMS-40B is only for people who already have Part A, and A itself tells HSA holders to defer Part A.

800元若为实发：'公司可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额' — takes the minority view (2192 counted before personal contributions) without saying it is disputed; the key's majority view is that take-home pay must still be at least 2192, so 800 would still be illegal
Step 3's maximum ignores existing IRA contributions. The later Roth-only caveat neither addresses traditional IRA contributions nor correctly handles compensation below $7,500.
"杭州的报销比例只看医院等级和费用段，不看连续缴了几年": not covered by the key; unverified.
The HR message states "제 퇴직금은 세전 약 1,022만 원... 으로 계산됩니다". Putting a figure that may be low (no ordinary-wage floor) into the message could anchor the company to the lower amount (minor).

"The 529 plan will issue Form 1099-Q to you as account owner" is wrong. The IRS 1099-Q instructions I opened say the recipient of a QTP-to-Roth trustee-to-trustee transfer is the designated beneficiary (the son).

"The 529 plan will issue Form 1099-Q to you as account owner": wrong. The 1099-Q instructions (irs.gov/instructions/i1099q, which I opened) name the designated beneficiary as recipient for a trustee-to-trustee transfer to a Roth IRA held for the beneficiary.
「所得税自体が約1,000円」: this ignores 社会保険料控除 and overstates the remaining income tax, which is most likely 0.
The "참고한 자료" list (including the Ministry calculator link) is a source claim that cannot be checked from the answer alone.
“平时是轮班/做六休一……正常工作日”：轮班可能需要核对休息日安排，但做六休一本身不能使超出标准工时的劳动成为正常工时。
「金額が大きいので、そこで交渉の仕方も教えてもらえます」: plausible but unverified claim about what those consultation services provide.
"Unused carryover still expires later": imprecise, since carried money can itself carry over again up to the cap and only the excess is forfeited (minor)

The Federal Register link (govinfo FR-2025-11-19, doc 2025-20251) and the Medicare.gov links are cited as sources. The document number could not be verified from the packet. The $202.90 figure itself matches the key.

1099-Q "distribution code 1 in Box 7" stated as what "should" appear: the IRS instructions make box 7 codes optional (box 4b and the son as recipient check out against irs.gov/instructions/i1099q, which I opened).

「国土交通省…ガイドラインでは、壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」(repeated in the email): overbroad. The guideline assigns the cost by cause (tenant-caused damage and nicotine stains are the tenant's), so it does not say wallpaper replacement is the landlord's cost in principle
"구직촉진수당(월 50만원, 최대 6개월)": the amount is unverified (the key does not penalize it). Listing it as a living-expense source next to 구직급여 is also loose, because 구직급여 recipients can be excluded.
"부동산 말은 절반만 맞아요": softens a claim the key calls wrong on both points.
“이직일부터 12개월 안” uses the wrong starting point and presents the payment window as an application deadline.
"If the annual limit rises with inflation, this compresses to four or five years" is wrong or misleading. At $8,000 a year, four years is only $32,000, so it still takes five.
「契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効」：負担範囲を契約書に具体的に明記する場合もあり、説明を受けた場合だけに限定するのは不正確。
‘7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고’ incorrectly treats three late-payment months as sufficient without establishing qualifying delay days or unpaid amounts.
“평일 18시까지”를 해당 주민센터 확인 없이 단정합니다. 제시한 특정 주민센터 링크만으로 사용자가 방문할 주민센터 운영시간까지 입증되지는 않습니다.
Run-out period "often ~90 days after year-end" is a typical figure, not a rule. It is unverified, but A frames it as common and tells the person to confirm.
"빌라는 근저당이 잡힌 경우가 적지 않아" — a claim about how common this is, with no source given; unverifiable.
消費者ホットライン188に局番なし・最寄りの消費生活センターにつながる旨の説明がない。軽微。
“已发过一部分加班费或补贴，从里面扣掉已付部分”：普通补贴不能自动抵扣加班费，须确认其确实属于已支付的加班报酬。
「クリーニング」を対象外として列挙しているが、治療目的の歯石除去などは対象になり得る。美容・予防目的との区別が必要。
「これで金額が動く可能性が十分あります」: 根拠のない見込み。
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 (근로자퇴직급여 보장법 제44조)": outdated. Since 2026.9.18 the penalty is 제43조, 5년/5천만 원 (minor deduction per the key).
“금요일 안에 전입신고를 마쳐야 주말 공백이 없습니다” overlooks processing hours and the remaining same-day mortgage risk.
"sign up for Part D within 63 days": the Part D SEP is 2 full months after coverage ends. 63 days is the gap that triggers the penalty (minor).
The answer gives a Rev. Proc. 2025-32 link for the $680 cap, which is right. It gives no Pub 969 or Notice 2005-42 citation for the grace period or the use-it-or-lose-it rule.
「領収書・レシートを保管（…通院の電車・バス代）」: train and bus fares usually come with no receipt. The key asks for a record of date and amount instead (minor).
「所得税は0円」「効果があるのは住民税だけ」 are unjustifiably definite; insurance deductions and withholding must first be checked.
"He is 22" is not established; someone born in 2004 could still be 21 on the packet's date.
浙里办菜单路径及先参保、再通过税务缴费的补缴流程：题包未核实这些具体操作。
「住民税は確定申告の内容が自動的に反映される」: true only if an income-tax return is filed; it omits the resident-tax-only filing route that applies when no income-tax return is filed
Gives specific operating steps (浙里办, 浙里医保, 我要参保, 职工参保登记, 浙江税务社保缴费) and a document list (补缴申请表, 补缴超过1个月通常要去窗口). None of this is in the key and it cannot be checked.
“확정일자는 주민센터에서 무료”: the key specifies a 600-won fee for a standalone in-person application.
"Sign up for Part D ... at the same time" as Part B differs from the key's 2-full-months-after-coverage-ends rule; imprecise, not harmful
「有給の話はこのLINEでぶつけず、休みが決まった後に改めて確認するのが現実的」: 有給は事後に切り替えられる保証がなく、当日が欠勤扱いで無給になる恐れがある。助言として不適切（事実の断定ではないが誤誘導）
Under the approval scenario, “多数情况下拿不到这么多”: a speculative generalisation with no source.
Never analyses the gross versus net case. It only asks HR whether 800 is 应发 or 实发, and it does not mention the exclusions from the base (bonus, allowances, overtime) or the 21.75 daily conversion.
Cites a 渋谷区 page on 令和9年度住民税 改正; I did not open it, so it is unverifiable by me, though the 43万円 figure matches the key
「2万円の追加請求になっている点も不自然」は根拠がない。請求額が敷金を超えること自体は問題ではない。
The Form 1099-Q Box 4b claim is not in the key. I checked the IRS 1099-Q instructions (Rev. April 2025) and it is correct.
“2억 원을 거의 못 건질 수 있습니다” adds an unsupported loss estimate without property value, debt or priority information.
LINE本文の「子どもの学校行事」: 依頼文は「子どもの行事」としか書いておらず、学校と決めつけている（軽微。置き換えが必要）
Gives the phone number 0571-89583017 as a Hangzhou 医保 line. It is not in the key and cannot be checked.
The survey's "30 states" count and complete state classification are not independently verified by the packet or official sources checked; they should not establish 2026 treatment.
「サインは「内容を確認した」以上の意味を持ちません」: overstated; a signature does bind the tenant to any valid clause, which is why the clause still has to be checked
"확정일자는 주민센터에서 무료": wrong. The key gives 600원 for a visit (500원 at 인터넷등기소).

"(선택) 전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만 ... 근저당이 많은 집이면 검토": it needs the landlord's cooperation, which goes unmentioned. It ranks by registration date, so it does not help against existing mortgages, and 'stronger' is unsupported.
“집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리” incorrectly presents continued occupation after auction as unconditional; priority matters.
Says 杭州报销比例不看连续缴费年限, and 省内换工作不用转移. Neither is checkable from the packet.

"法定节假日的工时不计入综合计算周期的总工时" is unsourced and unverifiable. 157号 Art. 8 (I opened the beijing.gov.cn text) says "其中法定休假日安排职工工作的…", which reads as holiday hours counting inside the period total. The claim is doubtful.
「所得税が約850円」「合わせて2,500円ほど」：還付を断定している。社会保険料控除等で所得税・源泉徴収税額が0なら所得税の還付も0円。
"이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)": an assumed calendar date that conflicts with the key, which puts this Friday on 2026-10-23.
“这笔钱你能要回来”“最坏情况下……至少”：把附有工资基数、工时和举证条件的测算说成确定结果，后文免责声明不能完全消除这一过度承诺。
“지연이자까지 한 번에 청구” asserts an all-in-one labor-complaint procedure not established by the packet.
'The earnings follow the Roth 5-year and age-59½ rules' is a side claim the key lists as not verified, and it is not plainly wrong.
第九条“只规定了……计算基数”：错误；该条也规定病假期间企业应当支付假期工资。
“퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원”: exceeds the key’s estimated 94,000–141,000 won and incorrectly implies tax withholding upon IRP transfer.
「7年住んでいる時点で、壁紙の残存価値はゼロです」: 正しくは残存価値1円。結果の0円は変わらないので軽微。
"이직확인서를 회사가 안 써주면 고용센터에 발급 요청하면 됩니다" is imprecise. The employment center asks the employer to file it, and the key says the claim can be filed without it.
“近两年要孩子才需留意”：材料没有这一两年期限。
Asserts an income-tax refund of about 850 yen (戻る税金は所得税が約850円) without saying the refund is 0 yen if 源泉徴収税額 is 0, and without telling the reader to check the 源泉徴収票.
Links the full text of 10号 on ft22.com, a non-official site, and links 中伦 and Ebner Stolz analyses. None of these were opened and they are unverified.
「室内の写真は当方でも保管しております」：依頼者が写真を保管している事実は示されていない。
“按现行口径，也不会缩短重新参保后的等待期”: stated as settled. The key marks whether back-payment waives the waiting period as unverified.
"You'll need ... plus pay stubs/W-2s as backup": presents supplementary evidence as required even with completed employer certification.
「店側が変更できるのは本当に忙しくて回らないときだけ」 - 第39条第5項の「事業の正常な運営を妨げる場合」の言い換えとしてやや緩い（条文・時季変更権の語は出ていない）
日経、LIMO、FP総合研究所の引用: 記事内容を確認できず、検証できない（年末調整では控除を受けられないという点自体は正しい）。
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」：結果と頻度を裏付ける根拠がなく、検証不能。
Penalty '3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(제44조)' is the old rule; the key says that since 2026.9.18 it is 제43조, 5 years or 50 million won (minor deduction).
Says to keep 電車・バス代 receipts; fares usually have no receipt, so a dated and amounted record is what the key asks for
Headline '세전 약 1,200만 원' assumes the whole 3.3 million won is ordinary wage. It does state this assumption and gives the 10,242,000 won alternative, so the issue is minor.
劳部发〔1997〕271号第4条 quoted as saying 另外支付 and 一般不安排补休: wording not in the key and not checked; plausible from my own knowledge.
「治療は2026年中にまとめる」は対象年の判断を誤らせる。原則として治療日ではなく支払日が基準。
Adds an off-topic aside that the 摇车牌 / 买房 连续社保 rule is different and 补缴 generally does not count as continuous. This is not in the key and cannot be checked.
“断缴3个月以内补缴，才不设等待期、可追溯待遇”：遗漏跨统筹区转移或职工、居民医保切换的适用范围，不能概括为一般断缴规则。
Recommends CMS-40B at retirement without requiring existing Part A; someone deferring both must apply for A and B through SSA.
「直前だと時季変更権の余地が広がります」：申請の遅さだけで権利の範囲が広がるとはキーから確認できず、法定の要件も説明していない。
"Spending $1,500 ... to save $680" misstates the spend-down tradeoff: eligible spending consumes the otherwise forfeitable balance, rather than merely saving the carryover.
“10월 4일이 기한”: asserts an exact deadline despite unresolved retirement-date and holiday calculations identified in the key.
'전세권 설정 등기: 확정일자보다 강하지만': leaves out that it needs the landlord's cooperation (민법 제621조), so the tenant cannot do it alone; mildly misleading

"K-12 tuition (up to $10,000 a year)" is outdated, judged from my own knowledge. The July 2025 law (OBBBA) raised the K-12 limit to $20,000 for years after 2025. Pub 970, which I opened, still shows $10,000 only in the prior-year chart. The claim is also irrelevant to a college graduate.

「国土交通省ガイドラインでは、壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」 (repeated in the email): this overstates the guideline, which assigns cost by cause. Damage the tenant causes through negligence is the tenant's cost, so the management company could easily rebut this line.
'2억을 거의 못 받을 수 있어요': hyperbolic, and not conditioned on any prior mortgage amount; the key does not support the size of the loss.
"Spend roughly $1,240+" overstates the required spend at the 2026 maximum carryover: $1,900 − $680 = $1,220.
"The plan can tell you the balance from five years ago" suggests an inadequate eligibility measure: qualifying current earnings must also be included.
'Waiting is the financially better move' is too categorical without comparing premiums, benefits and expected medical costs.
"Most don't" require Medicare enrollment: this prevalence claim is unsupported by the packet or an accompanying source.

Says the old rule has an "容易忽略的细节": the base is first cut to 70% of normal pay, so a full 4 years gives 8000×70%×80% = 4480 yuan. The key puts the 83号 80% tier at 8000×80% = 6400 on the contract monthly wage. The 70% base appears in the old Shanghai rules only as a default when no contract or collective contract sets the base, so applying it to a worker with an 8,000 contract salary is wrong.

"at most $660 of your $1,900 survives... The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240" has the wrong cap and arithmetic for 2026 ($680 and $1,220). It also contradicts the grace-period branch, under which the whole $1,900 can pay for March work done by the grace end.
「所定労働日の8割以上」は、法律上は「全労働日」の8割(軽微な言い換え)
Never tells the user to check the 源泉徴収票 源泉徴収税額 column to see whether any refund is possible
'지연이자도 이미 붙고 있습니다'라고 단정했다. 키에 명시된 법정 적용 제외 사유 여부는 확인되지 않았다.
'신청은 퇴사 다음 날부터 12개월 이내' — imprecise. The 12 months is the 수급기간, so a late application loses benefit days. It is not simply a deadline to file (key).
Says to sign up for Part D "at the same time" as Part B, without the 2-full-month window.
"재직 1,156일 가정": key uses 1,158 days, so the result is about 18k won low. Within 'approximately'.
补缴“一般也不能”免除等待期：包内材料没有核实这一结论，应说明需向经办确认。
'이의제기 → 심사청구 순으로': the formal remedy is a review request (심사청구), then a re-review (재심사청구). An '이의제기' step is not a defined statutory stage, so this is unverifiable as stated.
“신청은 퇴사 다음 날부터 12개월 이내”: 12개월은 수급기간이다. 늦게 신청하면 지급받을 일수가 사라진다는 설명이 없어 신청기한으로 오해하게 한다.

Third table row says a company on the old rule would pay 8000 × 70% × 80% = 4480 yuan, using '先按实得工资70%' as the base. This conflicts with the key, where the 83号 tier gives 8000 × 80% = 6400. It is unverifiable and probably a wrong gloss on the old base.
“最多再拿约2482.76元，合计最多约6206.90元”：没有周期总工时数据，不能确定综合工时加班费或其上限。
“자발적 퇴사로 보지 않고”: 자발적 퇴사라도 정당한 이직사유로 수급이 가능하다는 것이 정확하다.

"18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다": wrong. Per the key, an 인터넷등기소 확정일자 applied for after 18시 on Friday is granted on the next working day, 10-26 (Mon). The 신고일 for an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 is unconfirmed, and the key penalises stating it as fact.
“实际发放高于合同约定的，按实际发放”（加班基数）：与答案键的北京工资支付规定第44条（按合同约定工资，不低于最低工资）不一致，也无法核实。
"임금체불확인서(회사 발급)": wrong. The 체불임금등·사업주 확인서 is issued by the labour office (근로감독관), not by the employer.
「扶養に入っている場合、収入や申告が扶養判定に影響することがあります」 implies that filing could affect dependent status. The key says the medical deduction does not change 合計所得金額 and has no effect on that test.
「7年住んだ物件では残存価値はゼロ」: the guideline retains a residual value of 1 yen, rather than literal zero.
"about $1,220–$1,240 still forfeits": the range mixes the 2025 and 2026 caps. Only $1,220 is right for 2026 (minor).
Quotes the condition as 「業務の正常な運営を妨げる場合」, but 第39条第5項 and the linked Shizuoka Labour Bureau page (which I opened) say 「事業の正常な運営を妨げる」. Minor misquote
“报销比例不跟‘连续年限’挂钩”：题包未核实这一概括。
'늦게라도 받았다면 그 지연 사실 자체가 사유' - overclaim; late-paid months count only through the 60-day rule, so it is not automatic
"임금이 밀리거나 늦게 지급돼서 그만둔 경우는 '자발적 퇴사'로 보지 않고": mischaracterised; it is still a voluntary resignation, but with a 정당한 사유 under 제58조 제2호 다목
「少額調停」: no formal procedure has this name (the procedure is 民事調停). The term is imprecise.
1350 링크의 문서 번호(id=1000271860, id=1000313975)와 law.go.kr 링크는 열어 확인하지 못함: 확인 불가
"이직확인서를 회사가 안 써주면 고용센터에 발급 요청하면 됩니다": imprecise. The job center does not issue the separation certificate; the company must submit it within 10 days of a request, and you can apply without it.
생계비 융자 "연 1.5%" with no date given: in October 2026 the temporary rate is 1.0% until 10/31, and 1.5% applies from November. The 1% guarantee fee is also left out.
Says 'Hangzhou 报销比例不跟连续年限挂钩' and 'retirement 待遇 does not look at years beyond 20'. Neither is in the key and neither can be checked.
연 20% 지연이자(같은 법 제17조 제3항, 근로기준법 제37조): 퇴직급여법 제17조 제3항 인용은 근거를 확인할 수 없고 틀렸을 가능성이 큼. 근로기준법 제37조는 맞음
Quotes 劳部发〔1997〕271号第4条 as saying 另外支付不低于300% and 一般不安排补休; the wording is not in the key and I did not verify it, so it is unverifiable.
"이직확인서를 회사가 안 써주면 고용센터에 발급 요청": loosely stated. The employer must issue it within 10 days of a request, and the person can apply without it. Minor.
“The 529 plan probably will not verify his income or other contributions” is an unsupported prediction about the unidentified plan.
“잔금 영수증 지참”: 전입신고에 필요한 서류처럼 제시했지만 통상 필수 서류가 아님.
The LINE says 「急なお願いで恐れ入ります」 for an event next month. A minor framing error.
Step 2 "budget to spend roughly $1,240+" uses the 2025 $660 cap. For a 2026 plan year with a $680 cap, the required spend is $1,220 (minor, errs on the conservative side).
"confirm the office will charge before the 15th": the date the care is provided is what counts, not the date the office charges, so this points the person at the wrong date.
"K-12 tuition (up to $10,000 a year)" is outdated for 2026; the federal limit is $20,000. See [IRS Topic 313](https://www.irs.gov/taxtopics/tc313).
Frames the exception as active coverage "from an employer with 20+ employees", which implies employer size is a condition of the no-penalty SEP. It only decides who pays first.
"your coworker's penalty warning doesn't apply to you at 400 employees": ties the SEP to employer size. Size decides payer order, not SEP eligibility (imprecise, minor).
“빌라는 근저당이 잡힌 경우가 적지 않아”: an unsupported prevalence claim.

The 北京三中院法官 calculation link and the 光明网 link were not opened and are unverified. The 丰台法院 link was opened and supports the claims that unapproved agreements are invalid and that an expired approval reverts to standard hours.
Links to a Proskauer blog post as a "helpful comparison". The URL is unverifiable here, though the IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 link is the right primary source and the figures match the key.

"Complete the transfer by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 limit" presents December 31 as the deadline. A rollover designated for 2026 can run to April 15, 2027, though plans vary. Minor error per the key.
「ガイドライン上も」 provides no checkable link or document number, although its sunlight-discoloration conclusion agrees with the key.
“通过‘浙里办’搜‘医保补缴’或‘灵活就业参保’”：具体办理路径未获所给材料支持，未外部核验。

Opening line "如果劳动合同或公司制度沿用旧上海口径，可能是 4480 元" maps the old Shanghai approach to 8000×70%×80%. The 70% base was only a fallback when no wage was agreed, and with an agreed 8000 wage the old rules gave 6400. Section 2 adds that condition, but the headline figure misleads.
「日焼けの程度を示せるのはあなただけ」：管理会社の記録や立会いでも示せるため、根拠のない限定。

States the 2192 floor as 应发 outright, and says that if 800 is the net amount the company 可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额. This gives only the minority reading and omits the majority reading (the minimum wage excludes personal contributions, so net pay still must not fall below 2192). The key says there is no official position, so the claim is overconfident.
“계약서 명의자 본인이” incorrectly makes personal filing by the named tenant mandatory; authorized proxy filing is possible.
Claims Part B would cover 'little your plan doesn't already cover'; no employer benefit details establish that.
Cites 劳部发〔1994〕503号 article 7 and 京劳社资发〔2005〕94号 (10-working-day licence procedure); not covered by the key and not checked, plausible but unverified.
Cites 北京高院2024年解答（一）第56条 on 值班 with no checkable source; unverifiable.
「7年住んだ物件では残存価値はゼロ」: the actual floor is 1 yen (about 0%), and it is applied to the sunburn rather than to a hypothetical tenant-caused damage. Minor imprecision; no percentage is computed.

"When your coworker would be right: ... an employer under 20 employees": imprecise. SSA says the SEP covers small or large employer plans. Under 20 employees Medicare pays first, so taking Part B makes practical sense, but the penalty exemption still applies.

"you can incur expenses through March 15, 2026 and still claim them against 2025 funds" has the wrong year: for this plan year the latest grace end is March 15, 2027. It also presents March 15 as fixed, when that is only the maximum.
「民法621条ただし書きにより、通常の使用に伴う損耗および経年変化は原状回復義務の対象外」(in the email): mis-cited. The exclusion is in 621条's parenthetical clause. The ただし書 covers damage the tenant is not responsible for
"Scholarships ... do not [count]" is overbroad: qualifying taxable scholarships and graduate-study stipends can count. Checked [IRS Publication 590-A](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p590a).
'工资里已经包含加班费……法定节假日部分不能包干' and the advice to apply for 政府信息公开 to check the approval are given without any source.
"若是外地户口，这条路可能走不通" is overstated: a 居住证 plus 就业登记 route exists, though 就业登记 may be hard to meet for someone currently jobless.
“기한은 10월 4일”, “20일 넘게”: 퇴직일 해석과 휴일 처리를 확인하지 않아 기한과 경과일을 확정할 수 없다.
メールの「残存価値はない」は不正確。キーの基準は残存価値1円であり、厳密なゼロではない。

The state survey is unverifiable. It claims "30 states follow federal", lists Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Utah and Vermont as recapturing deductions, and says Colorado, Missouri and New Jersey are "still deciding". It rests on one secondary source (praetorianguard.biz). The key did not check other states.
国交省ガイドラインとして示したリンク（mlit.go.jp/common/001238428.pdf）は、取得できたメタデータが『ガイドライン201801契約書…』（2018年作成、34ページ）で、再改訂版・平成23年8月の原状回復ガイドラインとは別の資料の可能性が高い。本文は読めず未確認。
'此后上海不再强制按工龄分档' is stated flatly. The key says only that no replacement was found and that the search was not exhaustive.
"현행법상 퇴직금은 IRP 계정으로 이전하는 방식이에요": overgeneralized; it leaves out the conditions (under 55, over 300만 원), and the message tells HR the same unconditionally
Cites 劳动合同法第26条 as invalidity for violating mandatory rules (item 3). The key's point is item (2); the substance is right but the item differs.

"Complete the transfer by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 limit" is wrong as a federal deadline; a 2026-designated rollover can occur through April 15, 2027, subject to provider processing.
Tells her to ask 12393 whether she can "补3–9月". The gap is 4–10月 (March was paid). The month range is wrong.
'3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(같은 법 제44조 제1호)': outdated; from 2026.9.18 the penalty is 제43조, 5 years or 50 million won (key treats this as a minor deduction)
LINE本文で法律の説明をやや詳しく述べており、LINEとしては少し長く説明的(誤りではない)
Names CMS-L564 as the proof form but says only that "your employer fills it out". The asker completes Section A and the employer Section B, so this is incomplete.
"If you change jobs, the whole balance — carryover included — is gone": leaves out the COBRA exception for the health FSA (Notice 2013-71)
The link described as the 83号 official reply has a 2025-04-12 date in its path. The key places the official reply on 2026-08-19, so the description is unverified.
Run-out "often ~90 days after year-end" is an unverified typical figure, though it is hedged and plausible (judged from own knowledge).
“上海人社局尚未发布新的分档规定”比答案键的“截至核查日未找到替代文件”更确定，未充分保留检索局限。
"실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분을 받을 수 있으니 지금 미리 신청해 두세요" (국민취업지원제도): unverified and at odds with the key, which says people who are on 구직급여 or within 6 months after it ends may be excluded from 구직촉진수당
「有給で取れる可能性が高いです」: 8割出勤の条件に触れずに書いており、条件が抜けているため断定の根拠が弱い。
Quote attributed to the Changzhou HR bureau (300%和200%都是支付月工资之后另外支付): not checked, so unverifiable.

Works out a figure for the approved scenario: “按这4天32小时全超时粗算约2,482.76元” and “大约在3,724～6,207元之间”. The key says this cannot be computed from the information given. The 6,207 ceiling also assumes 8-hour days, so it is not a real upper bound.

Concludes that if 800 is the net pay, 'Company may just meet the floor, no shortfall'. That adopts the minority view as the result and omits the majority view that net pay below 2192 is still unlawful.
"Not actively working" means the coworker is right: overbroad; coverage through a spouse's current employment can qualify.
“아직 못 받았다면 더 확실”: an unspecified unpaid amount and duration do not establish eligibility.
「代わりに出られる日を添えるのが、実は一番効きます」 asserts an unsupported ranking of effectiveness.

Table row '合同沿用旧“本人工资=实得工资 70%”口径 8000×70%×80%=4480元': garbled. The old 70% base was a fallback in the old 工资支付办法, used only when no wage was agreed. It was not a '实得工资70%' rule. The answer offers it only as a contract scenario, so this is a minor error.
“임금체불확인서(회사 발급)”: 회사 발급 서류를 준비 절차로 제시한 근거가 없으며, 공식 체불 확인 서류와 혼동할 수 있습니다.
「課税所得が消えるため、ほぼ0円（還付なし）」: stated as fact without asking the person to check the 源泉徴収税額 box on the 源泉徴収票, and it assumes 社会保険料控除 of at least 2万円.
'2년 근무면 150일분이 나오고' leaves out that age 50 or over, or a disability, gives 180 days.
“合计约3,370元”“8个月，约3,850元”：错误地把个人账户扣减费用加进现金补缴额；应分别为3,315.69元、3,789.36元。
「宅建業者を所管する都道府県の担当窓口」を相談先に挙げる: 管理会社が宅建業者とは限らない。軽微。
「今回は通常の医療費控除が有利です」: 根拠の提示なし。ただし歯科費用はセルフメディケーションの対象外なので結論は妥当。
"7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다": overstated; the test is a total of 60 days of delayed or unpaid wages, not the number of late months (key: '석 달이니 무조건 받는다'는 과장)
Gives 北京人社问答 rather than 人社部发〔2025〕2号 as the basis for 21.75; the figure is right and no abolished document is cited. I opened the page and it confirms (365-104)/12 = 21.75.
"전입신고 확인서" is not a standard document name. 주민등록등본 or the filing receipt is the usual proof (minor, unverifiable).
「休みが認められたら、「欠勤」ではなく「事前に承認された休暇」として扱われているか確認」: this is not a legal category. An approved day off that is not 年次有給休暇 is still unpaid, so the advice suggests a pay protection that does not exist.
'3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금' is the old penalty. Since 2026.9.18 it is 5 years or 50 million won under 제43조 (minor deduction).
冒頭の「文面はこれで大丈夫です」は、まだ文面が示される前の発言で意味が通らない
The standalone example “He earns $4,000: $4,000” needs an explicit assumption of no other IRA contributions and sufficient eligible funds.
Phone number “0571-89583017” for Hangzhou 医保: unverifiable (12393 is the known national hotline)
The phrase 按现行文件和裁审口径的分析 refers to arbitration and court practice with no source, so it is unverifiable.
Cites 《劳动合同法》第26条 using item (3)'s wording ("违反法律、行政法规强制性规定") instead of item (2) (免除用人单位法定责任、排除劳动者权利). The conclusion is still right; the sub-item is imprecise
「欠勤」ではなく「事前に承認された休暇」：事前承認だけでは有給扱いや欠勤による不利益の回避は保証されない。
"Several states still don't treat these transfers as a qualified 529 use" is generic, with no states named and nothing checkable.
“Many plans offer neither” is an unsupported prevalence claim.
声称网上很多旧标准答案来自2026年8月15日前的页面；未提供可核查的页面证据。
IRP described as the "원칙적" payment method with no 3 million won threshold and no under-55 condition; "회사가 계좌를 물으면 안내받아 처리" is passive.
"一般也不能免除上面那2个月等待期" is stated fairly firmly; the key says whether 补缴 waives the waiting period is unverified, so it should read "unknown, ask the 经办".
「医療費控除を受けるには確定申告が必要」は広すぎる。所得税の申告をせず、住民税申告で控除を受ける方法もある。
「民法621条は…（2017年改正で明文化）」: 改正の公布年としては正しいが、施行は2020年4月1日で、施行日や旧法契約の扱いには触れていない。
고용노동부 퇴직금 계산기 링크와 생활법령 링크는 열어 확인하지 못함: 확인 불가
“法定节假日部分不能‘包干’”：不能免付不等于任何包含加班费的工资约定都无效，需核实约定及实际支付是否达到法定标准。
“지연이자는 연 20%”, “하루 약 6,600원씩 늘어요”: 법정 적용 제외 사유를 고려하지 않은 단정이다.
Says to call SSA at 1-800-772-1213 to withdraw an application before it takes effect: the withdrawal procedure is not verified. The phone number is the real SSA line.
근속을 30일 x 38/12 = 95일분으로 계산해 약 1,022만 원 제시: 키의 일수 기준(1,158일/365, 약 1,024만 원)과 약 2만 원 차이로 사소함. 다만 통상임금 하한(약 1,202만 원)을 빼고 1,020만~1,045만 원이 범위인 것처럼 말함
“이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)”은 정답 기준의 금요일인 10월 23일과 다릅니다.

The reference '법제처 ... (2026. 5. 26.)' and the moel.go.kr and law.go.kr links come with no document number or checkable detail, so they are unverifiable. The key does cite a 법제처 interpretation for this point, so it is plausible.
Says 11–12月 "大概率没有统筹报销" and that 补缴 "大概率仍有等待期". Both are hedged, and the key says the exemption is unverified.
“1,020만~1,030만 원 사이”: 통상임금 하한을 누락한 범위로, 키의 조건에서는 약 1,202만 원까지 가능하다.
“近期可能看病、生育：建议补”：尚未确认补缴能恢复等待期或生育连续资格，建议依据不足。
'This compresses to four or five years' is unsupported: future limits are unannounced, and even $8,000 annually yields only $32,000 over four years.
“实际发放高于约定的，按实发”：标准答案未支持这种自动取较高值的北京加班基数规则；依本人法律知识判断，该表述不准确。
Gives source links for the 2740 figure and the rule expiry. The 2740 figure matches the key; the links were not opened and are unverified.
“个别法院……不是机械按200%判”：未给出可核验案例或适用条件，容易把加班事实、时长的酌定与法定支付比例混淆。
Nothing is said about the excess if more than the cap is moved: no 6% Roth excise and no $40,500 figure. Not an added claim, but a gap.
'也可以在1年内申请劳动仲裁' — imprecise: a wage-arrears claim made while still employed is not bound by the one-year limit, which runs from leaving (劳动争议调解仲裁法第27条)
"If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years" is unsupported by announced limits; even four years at $8,000 totals only $32,000.
“If you change jobs, the whole balance ... is gone” omits the FSA COBRA exception.
少額訴訟は「費用も数万円程度です」: 12万円の請求なら手数料は数千円規模で、数万円は過大(キーの新制度では訴額10万円まで書面3,500円)。
"about $1,220–$1,240 still forfeits" and "budget to spend roughly $1,240+": the $1,240 comes from the 2025 cap of $660. The 2026 cap is $680, so the figure is $1,220 (minor).
'전입신고 (신분증·계약서·잔금 영수증 지참)': 전입신고 does not require a 잔금 영수증, so this adds a requirement that does not exist.
'대항력(집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리)': oversimplified. In an auction it depends on ranking ahead of the 말소기준권리.
'The most commonly missed cost' adds an unsupported ranking of state-tax mistakes.
Table row "旧规满4年（2026年8月15日前）| 8000×70%×80% | 4480元": the same invented rule, presented as the standard old calculation
"摇车牌或买房，非杭州户籍的连续社保……补缴一般不算连续": outside the request and key; unverified.
Does not say the new employer cannot pay the April to October months for her. It only says to mind the handover between 灵活就业 and 单位参保.
The California line says 'taxes the earnings plus a 2.5% penalty'. The key says whether California taxes the whole rollover or only earnings is unresolved. This is accepted but is stated as settled.
'퇴사 후 14일 안에 청산하지 않으면 바로 진정할 수 있습니다': implies you must wait 14 days, but the July–September wages are already overdue and a complaint can be filed now.
"risks forfeiting roughly $1,220–$1,240": the $1,240 end uses the 2025 $660 cap. That cap does not apply to a plan year ending Dec 31, 2026, which uses $680 and gives $1,220 (minor).
'不再统一适用' is stated without noting that no replacement document was found. This is minor.
“正常上班到退休只会超过，不会不够”：不知道用户年龄及未来缴费情况，无法保证。
「サインは「内容を確認した」以上の意味を持ちません」: overclaim. Signing is assent to the contract terms; a clause that names the wallpaper specifically can be valid under the 2005 Supreme Court test.

Steps 3 and 4 list 정부24 and 인터넷등기소 as equal options and say "전입신고와 같은 날", with no warning that an online 확정일자 requested after 18:00 is dated the next business day. The opening line steers to a Friday-daytime 주민센터 visit, which limits the harm. This is an omission, not a stated falsehood.
劳部发〔1994〕503号第7条 said to leave local approval measures to the provincial labour authority: unverified.

It cites a third-party commercial site (property.ambitstock.com) as the basis for the HUG conditions "(2026. 10. 기준)". That is not an official source. The figures happen to match the key, but the source is weak.
「後日『有給のことで』と切り出すのでも遅くありません」 gives an unsupported assurance without specifying whether this happens before or after the absence.
'Scholarships, gifts, and investment income do not [count]' is imprecise. Taxable fellowship or stipend pay can count as compensation.
"Not every 529 plan has its rollover process running smoothly yet" and "December is a busy month for processors": unverifiable generalizations.
"Carryover only happens if you're ... still enrolled" presents a potentially plan-specific enrollment condition as universal.
“조기재취업수당(남은 급여의 절반, 12개월 이상 근무 시)” omits the required timing after reporting unemployment and the requirement to retain at least half the prescribed benefit days.
"계약 후 잔금 사이에 근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다": an unverifiable claim about how often this happens.
'The money needs to land ... by December 31, 2026' incorrectly makes December the federal deadline; a designated 2026 rollover can qualify through April 15, 2027, subject to plan processing.
"Whether the plan requires you to enroll in Medicare at 65 (some do; most don't)": the frequency claim is unverifiable.
“法定节假日部分不能‘包干’”：表述过于绝对；约定包含加班费是否有效，应审查实际支付是否达到法定标准。
생계비 융자 is not mentioned.
Says 미지급 시 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금. The key says this is the old rule and the penalty is 5년/5천만 원 from 2026.9.18 (minor deduction).

「子の看護休暇は病気・けがの看護」 and 「子どもの学校行事そのものを保障する法律はありません」 are outdated (my own knowledge): since 2025-04-01 the leave is called 子の看護等休暇 and also covers entrance and graduation ceremonies and class closures for children up to the end of 3rd grade of elementary school. The claim is minor and peripheral.
法テラスは「無料法律相談の紹介」とだけ書いているが、収入・資産要件がある。軽微。
日経・LIMO・FP総合研究所のURLは根拠として挙げているが、内容は確認できない(未検証)。
“有审批时这7天大约在3,724～6,207元之间”：没有综合计算周期的实际工时，无法确定该范围；假设32小时全部超时的2,482.76元算术正确，但不能据此确定上下限。
Cites no document number, only the generic 《杭州市基本医疗保障办法》 and 2026年1月1日, so the basis for the correction is thinner than the key's.
「通常損耗について納得していないが、早期解決のため例外的に応じる」と一文を残せば「納得して払った」と認定されるのを防げる: 根拠のない断定。
The furusato nozei (ワンストップ特例) and self-medication tax (12,000円超, no combined use) points are mostly correct but were not asked for. They add length to a request for a brief summary.
“旧上海算法（先按实得工资70%）”：包内依据未支持这项额外的历史基数规则，不能仅凭制度照搬83号文就推出4480元。
“正常上班到退休只会超过，不会不够”：不知道用户年龄和剩余缴费时间，不能保证累计满20年。
Describes the SEP exception as requiring '20+ employees': that threshold governs payment priority, not SEP eligibility.
"Years before you need it": invents a retirement timeline and assumes secondary coverage has no present value.
States that 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 has expired as settled fact; the key says this is presumed, with no explicit official statement
"퇴직소득세가 원천징수되어": imprecise. With an IRP transfer, which B itself describes, nothing is withheld when the money is paid (소득세법 제146조②).
'If you're not on Social Security, nothing happens automatically' overlooks automatic enrollment through Railroad Retirement benefits, based on general knowledge.
"평일 18시까지" — presented as a fixed rule, but 주민센터 hours differ by dong (minor, unverifiable).
「所得税の課税所得は0…その場合、所得税は1円も戻りません」: 戻るか否かは源泉徴収税額で決まる。源泉徴収票の「源泉徴収税額」欄の確認に触れておらず、推論が不完全。
“可能另扣大病保险等几十元”：金额无依据；标准明确相关费用从补划的个人账户扣减，不另交现金。
「欠勤」ではなく「事前に承認された休暇」なら安心という助言：承認された休暇でも無給の場合があり、有給休暇としての請求・扱いの確認を代替できない。
“轮班/做六休一……算法要按实际排班调整”：仅凭排班不能证明国庆休息日可作为正常工作日，可能误导劳动者少算。
“在职期间追劳动报酬不受1年限制”：直接用于加班费请求，遗漏答案键提示的适用口径差异。
Shibuya ward 令和9年度 resident-tax page link: a source citation I could not verify from the packet
「7年住んだ物件では残存価値はゼロ」: the guideline floor is 1円 (≒0%), and it is applied straight to the sun-yellowing, which needs no depreciation step. Minor.
"补缴超过 1 个月通常要去医保经办窗口": unverifiable procedural claim.
“退休补缴标准还会随省平工资上涨”：题包只支持标准每年调整，不能保证未来上涨。
“경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 권리는 생기지만”: 선순위 담보권 등과의 관계에 따라 낙찰자에게 대항하지 못할 수 있어 무조건적인 설명은 틀림.
조기재취업수당 "대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면 남은 수급일수의 절반": leaves out the condition that at least half of the 소정급여일수 must remain; incomplete rather than wrong
“이의제기 → 심사청구 순”: an obligatory two-stage sequence is not established by the packet or a specific supporting citation.
"7 个月年限以后随时能缴回来" is slightly overconfident; the key gives retirement-time lump-sum or monthly continuation with annually changing standards, which B does not mention.
The suggested HR question "does it run through March 15, 2026?" names the wrong year, which would confuse the check the person needs to make.
「壁紙の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」 overgeneralizes the guideline: responsibility depends on the cause of damage.
メールの「120,000円を全額ご負担いただく旨」：管理会社が負担する意味になり、請求の方向が逆。
'可以在 1 年内申请劳动仲裁' is oversimplified. Per the key, wage arrears claimed while still employed are not subject to the one-year limit.
Says 可以在1年内申请劳动仲裁 without the in-service exception. While the employment relationship continues, wage-arrears claims are not subject to the one-year limit (key, 调解仲裁法第27条).
'If the money lands in January ... the 2026 room is lost' overlooks transfers designated for 2026 through April 15, 2027, subject to institutional processing.
Frames the SEP exception as requiring “20+ employees”; employer size determines payment priority, not SEP eligibility.

Table shows '413.79 × 300% × 3 = 3,724.14' and '413.79 × 200% × 4 = 3,310.34'. With the rounded 413.79 these come to 3,724.11 and 3,310.32. The shown totals come from the unrounded rate, so this is a cosmetic mismatch of a few fen, not an error.
"这期间看病全自费": overstated. The key only says the medical insurance fund does not pay, and whether the personal account can be used is unverified.
States the 2192 floor as 应发 ('法定下限是 2192 元/月（应发）') as settled. The key says there is no official position after 14号 lapsed and the majority view is that the floor excludes personal contributions.
“长护险（45元/年）”：材料未核实这一具体金额。

「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ」: the guideline floor is a residual value of 1円 (≒0%), not zero. The answer also offers depreciation as a separate argument for the sun-yellowing, which needs no calculation because it is normal wear. Minor.
"회사가 사실상 도산했다면" as the condition for 소액체당금: wrong. 간이대지급금 for a worker who has left does not require the company to be insolvent.

Third table row (合同沿用旧“本人工资=实得工资70%”口径, 8000×70%×80% = 4480元): the premise is not in the key and is unverifiable. It conflicts with the key's base (the contract-stated position wage) and could mislead the user about what they are owed.
"3개월 총일수 약 89~92일": the three months before a 9/20 last workday (6/21~9/20) are exactly 92 days. 89 days does not apply here and inflates the upper estimate to 1,060만

"Finish by December 31, 2026 so it counts against the 2026 limit": treats December as the deadline; key says a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027 (plan-dependent), so this is a minor error
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”: 키에 따르면 개정 전 벌칙이며, 현행은 5년·5천만 원이다. 경미 감점 대상이다.
"Usually ~90 days after Dec 31" for the run-out: a typical figure that varies by plan. It is hedged, so this is minor and unverifiable rather than wrong.
「店側が変更できるのは本当に忙しくて回らないときだけ」: 時季変更権の要件「事業の正常な運営を妨げる場合」の言い換えとしてはやや粗く、条文の引用もない。
'워크넷 구직등록 후 관할 고용센터에 수급자격을 신청': 워크넷 구직등록은 고용24로 통합돼 종료됨(키가 틀린 값으로 지정)
취업규칙이나 근로계약서에 한 달이라고 적혀 있어도 법정 기한을 넘기는 조항은 인정되기 어렵다고 함: 근거 없는 법적 판단이며, 합의 연장이 가능하므로 단정은 과함

'The transfer must be completed by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 annual limit' conflicts with the key. A rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027, subject to plan processing. It then says 'no separate December 31 deadline', which contradicts itself.
“3개월치 + 퇴직금” assumes all three months remain unpaid; the request establishes late payment, not three unpaid salaries.
"퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원": 키의 추정(지방소득세 포함 약 9.4만~14.1만 원)과 맞지 않는다. 1,200만 원에 근속 4년이면 약 14만 원이라 직접 재계산해도 20만 원보다 훨씬 낮다. 또 IRP로 이전하면 지급 시점에는 원천징수가 없다.
"you might need a Part D plan, and possibly Part B to get it": Part D needs Part A or Part B, so premium-free Part A is enough. Imprecise, though hedged with "possibly".
“7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다”: counts affected months instead of establishing delay duration or unpaid amount.
"Skip ... Part D" after checking only enrollment requirements and carve-outs: unsafe if HR reports that the drug coverage is not creditable.

"So at most $660 of your $1,900 survives... The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240": wrong under a grace period, where all $1,900 can pay for work done by the grace end. It also contradicts B's own later grace-period caveat.
Says 실무에서는 두 방식이 갈리므로 and advises negotiating on 1,200만 원. The claim about practice is unverifiable and no basis is given.
'Scholarships ... don't count' as earned income is too broad. From my own knowledge, the SECURE Act (2019) treats taxable non-tuition fellowship and stipend payments as compensation for IRA purposes.
“고용24에서 수급자격 신청” omits the training and employment-center visit specified by the key.
Procedure “补缴超过1个月通常要去医保经办窗口，带身份证、居住证或户口本、就业登记材料、补缴申请表” and the 浙里办 menu path: unverifiable procedural steps
"北京法院在类似案件中的口径也是：未履行行政审批的，按标准工时制认定" rests on a news link (Fengtai court briefing) that I could not open; unverifiable.
"If you don't have 40 quarters, Part A carries a premium and its own late penalty": imprecise. The current-employment GHP SEP also shields premium Part A from the penalty. Minor, and B defers to SSA.
"퇴사 후 14일 안에 청산하지 않으면 바로 진정할 수 있습니다": misleading. Wages already overdue can be reported right away, with no need to wait 14 days.
Grace period stated flatly as "through March 15". That is the maximum, and a plan may set a shorter one.
Table shows 413.79 × 300% × 3 = 3,724.14, but 413.79 × 9 = 3,724.11. The figure comes from the unrounded daily wage. The key accepts either, so this is only a small internal inconsistency.
浙里办 → "浙里医保" → 我要参保 → 职工参保登记（灵活就业）, and paying through "浙江税务社保缴费": unverifiable app navigation steps.
'Scholarships, investment income, and parental support don't count' as earned income. Roughly right, but taxable stipends can count as compensation. Minor and unverified.

'the 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary' (in the change-beneficiary option) is stated as settled. The key says no IRS guidance exists and the point is unresolved; this is a major deduction. Elsewhere A hedges with 'can restart'.

Puts quotation marks around '安排劳动者在法定休假日工作的,按300%' and calls it Beijing's rule. The linked gov.cn page is the 北京市工资支付规定 (I opened it), but its Article 16 text only says to pay under Article 14(3), i.e. 300%. Paraphrase presented as a quote; minor.
"설령 합의로 미뤘더라도 지연이자는 원칙적으로 그대로 붙어요(고용노동부 행정해석)": cites a ministry interpretation with no document number or link, so the source cannot be checked
「口頭でも『LINEでお願いした件です』と一言添えると通りやすい」: 根拠のない経験則で検証不能
「付与日や日数は就業規則にも書いてある」 assumes contents of this employer’s rules that the packet does not establish.

"Indiana ... recapture state 529 deductions" misidentifies Indiana's benefit: it is a credit. See [Indiana529's official tax information](https://www.indiana529direct.com/home/help-center-taxes.html).
"big exception that fits you exactly: active employment-based group coverage from an employer with 20+ employees": imprecise. The SEP is not tied to employer size (minor per key).
"If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years": contradicts key; even at $8,000 x 4 = $32,000 < $35,000, the full $35,000 still takes at least five tax years
「重要事項説明でその説明を受けていた」を特約成立の事情として挙げる点は、法的要件として断定できない。
称劳动仲裁“时效1年”：遗漏在职追讨欠薪不受一年时效限制、离职后一年内提出的特别规则，会误导本案用户。

"18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다": the key says an internet-registry 확정일자 requested after 18:00 is dated the next business day (Monday 10-26), so it cannot be finished the same day. The key also treats the date of an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 as unconfirmed, and this answer states it flatly.
Asks whether she can 补3–9月. That span conflicts with the 7-month gap of April to October (new job from November), so October is left out and March is added.
「急なお願い」「代わりに出勤できる日を調整することもできます」：依頼が急であることや代替出勤の可否は相談者から示されていない。
'Premiums aren't refunded' is an unsupported blanket assertion; the packet does not establish refund rules.
「社会保険料の金額が分かれば、所得税0が確定します」 is incorrect: knowing the amount does not establish that it meets the required threshold.
引号中的“参保缴费次次月”：计算结果符合答案键，但材料不能验证这是文件原话。

"고용노동부와 법제처도 퇴직금 산정에 이 조항이 적용된다고 해석합니다": no link or document number. The 법제처 part matches the key; the 고용노동부 interpretation is unverified.

Asks whether the plan 'carves out' benefits for Medicare-eligible non-enrollees and says to enroll if it does: for a 20+ employer's active employees such carve-outs are generally not allowed under Medicare Secondary Payer rules, so the concern is misleading (my own knowledge).

"평일 18시까지" is stated as the 주민센터's closing time from one 강동구 FAQ link. Hours differ by 동, so this is only loosely supported (minor).
'고용노동부와 법제처도 ... 해석합니다' gives no document number or link, so it is unverifiable as written (the key does support a 법제처 interpretation).

"18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다": wrong per the key. An internet-registry 확정일자 applied for after 18:00 on Friday is granted on the next working day (Monday), and the filing date of an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 is unverified, so stating it as settled is penalized.
“운영시간…을 놓치면…인터넷등기소 확정일자로 대체하세요” misleadingly presents an after-hours substitute without explaining that Friday applications after 18:00 receive Monday issuance.
"你的年限会从8年变成8年": confusing wording.
"진정 결과는 실업급여 심사에도 도움이 됩니다" is unverifiable.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated. From 2026.9.18 퇴직급여법 제43조 sets 5년/5천만 원 (minor deduction).
Changing only the third sentence does not make the message 「休みの相談としてだけ読めます」: the following sentence still explicitly asserts paid-leave entitlement.
'The 2026 IRA limit is $7,500 per the IRS' credits the IRS with no link or document number, so the source claim can't be checked (the figure itself is right per IR-2025-111).

Asserts an income-tax refund of about 850 yen (所得税5%で約850円) with no mention of the 104万円 basic deduction, of withholding being 0, or of checking the 源泉徴収票. The key treats this as a significant omission.
"The 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary" presents an unresolved question as settled.
The HR text says "제가 계산한 퇴직금은 세전 약 1,020만 원", which anchors at the lowest figure although the answer's own range goes up to about 12.02 million won (strategic weakness, not a factual error).
"It's an employer plan account, not your money" is loose and unsourced wording.
전입신고 준비물에 '잔금 영수증' 포함: 필수 서류가 아님(해는 없음)
杭州职工医保的报销比例不跟连续年限挂钩 / 连续年限清零在杭州主要影响等待期和生育 - unverifiable. The key says Hangzhou's employee-insurance rules have no reset of continuous years at all.
将合同写“按国家和上海有关规定执行”直接对应2192元，忽略答案键要求结合合同全文及以往发放情况判断。

전입신고 "계약서 명의자 본인이": the law does not require the person named on the contract to file it personally (a household member or an authorised proxy can), so this is overstated
'HUG·SGI' 반환보증 '전입신고·확정일자 후 신청 가능': the HUG condition matches the key, but the SGI condition and the 'only after' timing are unverified.
It uses 1,157 days and 3.17 years and gets 약 1,023만, slightly off the key's 1,158 days and 약 1,024만 (rounding only).

Never addresses what happens to the excess if all $48,000 were moved in 2026: no 6% excise tax and no taxable earnings plus 10% on the non-qualifying part. It only says $7,500 is the most to move this year.
“고용센터에 피보험자격 확인”: 일반적인 제도 지식상 근로복지공단 담당 절차이며, 제시한 접수 경로는 확인이 필요합니다.
住まいるダイヤル（0570-016-100）: 筆者の知識では実在の相談窓口で番号も合うが、packetでは未検証。
'2년 근무면 150일분이 나오고' — leaves out the age condition: claimants aged 50 or over, or with a disability, get 180 days (key).
'3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 (퇴직급여법 제44조)' is the old penalty. Since 2026.9.18 it is 5 years or 50 million won under 제43조 (minor deduction).

'(선택) 전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만': omits that it needs the landlord's cooperation (민법 제621조) and that it ranks only from the registration date, behind any existing mortgage. This is the one step the tenant cannot do alone.
"你离退休还远" is assumed, not known, and the advice not to 补 depends on it.
引用北京市人社局2019年案例的逐字原话：核心意思与答案键一致，但逐字引文没有可核验链接或文号，无法核实。
“另加大病、长护险几十元”：应从补划的个人账户资金扣减，不另交现金。
"购房、落户等'连续社保'资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）" is unverified and likely concerns 养老/社保 rules rather than 医保; not covered by the key.
Typo in the draft arbitration request: '不及效力' should be '不发生效力'. The answer is also long and repeats itself: section four, the cross-check in section three and the variables section overlap.
"购房、落户等'连续社保'资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）": an unverifiable general claim beyond the request (my own judgment; varies by city)
"상시 5인 이상 사업장의 퇴직금제도라고 가정" implies that workplaces with fewer than 5 employees are treated differently. Not penalized, because the key leaves eligibility requirements unverified.
"Then: spend it before Dec 31, not in March": unconditional advice that ignores the grace-period branch, where March work by the grace end is covered.
'대항력은 신고 다음 날 0시부터라 오전에 끝내는 게 좋아요': finishing in the morning does not change the effective time, so the reasoning does not support the advice (minor).
Medicare.gov source links are cited as the basis for the answer, with no way to verify they were consulted. Unverifiable.
"Most [plans] do by 2026, but not all" adds an unverified claim about plan availability.
「満額12万円にはなりません」 is too categorical: depreciation alone does not exclude labor or construction costs for tenant-caused damage.
“7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 충족할 가능성이 높으니”: three late-payment months alone do not establish likelihood without delay lengths or outstanding amounts.
“断缴3个月以上会重新计算”：杭州分界是超过3个月；题包也未支持笼统的职工医保连续年限重算规则。
「そもそも敷金10万円で足りず、2万円の追加請求になっている点も不自然です」: unsupported reasoning. The 20,000 yen is just 120,000 minus 100,000, and the key treats it as the risk of accepting, not as an oddity.
"임금체불확인서(회사 발급)" is wrong. The 체불임금등·사업주 확인서 comes from the labor office (노동관서) after a complaint, not from the employer; judged from own knowledge.
“빨리 재취업하면 … 절반”: omits the initial 14-day restriction, at least half the benefit days remaining, and 12 months of employment.
“另加大病、长护险几十元”：错误；相关个人费用从补划的个人账户资金扣减，不另交现金。

The 2026 maximum is given as the smallest of four items ($7,500; compensation; eligible balance; $7,500 minus other contributions). That is wrong when compensation is under $7,500 and he has other contributions: $4,000 earned plus $2,000 contributed gives $4,000 instead of the correct $2,000. The table's own wording ("$7,500, or his taxable compensation if less. Reduced by any other 2026 IRA contributions") is correct, and so are all the worked examples.
现行细则明确：应保未保期间可以补缴, sourced to 本地宝 - the source is third-party and 明确 overstates. The key marks back-payment for a period of unemployment as unverified.
“열쇠를 받아 쓸 수 있으면 ‘인도’는 됩니다”는 정답 기준에서 확인되지 않은 법적 단정입니다. 실제 점유 이전 여부에 관한 조건이 빠졌습니다.
“가장 큰 목돈입니다” cannot be established from the unknown unpaid wages, severance amount and other available funds.

"Grace period - you can incur expenses through March 15, 2026 and still claim them against 2025 funds" has the wrong year. For a plan year ending Dec 31, 2026 the grace end is March 15, 2027 at the latest. The user's March dental work is in 2027.
"sign up for Part D within 63 days": imprecise. The Part D SEP runs 2 full months after coverage ends; 63 days is the penalty threshold.
将14号文到期失效作为确定结论：标准答案仅推定失效，未见官方明确表态。
"you usually have until March–April to submit receipts": run-out deadlines vary by plan. This typical range is unverified (minor).
"같은 법 제17조에 따라 연 20%의 지연이자": wrong citation. The delay interest comes from 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조, not 퇴직급여법 제17조. The same wrong citation is repeated in the HR message.
“这4天32小时”：用户未提供每天工作时长，只能作为明确标注的假设。
"The contributions themselves can be withdrawn tax-free at any time" for rolled-over money is not verified. The key lists the Roth ordering rules as not verified.
Cites article 55 of the Hangzhou measures for carrying years across cities: the article number cannot be checked from the packet.
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」: defers the number to workplace documents when the statutory number is fixed (5 days under 施行規則第24条の3), and a 給与明細 does not necessarily show the leave balance

"4대보험 미가입이었다면 근로복지공단에 피보험자격 확인청구(1588-0075)" is unverifiable as to the right agency (고용센터 or 근로복지공단) and the phone number. It is also off the stated facts, since the user never said they lacked insurance.
Says 10号第九条 '只规定了病假工资的计算基数' and has no ratio. The key says 第九条 also requires paying sick-leave wages per the rules, and B's own HR message says so later. Slightly inconsistent.
"Your coworker's penalty warning doesn't apply to you at 400 employees" ties the penalty exemption to employer size. The SEP does not depend on size; size decides who pays first (imprecise, minor).
'目前仅支持线下办理，带身份证或市民卡去区医保经办机构' is a procedural claim not in the key and is unverifiable

Third table row ("合同沿用旧'本人工资=实得工资70%'口径", 8000×70%×80%=4480) applies a 70% haircut to an 8000 contract wage. Per the Zhonglun article the 70% base applies only when no wage is specified in the contract or collective contract, so this scenario is misapplied. Offered as a hedged alternative, and A says elsewhere that the old 4-year tier means 6400.
“另加大病、长护险几十元”: per the key, these premiums come out of the money credited to the personal account during back-payment, not as extra cash.
“기한을 넘기면…지연이자가 붙습니다”: omits the statutory circumstances in which interest is temporarily excluded.

"(Part D is 63 days.)" and "Enroll in Part D or a Medicare Advantage plan within 63 days if your drug coverage isn't creditable": these mix up two rules. 63 days is the coverage gap that triggers the penalty. The enrollment window after employer coverage ends is 2 full months, and if the current drug coverage is not creditable, the penalty is already building.

Ties the no-penalty delay to the employer being over 20 employees ("That makes your group plan primary, and it lets you delay Part B"). Employer size is not a condition of the SEP; the key calls this imprecise but minor.
Says the 办法 does not explicitly say whether 补缴 removes the waiting period. The hedge itself is fine, but 'the 办法 does not say' is an unverifiable claim about the text.
Lists 구직촉진수당 (월 50만원, 최대 6개월) in the same ordered list as 구직급여 without saying it can be excluded while receiving 구직급여; the cue '자격을 확인하세요' softens it.
“按现行文件和裁审口径的分析”未提供可核验的裁判或裁审口径依据。

Penalty given as 3 years / 30 million won under Art. 44: old rule; since 2026.9.18 it is 5 years / 50 million won under Art. 43 (minor deduction). It also sits oddly beside the opening line that the answer follows the law in force in October 2026.
“실무에서는 두 방식이 갈리므로…협의”: misleadingly presents the ordinary-wage floor as a negotiable alternative rather than a mandatory rule when applicable.
“고용노동부와 법제처도 … 해석합니다”: the underlying rule matches the key, but the claimed institutional interpretations are not accompanied by a checkable interpretation link or document number.
"He is 22": stated as fact, but someone born in 2004 could still be 21 in late 2026 (trivial).

The imaeil.com link cited for the 2026 figures was not opened. The figures themselves (66,048 and 68,100 won a day, about 198만 to 204만 won a month, about 1,000만 won in total) match the key and the arithmetic checks out. The 1350.moel.go.kr link was opened and is a real Q&A page on the 2-month wage-arrears rule.
和歌山労働局のリンクは実在し、パートにも同様に扱う旨と「全所定労働日の8割以上」の記載を確認した（問題なし）
"K-12 tuition (up to $10,000 a year)" is outdated: since January 1, 2026 the federal cap is $20,000 per beneficiary (checked on the web via several 529 provider pages and J.P. Morgan).
「今回は通常の医療費控除が有利です」は、市販薬の購入額が不明なため根拠のない断定。
把14号文件失效也归于所链接的人社局答复：答案键确认的官方答复仅涉及83号，14号失效仍是推定。
States the deadline as 10월 4일 flatly; the key says it falls somewhere in 10/3~10/6 depending on how the retirement date and holidays are read.
“고용노동부(1350)…에 진정을”: blurs the distinction between telephone consultation and filing a complaint.
Labels NTA No.1119 as 医療費控除の手続; I opened it and its title is 医療費控除に関する手続について, so the label is fine
Step-by-step app route (浙里办 → 浙里医保 → 我要参保 → 职工参保登记, then 浙江税务社保缴费) and the list of documents to bring: unverifiable, no source.
“평일 18시까지” generalizes one linked local office’s hours to the unspecified office; the key says office hours can vary.
“降薪、调岗、辞退；如果发生……主张违法解除赔偿金”：降薪、调岗本身不等于违法解除，不能一概适用解除赔偿。
Quotes an 人社部办公厅 notice ('在正常发放的当日工资（100%）之外，再额外支付300%') without naming the document. The wording cannot be checked.
"전입신고 ... 주민센터나 정부24에서, 계약서 명의자 본인이": the requirement that the 계약서 명의자 file in person is unsourced, and no after-hours date caveat is given.
"임금체불확인서(회사 발급)": the 체불 확인서 is normally issued by the labour office (노동관서), not the company; questionable
No 743.60 yuan/month (5,205.20 for 7 months) retirement lump-sum figure, so the cost of not topping up is not quantified.
Quotes the rule as “参保缴费次次月”. The key's wording is “自恢复缴费月起的第三个自然月”. The meaning matches, but the quoted text is unverifiable.
'Part B starts November 1, 2026' assumes the current month is October 2026 (matches the key, but the request gives no date).
'(선택) 전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만': 임대인 동의·협력이 필요하다는 점을 빠뜨렸고, '더 강하다'는 단정은 논란이 있음
「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ」: 定額法には下限の1円があり、正確には「1円（≒0%）」。軽微な不正確さ。
"Six-month Medigap open enrollment ... (in most states)" misleadingly qualifies a federal protection for this 65-year-old.
「合わせて2,500円程度」：所得税の還付がない可能性を無視している。源泉徴収税額が0なら所得税の還付も0円。

조기재취업수당 "대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면 남은 수급일수의 절반" leaves out a required condition: the person must re-employ with at least half of the 소정급여일수 still left. The key also puts the timing at 14 days after filing, not "대기기간 후".
"个别法院会结合岗位特点、劳动强度酌定，不是机械按200%判" is an unsupported claim about court practice.
'이미 늦게라도 받았다면 그 지연 사실 자체가 사유가 되고' is wrong as a general rule. The test is the sum of delay days, not the number of late months.
"Medigap guaranteed-issue window (6 months from Part B enrollment)" is loose wording for the Medigap open enrollment period, though the substance is right
'你可以主张按9000元或近12个月平均应发工资作为基数': a 12-month average is not the Beijing overtime base rule (工资支付规定第44条: the wage set in the contract, then the collective contract, then normal wage). Unsupported.

Uses the 6-year life and 「残存価値はほぼゼロ」 as a backup argument for the sunburn itself. The key says depreciation does not apply, because sunburn creates no tenant liability at all (it is not wrong, but it muddies the reasoning)
"전입신고 — ... 계약서 명의자 본인이": an invented requirement. A 세대주, a 세대원 or a delegate can file a 전입신고, and a family member's 전입 also counts toward 대항력.

States the requirements for a valid 特約 as 「内容が具体的で明確」「借主の認識」「締結経緯からみて真意に基づく」. This does not match the guideline's three requirements (必要性・合理性, 借主の認識, 負担の意思表示) and leaves out the necessity/rationality requirement (minor).

The "smallest of" list has the same flaw as A. It treats compensation and "$7,500 minus other IRA contributions" as separate caps, so $4,000 earned plus $2,000 contributed would give $4,000 instead of $2,000. The worked examples never hit this case.
"9월 20일 퇴사라면 10월 4일이 기한"과 "오늘(10월 25일) 기준으로 이미 3주 가까이": 질문에 월과 오늘 날짜가 없는데 단정했다. 10/4는 키의 범위(10/3~10/6) 안이다. 문자의 "퇴사일 다음 날부터 14일"은 본문의 "9/20 + 14일 = 10/4"와 맞지 않고 법 문언(지급사유 발생일부터)과도 다르다.
"plus pay stubs/W-2s as backup" for the CMS-L564 filing is unverifiable and not in the key
「クリーニング…は対象外」：治療目的の歯石除去等まで一律に対象外にはできない。
The source's claimed “updated Aug. 2026” date is unverified from the packet.
“最划算”“没有实际收益，不建议补”：未核实退休时间及预计缴费缺口，不能作此确定判断。
“석 달치 임금”: three months of outstanding wages are not established by the request.
Medicare.gov links (including the 'ready-to-sign-up-for-part-a-part-b' URL) are cited as sources and cannot be verified from the packet.
「後日…切り出すのでも遅くありません」：有給の申出を後回しにしても支障がないとは、具体的な時期や手続きなしに保証できない。
"杭州退休医保待遇不看20年以上的年限" and "杭州职工医保的报销比例不跟连续年限挂钩": not covered by the key and no specific source given; plausible but unverified.
山东高院〔2018〕鲁民再154号及“值班的特殊情形”：案号和案情描述无法核实，而且离题。
Frames the penalty exception as requiring an employer with 20+ employees; the SEP itself has no size condition (the 20-employee line only decides who pays first). Imprecise, minor here.
“Everything is forfeited December 31” and “$1,900 becomes $0 on January 1” overlook reimbursement of timely incurred expenses claimed during the run-out period.
“大病保险等可能另计几十元”误导现金预算；答案键明确相关个人费用从补划个人账户扣减，不另交现金。
“不能只按基本工资；实际发放高于合同约定的，按实际发放”：忽略北京优先按合同约定工资标准确定基数的规则，表述过于绝对。
추천 문자 ①의 "지연이자(연 20%)와 고용노동부 진정 절차를 검토할 수밖에 없어": 키가 금지한 위협성 문구에 가깝다. "일정을 맞추기 어려우시다면 사유와 구체적인 지급 예정일을…"은 연장을 열어 주는 것으로 읽힐 수 있다.

'대항력은 신고 다음 날 0시부터라 오전에 끝내는 게 좋아요': the next-day-0:00 rule does not depend on morning versus afternoon, so the stated reason does not support the advice. It also never ties the timing to Friday/10-24 or says the priority right starts the same way.
"The 2026 IRA limit is $7,500 per the IRS": the source is cited without a link or document number. The figure is correct per the key (IR-2025-111).
The 참고한 자료 list includes a 법제처 interpretation dated 2026. 5. 26. and a 고용노동부 calculator link. Links are given, but the date and content can't be verified here.
'7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다' is stated flatly with no 60-day delay-day test and no check of how late each month was. This is the '석 달이니 무조건' overclaim.
The HR text states the amount as 약 1,020만 원, the low end only. This is not an error, but it is weaker than the answer's own point that 1,202만 is arguable.
'You'll need ... plus pay stubs/W-2s as backup' incorrectly presents supplemental evidence as routinely required alongside completed CMS-L564.
“Many plans offer neither”: unsupported prevalence claim; the packet establishes only that neither is possible.
'the 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary' presents the beneficiary-change reset as settled. No IRS guidance exists, so the question is unresolved.
"杭州的报销比例只看医院等级和费用段，不看连续缴了几年": unverifiable, not covered by the key.
Arithmetic is inconsistent: 32×51.72×1.5 = 2482.56, not 2482.76 (that only follows from the unrounded daily wage), and 7034.48-6206.90 = 827.58, not the stated 827.59. Differences are a few cents.
「立会いの「確認書」は現状記録としてなら署名可」: 実務上の助言。署名内容次第では不利になりうるが、ある程度の根拠はある。軽微。
Cites 《杭州市基本医疗保障办法》'第五十五条' for transfer and accumulation; the article number is unverifiable from the key

「子どもの学校行事そのものを保障する法律はありません」「子の看護休暇は病気・けがの看護」：誤り。開いて確認した[厚生労働省の説明](https://www.mhlw.go.jp/seisakunitsuite/bunya/koyou_roudou/koyoukintou/ryouritsu/ikuji/nursing/)では、2025年4月から入園式・卒園式・入学式も対象で、予防接種等も含まれる。

「戻る税金は所得税が約850円…合わせて2,500円ほど」: states an income-tax refund as fact. 106万−104万＝2万 is wiped out by any 社会保険料控除 of 2万 or more, which a 180万 part-timer almost certainly has, so the refund is likely 0. The answer never mentions checking 源泉徴収税額. The key penalizes exactly this.
"re-enrolling later is more complicated than never enrolling": an unsourced opinion. Someone still working could re-enroll under the SEP.
"첫 입금까지 몇 주 걸립니다" is a rough timing estimate with no 7일 대기기간 or other figure; plausible but unverified.
"퇴직금 미지급은 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 (퇴직급여법 제44조)": outdated. From 2026.9.18 it is 제43조, 5년/5천만 원 (minor, per the key)
「具体的に書かれ、重要事項説明でその説明を受けていた…事情がない限り」：書面への具体的記載と重要事項説明の両方を必要条件のように扱っている。キーの判例は具体的記載、または口頭説明による明確な認識・合意を挙げている。

「借主がその内容を認識し、契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効（同ガイドライン）」: oversimplifies. The guideline's three requirements are necessity/reasonableness, the tenant's recognition, and an expressed intent to bear the cost. The Supreme Court test is a specific written clause OR an oral explanation, not explanation only.
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」: The actual documents were not provided, and a payslip is not guaranteed to show leave entitlement.
少額訴訟の「費用も数万円程度」：根拠のない費用目安。キーにある10万円請求の手数料は書面3,500円・電子2,400円で、数万円になる費用内訳を示していない。
Cites a 2026-09 全国总工会 interpretation and a 西城区 service guide. The guide is said to require union opinion, publicity and democratic-procedure materials. Both are given with links only.
The Sources list (savingforcollege, lockwealthmanagement) is secondary and unverifiable.
Says the threshold has no separate continuous-payment requirement and never says Hangzhou requires staying insured until retirement (办法第八条). This is a mild over-simplification.
Cites 劳部发〔1997〕271号第4条 with quoted wording “另外支付” and “一般不安排补休”: not checked, unverifiable.
The draft text assumes 「学校行事」, but the user wrote only 「子どもの行事」. This is minor.
“330만 ÷ 209 × 8”: assumes a 209-hour monthly schedule without establishing or explicitly stating that condition.
'퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원을 빼면 실수령' is unsupported. An IRP transfer has no withholding at payment, and the key's estimate for a non-pension withdrawal is about 9.4만~14.1만.
“7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고” incorrectly treats three affected months as sufficient without checking delayed-payment days or unpaid amounts.
「残存価値はゼロ」: under the current guideline the residual value is 1 yen (about 0%), not exactly zero. Minor.

'If the money lands in January, it generally counts for 2027, and the 2026 room is lost' is wrong as a federal rule. A rollover designated for 2026 can run to April 15, 2027, though processing varies by plan. December 31 is treated as the deadline.
Asserts '北京主流裁审不这么看' with no source. Unsupported generalisation.
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」 and 「出せない請求は、根拠も怪しいことが多いです」 are unverifiable empirical claims.

Defines 대항력 as "집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리": misleading. It holds against an auction buyer only if it predates the senior 근저당; the key defines it as the right to demand the deposit back from a new owner.
Filing is shown only as 2027年2月16日〜3月15日: it omits the 5-year refund-filing window and the early start from 1 January, so it implies a narrower window than the rules allow

"이직일 다음 날부터 12개월 안에 신청해야 하고": presents the 12-month benefit period as a filing deadline. This hides that filing late cuts the number of paid days (150 days requires filing within about 208 days of leaving).

「国土交通省ガイドラインでは、壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」, which is repeated in the drafted email. This overgeneralizes the guideline, which assigns the cost by cause: sun fading falls on the landlord, while damage the tenant caused falls on the tenant.

"If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years": unrealistic and contradicts the key. With 2026 fixed at $7,500 and indexing in $500 steps, even $8,000 x 4 = $32,000 < $35,000, so it still takes five years.
称无合同、集体合同约定时按正常工资70%作为基数，并引出4480元：给定材料不足以核实该额外规则及其现行适用性；乘法本身正确。
14일을 넘기면 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(같은 법 제44조 제1호): 2026.9.18.부터 제43조의 5년 이하 징역/5천만 원 이하 벌금으로 바뀐 옛 규정임(키상 경미 감점)
Applies the 2025 $660 carryover cap and $1,240 remainder to this 2026 balance; the applicable maximum is $680, leaving $1,220.
Labels the 6400 row as "合同/制度只约定80%、基数按8000（无70%折扣）". That presents the plain 83号 tier figure for 4 full years as an odd contract case.
"连续缴费年限：断缴3个月以上会重新计算": per the key, a 'reset' appears only in the resident-insurance critical-illness continuity reward, not in Hangzhou employee insurance. Misleading framing.
"If the money lands in January ... the 2026 room is lost" is wrong: designation for 2026 is federally possible through April 15, 2027, subject to plan processing.

"10월 4일이 법정 기한" and "오늘(10월 25일) 기준 21일 지났어요": a single deadline is asserted although it depends on the retirement-date reading and holidays (key range about 10/3 to 10/6). The arithmetic (10/25 minus 10/4 = 21) is right and the answer is conditional on a 9/20 exit.
Hard-codes 9월 20일 퇴사 and a 10월 4일 deadline although the user gave no month; an assumption stated as fact, though it falls inside the key's 10/3~10/6 window.
Cites an unnamed 人社部办公厅 notice with quoted wording and a 常州人社局 reply; no document number, so the quoted wording is unverified.
"另可能补扣大病保险 48 元/年、长护险等几十元": the key says these come out of the backfilled personal-account money, not extra cash. The wording is ambiguous.
'两种计算方式相差约827.59元' rests on the invented 150% figure
“이게 당장 가장 큰 현금입니다”: neither the outstanding amount nor immediate recovery is established.
"Does it run through March 15, 2026?" would send the user to ask HR about a date that has already passed.
"The most commonly missed cost" adds an unsupported claim about how frequently state tax is overlooked.
“1,020만~1,045만 원”: misleadingly narrow estimate; omits the ordinary-wage floor that could raise payment to about 12.02 million won.
Premium given only as "roughly $185-$210/month, set annually" instead of the 2026 figure of $202.90; vague, not wrong
"529 plans often have earlier year-end processing cutoffs": unverifiable generalization. It is hedged and plausible, and the key says processing varies by plan.
「できれば今週中に」: 法律上の期限ではなく助言だが、根拠は示されていない。
'you might need a Part D plan, and possibly Part B to get it': imprecise. Part D needs Part A or Part B, so someone who has premium-free Part A doesn't need Part B for it (hedged, minor).
“2년 근무라 퇴직금 대상”: omits the weekly working-hours condition specified in the key.
Assumes 1,156 days of service (key: about 1,158), giving 10,224,000 won instead of 10,241,990. The difference is small, but the days are assumed without explanation.

'旧标准还有一个容易忽略的细节：基数要先按正常工资的70%计算，所以按旧口径是 8000×70%×80%=4480元，并非6400元': wrong. The 70% base applied only as a fallback when no wage was agreed. With an agreed 8000 wage, the old bracket gives 6400, which the key states explicitly.
「少額訴訟（60万円以下）：自分で提起でき、費用も数万円程度です」: 10万円前後の訴額なら手数料は数千円(新制度で書面3,500円・電子2,400円)。「数万円」は過大。
'고용24에서 수급자격 신청': imprecise. Online you only file the job-seeker registration and do the education; the eligibility claim is made in person at the local employment center.
「サインは『内容を確認した』以上の意味を持ちません」は誤り。署名は契約内容への合意を示す証拠にもなる。
'《综合计算工时工作制行政许可决定书》' is given as an exact document title: unverifiable, though harmless as advice.

Calls 2,192元 应发下限 while also saying the personal-contribution question is disputed. The key's majority view is that 2192 is a net-pay floor. This is a minor lean toward the minority view, mitigated by the stated dispute.
Says the continuous-years figure is what gets recalculated and that it decides the waiting period. This goes beyond the key, and the waiting period comes from the interruption rule.
Attributes the exclusion of normal wear to 「判例・通説」 and never mentions that it is codified in 民法621条 (minor).
"2026년 10월 현재 시행 중인 법을 기준으로 정리했습니다": says current law was checked, but the penalty it gives is the old one
山东高院〔2018〕鲁民再154号: case citation with no link. Unverifiable.
「更新の必要があっても借主負担分は生じません」: depreciation does not eliminate every possible charge for tenant-caused damage, including potential labor costs.

「クリーニング・ホワイトニング…は対象外（国税庁 No.1128）」: the citation makes it look as if NTA lists these. Whitening is not among NTA's examples, and insured scaling (cleaning done as treatment) is deductible, so 'クリーニング' is overbroad (judged from my own knowledge plus the key)
"Next year, elect only what you'll realistically spend": generic advice that misses the point that a 2027 election could cover the March work.
TKC・財務省・国税庁(keisan)のURLを出典として提示: 内容は未確認(ただし本則62万＋特例42万＝104万は鍵の104万と整合)
'If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years' is misleading. Four years would need an average cap of at least $8,750, and limits are indexed in $500 steps, so it still takes five years.
“회사는 평균임금 기준 1,024만 원으로 계산할 수 있습니다” misleadingly suggests the company may choose the lower calculation even when the ordinary-wage floor applies.
Puts the Beijing rule in quotation marks as "安排劳动者在法定休假日工作的，按300%". That is a paraphrase shown as a quote; the regulation refers to 第十四条第（三）项 rather than saying '300%'

「通常損耗を借主負担とする特約は、借主がその内容を認識し、契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効（同ガイドライン）」: incomplete summary of the three guideline requirements (omits necessity/rationality and the tenant's expressed intent to bear the cost). The 最判平成17年12月16日 is not cited.
States the deadline as 10월 4일 flatly; the key says it falls somewhere in 10/3~10/6 depending on how the retirement date and holidays are read.
"10월 30일 이후 노동청에 진정" and a 10/30 payment deadline in the text message: arbitrary dates, no legal basis. They are practical choices, not errors.

"3개월 일수가 90~92일이면 약 1,020만~1,045만 원": the window from 6/21 to 9/20 is fixed at 92 days, so varying the day count is misleading. The range also leaves out the ordinary-wage floor (about 1,202만), so 약 1,022만 is presented as nearly fixed (minor).
"Scholarships do not [count]" is too broad: qualifying taxable scholarship or fellowship compensation can count. Checked [IRS Publication 970](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p970).
“已经发过……节日补贴，要抵扣”：节日补贴并不当然属于已支付的加班工资，不能一概抵扣。
"이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)" is wrong. The key puts this request's Friday at 2026-10-23, so every date-dependent step is off by a week.

"The drug coverage isn't creditable. Then you might need a Part D plan, and possibly Part B to get it" is misleading: Part D eligibility needs Part A or Part B, so Part A alone is enough and Part B is not needed to get a Part D plan.
「貸主様側で負担が確定した分を除き」は負担者を逆にしている。貸主負担分を敷金から控除する理由にはならない。
人社厅函〔2025〕1号“明确这300%是另外支付”：引号措辞无法核实。结论与答案键一致，并附了链接。

"퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원": overstated. My own recomputation with 4 years of service (근속연수공제 400만, 환산급여공제) gives about 9.4만 to 14.1만 won including local tax, matching the key. Also, after an IRP transfer nothing is withheld at payment.
「敷金から引くには修繕内容と費用の内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: misstates Art. 622-2, which says the deposit is returned less unpaid debts arising from the lease. It contains no duty to present an itemised breakdown.
'제44조 제1호, 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금'은 키 기준으로 개정 전 규정이다.
