「少額でも相談は無料です」: consultation is free, but a 188 call carries ordinary call charges. Minor.
'The 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary' presents an unresolved issue as settled.
“连续缴费年限……重新计算”：材料不支持这一概括性的职工医保重算规则。
“杭州退休医保待遇不看20年以上的年限”：题包未支持这一笼统待遇判断。
「直前だと時季変更権の余地が広がります」 is plausible but not sourced; the key only says a change right needs a real obstruction to normal operations.
"7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다": overstated. The test is 60 days of total delay or nonpayment, not the number of late months, and a late-paid month may fall short.
“休息日调休要有书面记录”“向区人社局申请政府信息公开”以查审批：流程性说法无出处，无法核实。
“摇车牌或买房……补缴一般不算连续”：新增跨政策领域的概括，给定材料无法核实。
「②…一文を残す…後から『納得して払った』と認定されるのを防げます」: unverifiable legal assurance, and the answer offers to draft an acceptance email anyway
给人事的文字声称“已按公司要求提交证明”，但请求只说明持有医院证明，未说明已经提交。
'3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(제44조)' is the old rule; the key says 5 years / 50 million won under Article 43 from 2026.9.18 (minor deduction).
“合计约3,370元” (adds 大病/长护 about 54元 on top of 3,315.69 as cash): the key says these individual fees are deducted from the re-credited personal-account funds and are not paid as extra cash

"If the money lands in January, it generally counts for 2027, and the 2026 room is lost": wrong per key; the 2026 Form 5498 instructions and 219(f)(3) allow a rollover designated for 2026 through April 15, 2027 (whether the plan processes it that way varies by plan), so December 31 is not the federal deadline
Quotes the Hangzhou rule as “参保缴费次次月”: the source wording is “自恢复缴费月起的第三个自然月”, so the quote is unverifiable even though the resulting month matches
“我能不能以灵活就业身份补3–9月”: wrong months. She left in March and had paid for March, so the gap is April to October 2026.
Quotes the statute as 「業務の正常な運営を妨げる場合」. Article 39(5) and the cited Shizuoka Labour Bureau page say 事業の正常な運営 (I opened the linked page: it reads 「事業の正常な運営を妨げるような場合」). Minor misquote.
Gives no month shortfall for the 10-year actual requirement (24 months). The cumulative gap is given only as "还差12年".

"国家医保局的口径也是：断缴3个月以内补缴，才不设等待期、可追溯待遇": presented as a general national rule. Per the key, 43号文 Art. 11 covers only cross-region transfers or switching between employee and resident schemes with a gap of 3 months or less. The conclusion that it does not apply to her is still right.
"Submit by early November. Processing can take several weeks" is unverifiable. Timing varies by plan.
"If you transfer more than the eligible amount, the excess is a nonqualified withdrawal": incomplete, because it leaves out the 6% excise on the Roth side. Not wrong as far as it goes.
“10월 5일부터는 연 20% 지연이자”: 정확한 기산일이 확정되지 않았고 법정 적용 제외 사유도 있다.
"December slots fill fast" is an unverified generalization about appointment availability.

The question about whether the plan will 'carve out' benefits for Medicare-eligible employees who aren't enrolled suggests a 20+ employer may do this to active employees, but Medicare Secondary Payer rules generally forbid it (judged from my own knowledge; harmless as a question).

The email argues 7 years / 耐用年数6年 as a reason the charge is 0円. For sunburn the key says there is no liability to begin with, so depreciation is moot. A frames it as 「仮に借主負担が生じる場合でも」, so this is a minor framing issue, not a concession.
残存価値の式「取得価額×(1−経過年数÷耐用年数)」に1円の下限がなく、7年では負の値になる点に触れていない。軽微。
「クリーニング・ホワイトニング」を対象外とし、No.1128 のリンクを併記している。クリーニングが No.1128 に明記されているかは確認できず、出典の示し方が不確か。
「事前に承認された休暇」として扱われているか確認 uses 承認 wording that could suggest approval is required; the key says approval is not a condition for taking annual leave. This is minor.
Gives portal paths (浙里办 → 浙里医保 → 我要参保 → 职工参保登记; 浙江税务社保缴费) and a window document list (身份证, 居住证或户口本, 就业登记材料, 补缴申请表). Also says 补缴超过1个月通常要去窗口. None of this is checkable from the packet.
'If you contributed in 2021–2026, that money isn't eligible' wrongly excludes all 2021 contributions; eligibility depends on the actual contribution and transfer dates.
「差額ベッド代、健康診断など」は対象外：一般的な税務知識では、治療上必要な差額ベッド代や、重大な疾病の発見から継続治療につながった健康診断には例外がある。
"확정일자는 주민센터에서 무료" is wrong. The key gives a 600 won fee for a walk-in 확정일자.
“Part D within 63 days” incorrectly substitutes the penalty threshold for the enrollment deadline of two full months after coverage ends.
“확정일자가 없으면 일반 채권자로 밀려” overgeneralizes: an enforceable tenancy can still protect the tenant against a purchaser; lacking priority distribution does not erase that protection.

"If the annual limit rises with inflation, this compresses to four or five years": four years would need about $9,167 a year for 2027-2029, which $500-step indexing will not plausibly reach (even $8,000 a year still takes five). Overstated.
断言14号文“已于2026年8月15日到期失效”：标准答案仅将其失效列为推定，未见官方明确表态。
Fengtai court case said to hold that an expired approval returns to standard hours (批准期限届满没续的，也自动回到标准工时): link given but not opened, so unverifiable.
Part B would provide “very little” benefit: unsupported without examining the employer plan and the person's needs.
Gives no backdating warning for Part A and HSA; 'stop HSA contributions first' leaves out that contributions must stop 6 months before applying. Incomplete, risks a tax error.
"지연이자는 민사청구로 받는 경우가 많습니다": practice claim, unsourced. Plausible.
Note: I opened 157号 Art 4/8/15, the Fengtai court report (gmw 2026-05-07) and the Sina/ACFTU 2026 explainer. All support what B attributes to them.
“남은 수급기간의 절반을 조기재취업수당”: 신고 후 14일 경과, 소정급여일수 절반 이상 잔여, 재취업 후 12개월 고용 요건을 빠뜨렸습니다.

"基数要先按正常工资的70%计算，所以按旧口径是 8000×70%×80%=4480元，并非6400元": wrong. The 70% base applied only when neither the employment contract nor a collective contract set a monthly wage (old Shanghai wage-payment rules, Art. 9). With a contract wage of 8000, the old 83号 tier gives 8000×80%=6400, as the key says
'생활법령정보(2026. 9. 15. 기준)' and the other cited links (law.go.kr, easylaw.go.kr, ulsannamgu.go.kr) are checkable, but I did not open them, so the dated-source statement is unverified.
据上述70%折扣提出“按旧口径补3680元”：算术正确，但适用依据错误。
'(some do; most don't)' on plans requiring Medicare at 65: an unsourced generalization, though plausible.

I opened the gov.cn 2026 holiday notice, the sina piece, the gmw Fengtai court report and the 157号 page; all match what A says about them (157号 art. 8 wording, Oct 1-3 at 300%, Oct 4-7 rest days, approval missing means standard hours).
"you usually have until March-April to submit receipts": a typical run-out range, unverified
“报销比例只看医院等级和费用段”：排他性表述未经包内材料证实。
“자발적 퇴사로 보지 않고”: 정당한 사유가 있는 자발적 퇴사도 수급할 수 있다는 예외를 퇴사 유형 자체가 달라지는 것으로 설명했습니다.
「付与日数は…給与明細で確認できます」: unverifiable. Payslips are not required to show leave balances, and the answer leaves out the concrete figure (5日) the key gives.

「子どもの学校行事そのものを保障する法律はありません」 is overbroad. Based on my legal knowledge, statutory child nursing leave also covers specified school events, including entrance and graduation ceremonies, subject to eligibility.
所得税は「ほぼ0円（還付なし）」と断定している。源泉徴収票の「源泉徴収税額」欄を確認するよう促しておらず、キーの減点項目（源泉徴収税額0に触れずに還付なしと断定）に当たる。
1350 링크(id=1000294810)를 근거로 인용했으나 열어 확인하지 못했다. 링크 내용이 본문 주장과 맞는지는 확인되지 않는다.
Cites 山东高院〔2018〕鲁民再154号 as a duty (值班) case with a 'approval is only a managerial rule' reasoning, with no link. Unverifiable.

Headline offers 4480 yuan (8000 x 70% x 80%) as the figure under an old Shanghai approach. The key gives 6400 for the 83号 tiers, and under 10号 the base is the contract wage, so 4480 is unverifiable and probably does not apply to someone with an agreed 8000 salary.

Lists '$7,500 minus any 2026 IRA contributions' as a separate term in a smallest-of list. For $4,000 earned and $2,000 contributed this gives $4,000. The correct figure is min(7,500, 4,000) - 2,000 = $2,000.
Says 歯列矯正・ホワイトニングなど美容目的は原則対象外; roughly consistent with the key (通達73-4), the wording could be read as excluding all 歯列矯正
Like A, it says 7~9월 "요건을 넘길 가능성이 높습니다" without any day-count test.
「賃貸の原状回復は相談実績が非常に多い分野」 adds an unsupported claim about consultation volume.
$1,240 forfeited: wrong for 2026. The correct figure is $1,900 - $680 = $1,220.
“퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원”: contradicts the key’s estimated 94,000–141,000 won and incorrectly implies withholding upon IRP transfer.

「有給の話はこのLINEでぶつけず、休みが決まった後に改めて確認する」: the worker designates paid leave in advance (時季指定), and turning an approved unpaid day into paid leave afterwards is not guaranteed, so this advice can cost the worker the paid day.
医療費控除は「5年遡れる」: 過去分の還付申告としては正しい。ただし2026年分の還付申告を2027年1月1日から5年間できることは述べていない。
"3~5일 안에 회신이 없으면 ... 진정": arbitrary timeline with no source.
「壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」(管理会社宛メール案にも同旨): ガイドラインでは借主の故意・過失による損傷は借主負担(部分・減価考慮)。言い過ぎで、相手に反論されやすい。
"짐을 다 들이지 않아도, 열쇠를 받아 쓸 수 있으면 '인도'는 됩니다" — stated flatly with no source; roughly right but legally simplified (unverifiable here).
Cites a 대법원 PDF (file.scourt.go.kr/dcboard/1529376352496_114552.pdf) for the next-day-0시 rule. I could not read its text, so this is unverifiable
“多数情况下拿不到这么多”：没有提供支持这一频率判断的证据。
Cites a Federal Register URL (FR-2025-11-19, 2025-20251) for the 2026 premium. The $202.90 figure matches the key, but the document number is unverifiable.
“미가입이면 고용센터에 피보험자격 확인을 신청”: 해당 신청기관 안내는 패킷에서 확인되지 않아 검증되지 않은 절차로 남는다.
Initially implies the 20-employee threshold enables the SEP; employer size determines payment priority, not SEP eligibility.
“생계비 융자까지 받으면 석 달은 확보됩니다” guarantees a living-cost runway without knowing eligibility, approval, expenses, or payment timing.
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」: 給与明細に付与日数が載るかは職場次第で、根拠のない言い切り。実際の日数（5日）は示していない
HSA warning omits the up-to-6-month Part A backdating, so 'stop HSA contributions first' gives no lead time.
“Your 2004 account passes the 15-year test” assumes beneficiary continuity that the request does not establish.
Unconditionally recommends CMS-40B at retirement, although that route requires existing Part A enrollment.
“你离退休还远”：请求未提供年龄或退休时间。
"At most $660 of your $1,900 survives on its own" ignores the grace-period branch, where the full balance survives until the grace end date.
"미지급 시 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated; since 2026.9.18 it is 5년 이하 징역 또는 5천만 원 이하 벌금 (제43조) (minor per key)
「内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: that provision does not itself impose the claimed itemization requirement.
The LINE states 「10月1日から有給休暇が付与されています」 as fact, but the grant depends on 8割 attendance. Slight overstatement inside the message itself (minor).
Quotes the employer's right as limited to 「業務の正常な運営を妨げる場合」; the statute (and the Shizuoka Labour Bureau page A itself links, which I opened) says 「事業の正常な運営」. Minor misquote.
The HUG conditions are sourced to a third-party site (property.ambitstock.com), and the "2026. 10. 기준" label is unverifiable. The conditions themselves match the key.
Treats 沪劳保发〔2000〕14号 as part of the 按连续工龄分档 rules and writes the number as 沪劳保发. The key says it is 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号, the Shanghai minimum standard, not a tier table.

Says non-통상임금 items or a different 입사일 would change the amount only 조금. If the pay is partly non-통상임금, the figure could fall to about 1,024만 원, so this understates the range, though 10,242,000 is shown as the no-floor figure.
“HUG 가입 조건(2026. 10. 기준)”이라는 최신성 표시는 패킷으로 확인되지 않습니다. 연결한 자료도 HUG 공식 출처가 아닌 제3자 사이트입니다.
“전입신고만 하면 생기는 권리는 대항력”: 실제 인도도 필요함. 뒤에서 실거주를 언급하지만 첫 설명은 부정확함.

Never mentions the 6% Roth excise tax on an excess contribution. Never explains the 529-side tax on the non-qualifying part of a full $48,000 move. Only a check payout is described as non-qualified. 'Tax mess' is left vague.
“대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면” omits the early-reemployment allowance requirements of reemployment after 14 days from reporting and at least half the benefit days remaining.
"Usually ~90 days" adds an unverified typical run-out deadline; the actual deadline is plan-specific.
‘2년 근무면 150일분’ ignores the 180-day entitlement for people aged 50 or older or with disabilities.
“퇴직소득세가 원천징수되어 실수령액은 조금 줄어듭니다”: IRP 이전 시 지급 단계에서는 원천징수하지 않는다.

"如果 800 元是扣完个人社保、公积金后的实发金额……公司可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额": takes the minority reading (2192 as gross) and does not say it is disputed; the key's majority view is that take-home pay must not fall below 2192, so this would still be illegal
Ties the no-penalty delay to the plan being 'well above the 20-employee threshold': imprecise. Employer size decides which plan pays first, not whether the SEP exists (minor).
Says holiday work hours are not counted in the comprehensive-cycle total hours; stated as a firm rule with no source, and 157号 article 8 does not say this.
「10万円の足切りは所得200万円以上の人に適用される」 says 所得 where the legal test is 総所得金額等. This is slightly loose, but it is not wrong in substance.
“Coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form” incorrectly ties coverage commencement to processing rather than the applicable enrollment and effective-date rules.
"Most [plans] do by 2026, but not all" adds an unverified claim about adoption across plans.
“전입세대 열람 … 선순위 세입자도 볼 수 있습니다”는 과도한 설명입니다. 제 지식에 따르면 등록된 세대 확인만으로 임차인의 법적 우선순위나 보증금을 확정할 수 없습니다.
“多数情况下拿不到这么多”：没有计算周期工时或统计依据，无法支持这一判断。
States 沪劳保发〔2000〕14号 '已于 2026 年 8 月 15 日到期失效' as settled fact; the key says its lapse is only presumed, with no explicit official statement
"confirm the office will charge before the 15th": implies the charge date matters, when expenses count on the date of service (minor imprecision)
'沪人社规〔2026〕10号第九条只规定病假工资的计算基数' understates the article: per the key it also requires the employer to pay sick-leave wages as provided (minor).
“北京丰台法院2026年的案例解读”: the 2026 date and case details were not checked, unverifiable.

"연 20%의 지연이자(같은 법 제17조 제3항 ...)": the 퇴직급여법 Art. 17(3) citation looks misattributed. Delay interest on severance rests on 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조, which A also cites. Judged from my own knowledge; the law.go.kr fetch returned no article text.
“회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우”: 회사의 퇴직연금제도와 개인 IRP를 혼동한다. IRP 이전 의무는 퇴직금제도에도 적용된다.
“$1,900 becomes $0 on January 1” overlooks eligible prior-year expenses claimed during the run-out period.
Says 大病保险等可能另计几十元 on top of the payment. The key says these charges come out of the personal-account money credited by the back payment, with no separate cash.
「タクシーは緊急時のみ」は狭すぎる。キーの条件は公共交通機関が使えない場合。

Ties the no-penalty delay to the 20-employee threshold ("well over Medicare's 20-employee threshold... it lets you delay Part B with no penalty"); the SEP does not depend on employer size. Imprecise, minor here per the key.
“累计年限少7个月，对20年门槛几乎没影响”：影响取决于退休时是否达到规定年限，不能直接断定。
“纯粹为了退休，不用补”“3,300元花得不太值”：too categorical without knowing the user's retirement date or future contribution history.
「サインは『内容を確認した』以上の意味を持ちません」: 署名した契約書には拘束力があり、言い過ぎ。特約が明記されていれば別になりうる。
"순서는 체불임금 회수 → 수급자격 신청" and "체불임금·퇴직금 회수를 최우선으로" put the benefit application second. The key says to apply right away, because the 12-month period is running.
'부동산 말은 절반만 맞습니다': 중개사의 주장을 일부 인정하는 표현이지만, 바로 이어서 확정일자 없는 위험을 바로잡음
Gives “March 15, 2026” as the grace deadline; the applicable maximum is March 15, 2027, and plans may provide a shorter period.
States that 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 expired on 2026-08-15 as fact; the key says this is inferred and there is no explicit official statement.
“2년 근무면 150일분” omits the 180-day entitlement for people aged 50 or older or with disabilities.

'to count for 2026 the money needs to land in the Roth by December 31, 2026 — don't rely on the April 2027 filing deadline' treats December as the legal deadline. Per the 2026 Form 5498 instructions and 219(f)(3), a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027.
"CMS-L564 form (your employer fills it out)": incomplete allocation; the applicant completes Section A and the employer Section B.
“고용노동부와 법제처도 … 해석합니다” gives no checkable link or document number supporting this specific attribution.
Says the coworker would be right for an employer under 20 employees: employer size changes payment priority, not SEP eligibility.
"Medicare.gov's sign-up tool asks exactly the 20-employee question" is a claim about a checked source; it is unverifiable beyond the links given
“一般也不能免除上面那2个月等待期”：所给材料未核实这种补缴对等待期的影响。
「口頭でも…一言添えると通りやすい」：この職場での効果を裏付ける情報はない。
「満額12万円にはなりません」：減価だけで請求総額の上限は断定できない。有効な特約や工事費等の確認が必要。

"the carryover only happens if you're still employed and still enrolled in the FSA in the new plan year": the job-loss part is right, but "still enrolled" is stated as fact when it is plan-dependent and unverified
「有給か欠勤かを決めつけず」と書き、既定の文面を有給の請求にしていない。キーの求める日付を示した年休の請求ではなく、通常の休み願い（穴埋めの申し出つき）になっている。
Step 6, 'Finish by December 31, 2026 so it counts against the 2026 limit', presents December 31 as the cutoff. The key allows designation through April 15, 2027, though plans vary. Minor error.

"Complete the transfer by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 limit" presents December 31 as the legal deadline. A rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027, subject to plan processing (minor).
Says retirement 医保 is enjoyed "终身" once 20 years and 10 local years are met, omitting the 办法第八条 requirement to keep contributing in Hangzhou until retirement.
“미리 만들어두면 지급이 빨라집니다”: an unsupported assurance that opening an IRP account will accelerate payment.
“北京各区……要求提交……公示情况、民主程序材料”：仅列西城区指南，不能据此证实所有区均有这些具体材料要求。
“전입세대 열람으로 선순위 임차인도 확인 가능” overstates what that record establishes; it alone does not establish tenants’ payment priority.
Treats 没审批 as established fact. It never suggests checking whether the company holds an approval covering the dispatcher role, which the key's next step asks for.

"The transfer must be completed by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 annual limit ... if you miss it, it becomes a 2027 rollover": December treated as the legal deadline. Per the key, a 2026-designated rollover is allowed through April 15, 2027 (minor error).
'大病保险等可能另计几十元' contradicts the key: the individual's 大病/长护 premiums are deducted from the re-credited personal account funds, not paid as extra cash
"The money needs to land ... by December 31, 2026" is wrong as a federal deadline; April 15, 2027 is available for a 2026 designation, subject to provider processing.
Cites TKC and 財務省 pages for the 104万円 basic deduction (62万円 base plus 42万円 special); I did not open these and the figures match the key, so the links are unverifiable by me
“Exception ... employer with 20+ employees” incorrectly makes employer size a condition of the penalty-free SEP.
Two reference links (eiac.ei.go.kr page and a Gangnam-gu welfare page for the loan) are not checked and are unverifiable. A district welfare page is an odd source for the national loan terms.
"at most $660 of 2025 funds can move into 2026": wrong plan year. The plan year ending Dec 31 is 2026, so the cap is $680 carried into 2027.

"Subtract that too" after taking the minimum of all limits can understate eligibility: with ample wages, $3,000 eligible funds and $2,000 other IRA contributions, the maximum is min($5,500, $3,000) = $3,000, not $1,000.
「付与日や日数は就業規則にも書いてある」: The workplace’s actual rules were not provided, so their specific contents are unverified.
「雇い入れから6か月たつと法律上の有給休暇が付きます」: overstated, because it leaves out the second requirement (80% attendance) under 第39条第1項
“最多再拿2482.76元”“合计最多6206.90元”：擅自假定4天共32小时，并据此限定综合周期加班费；现有信息不能确定上限。
公司不提供考勤“则承担不利后果”遗漏劳动者先证明加班事实及相关证据由公司掌握的举证条件。
「国民生活センターの相談事例」としてkokusen.go.jp/hanrei/data/200406.html（NDLアーカイブ）を挙げている。hanreiは判例欄で、「相談事例」というラベルと内容の一致は確認できず検証不能。
"계약 후 잔금 사이에 근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다" — "흔합니다" is unsupported (unverifiable).
「貸主様側で負担が確定した分を除き」 wrongly permits deducting the landlord's own liabilities from the tenant's deposit.
"Some plans take two to four weeks" is an unverifiable processing time. The key says it varies by plan.
Says “公司有两处说错了” but then lists three numbered items. This is a presentation slip, not a legal error.
Carryover requires being “still enrolled in the FSA in the new plan year”: presented as universal, although enrollment requirements depend on the plan.
「付与日や日数は就業規則にも書いてあるので」: 休暇 is a required item in 就業規則 (Art. 89), but the answer cannot know that this store's rules spell out the grant date and number of days. Unverifiable, minor.
「e-Taxなら30分ほど」: 根拠なしで検証できない
「早めに出す。直前だと時季変更権の余地が広がります」は根拠が示されていない（法律上の申請期限はない）

"Enroll in Part D or a Medicare Advantage plan within 63 days if your drug coverage isn't creditable": muddled. The Part D SEP is 2 full months after employer coverage ends, and 63 days is the penalty gap.
"Medigap guaranteed-issue window": wrong term. This is the Medigap open enrollment period, which is separate from guaranteed-issue rights (minor).
实发800元、应发约2192元时断言“公司是按最低线在发，能主张的差额会少很多”，未充分说明多数口径要求最低标准不含个人缴费，差额不能据此确定。
“实际发放高于约定的，按实发”被写成普遍规则；答案键给出的北京规则优先采用合同约定工资，不能无条件以较高实发金额替代。
'보증금을 올려 재계약하면 확정일자를 다시 받아야': roughly right in general (the increased portion), but stated without the increase-only qualifier and not covered by the key.
退休差额公式只检查累计240个月，遗漏杭州实际120个月的独立要求和可能存在的视同缴费年限，不能作为通用计算公式。
"신청 기한: 이직일 다음날부터 12개월 안에 수급자격 신청": presents the benefit period as an application deadline. Late application loses benefit days, and nothing in the answer pushes the person to apply right away.
Section 5 on IRP omits the 300만 원 and under-55 conditions.
「合わせて2,500円程度」：所得税の還付を断定。社会保険料控除や源泉徴収税額によって還付は0円になる。

The table labels $680 carried over as the 'best case' and $1,220 forfeited as the 'realistic math' before the grace period is mentioned. Under a grace-period plan nothing need be lost, so this understates that branch (framing, minor).

Table row '合同沿用旧"本人工资=实得工资 70%"口径 8000×70%×80% = 4480 元': the old 70% base applied only when nothing was agreed, and it was 70% of 正常出勤月工资, not 实得工资. The key's base is the agreed post wage, so this is unsupported for an agreed 8000 salary.
“浙里办—浙里医保”查询路径及先停灵活就业再衔接单位的具体办理步骤：给定材料无法核实。
"고용노동부(1350)나 관할 지청에 ... 진정을 넣을 수": 1350 is a counseling line, not a place to file a petition. Minor imprecision

Step 2 tells the person to budget "roughly $1,240+" for the carryover-only case. That uses the $660 cap, and the 2026 figure is $680, so it should be about $1,220. Minor, and A also states $1,220-$1,240.
“4주마다 실업인정을 받습니다”: 패킷의 4주분 금액 예시는 인정주기가 항상 4주라는 근거가 되지 않는다.
Special-clause requirements given as「内容が具体的で明確なこと、借主の認識、真意に基づくこと」: this drops the guideline's 必要性・合理性 requirement. A loose paraphrase, not a direct source.
称新办法第九条“只规定了病假工资的计算基数”：表述不准确，该条也明确要求企业支付假期工资。
Says 2027年1〜3月 for filing without stating the 5-year window for 2026年分 (key point 7 only vaguely covered)
Cites the Shanghai file as 沪劳保发〔2000〕14号; the key gives 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号. It also lists 14号 among the 按连续工龄分档 rules, whereas the key treats it as Shanghai's minimum standard. Minor citation error.

劳部发〔1997〕271号「第四条」(holiday 300%, no comp leave) and「第五条」(cycle 150%, holidays per Art 44(3)): the content is real, but the article numbers look shifted by one; to my knowledge these are items 3 and 4 of that reply letter
"계약서 명의자 본인이" for the 전입신고 is a loosely stated condition. Proxy or household-head rules are not mentioned.
「『10万円以下だから申告しない』と決めると、この1万7,000円を損します」は、実際に得をするのは住民税約1,700円だけで所得税の還付は0円と見込まれるため、言い過ぎ。直後の文で修正している。
The medical-period remark ("1个月病假在医疗期内，公司不能仅以病假为由解除劳动合同") is directionally right but gives no N+2 figure or statutory basis.
“省内换工作不用转移”: other Zhejiang cities are outside the key; unverifiable.
「民法621条ただし書き」が通常損耗を除外するという引用位置は誤り。通常損耗の除外は本文の括弧書き。
Cites a Proskauer link for "2025/2026 FSA limits"; not opened here, so unverified.

For the approved-hours case B gives a specific 150% amount, '最多约 2482.76元（32小时 × 51.72 × 150%）', and a total of '3724.14—6206.90元'. The key says this cannot be calculated from the facts given; B also assumes 8-hour days and treats the 4 days as the whole overage for the cycle
“仲裁……时效1年”遗漏在职追讨欠薪的例外，会误导本案用户。
“第九条只规定……计算基数”不准确；该条也明确要求企业按规定支付病假期间的假期工资。
“买房、落户、车牌摇号……会受断缴影响”：未提供适用于杭州这些事项的具体条件或依据，不能一概确定。
The draft email reads 「貸主様側で負担が確定した分を除き」. The party is wrong (it should be the tenant's 借主 share), so the wording the user would send is confusing.
"계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다" — a claim about how often this happens, with no source given; unverifiable.
'按旧口径补3680元' rests on the wrong 4480 figure (the arithmetic 4480−800 = 3680 is right, but the premise is not).
“이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)”은 정답 기준의 2026-10-23과 다릅니다.
“고용노동부 실무는 통상임금을 적용하는 쪽입니다”: 통상임금 하한 자체는 키와 일치하지만, 별도의 실무 관행 주장은 제공된 자료만으로 확인되지 않는다.
「基礎控除104万円（合計所得132万円以下）」：キーの適用範囲は合計所得489万円以下。
"另加大病、长护险几十元": implies extra cash on top of 3,316. Per the key, the individual's major-illness and long-term-care premiums are deducted from the re-credited personal account, not paid separately.
'Most [plans] do [support it] by 2026, but not all' gives no source and can't be checked.

“같은 법 제17조” as the basis for delayed severance interest is misplaced; the key identifies Labor Standards Act Article 37 and Enforcement Decree Article 17. The unconditional wording also omits statutory exclusions.
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」: a generalization with no support.
Says the 10号 办法 "没有规定满4年按80%这类工龄系数" without quoting 第九条. The no-tiering point is consistent with the key, but the article is not cited.
"정확한 재직일수에 따라 1,020만~1,030만 원 사이": understated range. It ignores the 통상임금 floor (근로기준법 제2조제2항), which can raise the amount to about 1,202만 원
「申告しなくても罰則はありません」は申告義務がない条件を満たす場合に限る。依頼文だけでは条件を確認できない。
“확정일자가 없으면 일반 채권자로 밀려” overstates the consequence: lack of preferential distribution does not eliminate protection through opposability.
「戻る税金は所得税が約850円」: states the income tax refund as a fact. It never says the refund is 0 if the 源泉徴収税額 is 0, which is the likely case here (key: No.2030).
'以上是按现行文件和裁审口径的分析' claims arbitration/court practice with no case or document cited; unverifiable.
「社会保険料控除で課税所得が消える」：本人の社会保険料額は不明。2万円以上という条件と源泉徴収税額の確認が必要。
"CMS-L564, completed by your employer": partly wrong. The enrollee fills in Section A and the employer fills in Section B.
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 … 제44조”: outdated; the key specifies Article 43 and five years/50 million won from September 18, 2026.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(같은 법 제44조 제1호)" is the old rule. From 2026-09-18 the penalty is 5 years or 50M won under Art. 43 (minor, per key).
'Medicare.gov's sign-up tool asks exactly the 20-employee question': claim about a tool's behavior, unverifiable from the packet.
"The 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary" presents an unresolved issue as settled.
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」「出せない請求は、根拠も怪しいことが多いです」: 根拠のない一般化で検証不能。
“식대·차량보조 등 통상임금이 아닌 항목”: categorically excludes allowances whose ordinary-wage status cannot be determined from the packet.
'약 1,020만 원 ... 1,020만~1,030만 원 사이' is a narrow range with no 통상임금 floor; the key's range runs up to about 12.02 million won, so this is understated and overconfident.
"按旧口径补3680元" (4480 - 800) rests on the unsupported 4480 figure.
“퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원” contradicts the key’s estimated 94,000–141,000 won and incorrectly implies withholding upon IRP transfer.
"Form 1099-Q to you as account owner" is wrong for this direct rollover: the beneficiary is the recipient under the opened [IRS Form 1099-Q instructions](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1099q.pdf).
“14일째는 10월 4일”: 퇴직일 해석과 휴일 계산을 확인하지 않고 날짜를 확정했다.
“임금체불확인서(회사 발급)” introduces an unverified company-issued document requirement.

'7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고' is an overclaim: the test is total delayed or unpaid days (60 or more), not the number of months, so a few days late each month may fall short. Partly offset by asking at the end whether any pay was received.
"如果这7天每天超过8小时，超过部分另按150%主张": wrong for these days. Hours past 8 on a statutory holiday or rest day are still holiday or rest-day work (300%/200% under Labor Law art. 44), not ordinary 150% overtime
"(선택) 전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만 비용 발생" — does not say it needs the landlord's cooperation (민법 제621조), and offers it as a casual option.
“Which can restart the clock” presents beneficiary-change consequences too definitively; whether the 15-year clock restarts is unresolved.
"最好在11月新单位增员前" do the back-payment: unverifiable timing advice, the key gives only the 2026-12-31 deadline
"3개월 총일수 약 89~92일"과 "1,020만~1,060만 원": 질문에 월이 없어 범위로 쓴 것이다. 92일 기준 정확값(10,241,990원)보다 상단이 부풀려졌고, 문자에는 평균임금 하한 값인 "1,040만 원 안팎"만 쓴다.
'沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号已于2026年8月15日到期失效' stated as certain; the key says 14号's lapse is only presumed and nothing official confirms it
「ガイドラインでは、壁紙…の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」：日焼け等の通常損耗についての整理を張替え全般へ広げている。出典への確認可能なリンク・文書番号もない。
"If you change jobs, the whole balance — carryover included — is gone": leaves out the COBRA exception (minor).

Says that if gross pay is about 2192 and take-home is 800, '能主张的差额会少很多': adopts the minority view that 2192 is gross; it does flag '口径不完全一致' but never states the majority view that take-home should not fall below 2192.
'Coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form' incorrectly makes processing date the coverage-start trigger.
"He is 22" is not established; someone born in 2004 could still be 21 at the request date.
"임금체불확인서(회사 발급)" is unverifiable and probably wrong. That confirmation is normally issued by the labor office, and the employer who withheld the pay would not issue it.
“석 달치 임금과 퇴직금(2년 근무면 발생)”: 석 달치 임금이 아직 미지급이라는 사실은 없으며, 퇴직금에는 주 15시간 이상 등 요건도 있다.
Treats 800 as a gross figure ('公司只发800元，至少少发1392元') and never raises whether it is gross or net. A user whose 800 is net pay gets no guidance.
“2년 근무라 퇴직금 대상” assumes the weekly working-hours condition is satisfied.
'以上是按现行文件和裁审口径的分析' claims to follow adjudication practice without citing any ruling or source (unverifiable)
住まいるダイヤル 0570-016-100: パケットに根拠がなく検証不可（採点者の知識ではこの番号は正しい）
“계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다” asserts an unsupported frequency.

“连续缴费年限：断缴超过3个月，重新参保时要重新计算”: presented as a general employee-insurance rule; the key places “连续参保年数重新计算” in resident insurance and treats only the waiting period and the 6-month maternity rule as real for Hangzhou employees, so this is overgeneralized
「説明されていた場合に限り有効」 overlooks the alternative of sufficiently specific written terms recognized in the key.
国税庁(keisan)・TKC・財務省のURLは根拠として挙げているが、内容は確認できない(未検証)。
"If you contributed in 2021–2026, that money isn't eligible": too broad. For a late-2026 transfer, contributions from early 2021 are more than 5 years old and qualify.

Gives about 10.2 million won ('약 1,020만 원', range 1,020만~1,030만) with no ordinary-wage floor (통상임금 하한). If the 3.3 million won is all ordinary wage, the real figure is about 12.02 million, so this understates by roughly 1.8 million won.
「店側が変更できるのは本当に忙しくて回らないときだけ」: a loose paraphrase of 事業の正常な運営を妨げる場合. It is close enough, but the word 忙しくて could suggest that busyness alone is enough (minor).

"如果…近期可能看病、生育：建议补": misleading. Medical costs in the back-paid months are not reimbursed, and B itself says the waiting period probably still applies, so back-paying does not help with near-term medical use.
"Limits may rise with inflation, which would shorten the schedule" is unsupported as a reduction in tax years; even $8,000 × 4 = $32,000 still requires a fifth year.
“个别法院会结合岗位特点、劳动强度酌定，不是机械按200%判”未说明适用条件或给出支持这一额外概括的具体依据。
「2017年改正で明文化」: true as the year of enactment, but it omits the 2020-04-01 effective date and the old-law note that the key's point 1 asks for.
'도장(서명)' listed as a required item: a seal is not generally required for 확정일자; minor
“对20年门槛几乎没影响”“这两个条件都还不急”：是否紧迫取决于退休时间和其他缴费年限，不能据已缴8年确定。

"the exception for active employees at a 20+ employee employer": imprecise. The SEP does not depend on employer size; the 20-employee line only decides which plan pays first (key treats this as minor).
「対象外…差額ベッド代、健康診断」：一律の除外は不正確。一般的な税務知識では、治療上必要な差額ベッド代や、重大な疾病が見つかり引き続き治療した場合の健診費用には例外がある。

'call Social Security at 1-800-772-1213 and ask about withdrawing it before it takes effect': the number is SSA's national line, but the withdrawal route is unverified and not covered by the key. Plausible.
"you usually have until March–April to submit receipts": a run-out window that varies by plan. It is hedged, so this is minor and unverifiable.
The Proskauer link is the only source given. I could not open it, so I judged the $660 (2025) and $680 (2026) figures from my own knowledge of the IRS limits, and they are right.

Applies the 6-year useful life and 「残存価値はほぼゼロ」 directly to the sunburn in the email, though the key says sunburn carries no tenant burden before any depreciation is considered. No 1-yen floor or formula given.
“Unused balance on December 31 is forfeited” and “evaporates on January 1”: timely run-out claims for eligible expenses still reduce the balance before forfeiture.
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금” and its Article 44 attribution are outdated; the key specifies Article 43, five years or 50 million won.
「少額訴訟（60万円以下）：…費用も数万円程度です」: overstated. For a claim of about 10万円 the filing fee is a few thousand yen (3,500 yen on paper under the current fees), not several tens of thousands.
Uses 63 days as the Part D enrollment window and extends it to Medicare Advantage; this confuses the drug-coverage penalty threshold with enrollment deadlines.
“If the money lands in January ... the 2026 room is lost” overlooks designation for 2026 through April 15, 2027, subject to plan processing.
Cited 本地宝 and 163 pages: unverifiable.
“0571-89583017”及报身份证号查询的具体流程：材料无法验证。
称新办法第九条“只规定病假工资的计算基数”：该条也明确规定企业应支付假期工资。
「過去の分も領収書があれば還付申告できます」：領収書だけでは申告方法や還付の可否は決まらず、既申告かどうか等の条件も必要。
Recommended order "체불임금 회수 → 수급자격 신청": putting wage recovery first, which can take months, delays the unemployment claim. The key penalizes delaying the claim.
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”: outdated; the key specifies five years/50 million won from September 18, 2026.
"회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우에는 지급 방식이 조금 다르지만": conflates 퇴직연금 enrolment with IRP. IRP transfer applies to 퇴직금제도 too, for amounts over 3 million won and under age 55.
"some do; most don't" (plans requiring Medicare at 65): unverifiable generalization, minor.
'If the annual limit rises with inflation, this compresses to four or five years' is doubtful. Limits move in $500 steps, and at $8,000 a year it still takes five years.
「有給を取ったことを理由に不利益に扱うことも、法律で禁じられています」は附則136条の趣旨に沿うが、条文は「しないようにしなければならない」で、やや強い言い方
"If your plan has neither, all $1,900 is gone December 31": omits that expenses incurred by Dec 31 still use it, so it reads as unconditional loss.
Terminating Part B with CMS-1763, with re-enrollment restricted and premiums not refunded: plausible and I believe the form is right, but not covered by the key.
"근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호": an unsourced rule-of-thumb figure.
A 529 check to the son is said to become "an excess Roth contribution (6% excise tax per year)": oversimplified. It is excess only if it exceeds his limit or compensation.
Says to check on the 源泉徴収票 that 給与所得控除74万円 and 基礎控除104万円 are reflected; a 源泉徴収票 does not itemise the basic deduction, and it never points to the 源泉徴収税額 column
“기다리기만 하면…묵시적으로 합의했다”: introduces an unverified legal risk from merely waiting.
“If you're not on Social Security, nothing is automatic” overlooks automatic enrollment through Railroad Retirement benefits (assessed from my own knowledge).
表の「社会保険料控除 約20〜40万円」: 依頼文にない仮定の数字で根拠なし。表では所得税0円と断定しており、確定するのは社保額が分かった場合という但し書きが末尾に回っている。
The Sources list (IRS newsroom, Savingforcollege, T. Rowe Price) gives links, so it is checkable. I did not open the Savingforcollege or T. Rowe Price pages.

Early re-employment allowance given as 대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면 남은 수급일수의 절반. It drops the condition that at least half of the prescribed days must remain, and it misstates the formula (remaining days x daily amount x 1/2).
山东高院〔2018〕鲁民再154号, described as a duty-shift case holding that the approval rule is only a management norm: unverifiable case citation

The late-2025 survey's "30 states" and detailed state classifications remain unverified here and do not establish 2026 treatment; current [Colorado guidance](https://tax.colorado.gov/income-tax-topics-collegeinvest-contribution-subtraction) explicitly treats these rollovers as nonqualifying.
称14号文已于2026年8月15日确定失效；答案键仅将其失效列为推定，未见官方明确表态。
Call SSA at 1-800-772-1213 and ask to withdraw the application before it takes effect: the number is right, but whether withdrawal is possible is stated flatly and is not checkable from the packet.
The 1350 link is cited as the basis; it is a checkable link, but I did not open it and cannot say how far it supports the text.

Links to IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and a Proskauer blog are given as sources; the Proskauer page was not opened here, so its content is unverified (the Rev. Proc. link is checkable and matches the key's $680 source).
文面の「どうしても参加しなければならない」「急なお願い」「代わりに出勤できる日を調整することもできます」：必要性、緊急性、代替出勤の可否は相談者から示されていない。

"회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우에는 지급 방식이 조금 다르지만": this confuses IRP with the company's DB/DC plan and implies the IRP transfer applies only to pension members. Under 제9조제2항, a payout over 300만 won to someone under 55 goes to an IRP under the severance-pay system too.
IRP를 '미리 만들어두면 지급이 빨라집니다'라는 결과는 확인되지 않았다.
Step 3 allows 정부24 for the 전입신고 with no note that the filing date for an after-hours online filing is unconfirmed.
「クリーニング」を一律に対象外としている。自身の知識では、歯周病などの治療として行うものは対象になり得る。

'회사가 사실상 도산했다면 근로복지공단 소액체당금도 확인' — the scheme has been called 간이대지급금 since 2021, and it does not require the company to be insolvent (that condition belongs to 도산대지급금). Outdated name and wrong condition.
The HR text says the 14 days run from '퇴사일 다음 날부터'. The statute counts from the day the payment ground arises, so the wording is imprecise.
"2년 근무면 150일분이 나오고" gives no age condition. It is 180 days for someone aged 50 or over or disabled, so the figure is unqualified.
将14号文也断言为“已于2026年8月15日到期失效”：答案键仅支持推定失效，未见官方明确表态。
"The transfer must be completed by December 31, 2026" is wrong: the federal deadline for a 2026-designated rollover is April 15, 2027, subject to plan processing.
“If you contributed in 2021–2026, that money isn't eligible” wrongly excludes all 2021 contributions; eligibility depends on the exact transfer and contribution dates.
‘조기재취업수당(남은 급여의 절반, 12개월 이상 근무 시)’ omits the required 14-day interval after reporting unemployment and at least half the benefit days remaining.
Says the Part B penalty applies to people without “creditable coverage”; this conflates Part D terminology with Part B's qualifying current-employment coverage rules.
Calls the exception "active employment-based group coverage from an employer with 20+ employees", which suggests the SEP needs 20+ employees. Imprecise, minor here per the key.
Adds '계약서·잔금 영수증 지참' for 전입신고 and 'HUG·SGI' as guarantee providers with no source; plausible but unverified
"six-month Medigap open enrollment window (in most states)": the 6-month Medigap open enrollment is a federal right, so the 'most states' hedge is imprecise. Minor; state rules were not checked.
“可能另扣大病保险等几十元”: misleading. The key says the 大病/长护 premiums come out of the re-credited personal-account funds and are not paid in extra cash; “另扣” reads as an extra charge.
IRP 예외를 단순히 '출국'이라고만 제시해 적용 대상을 확인할 수 없다.
“购房、落户等连续社保资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）”：将医保中断泛化为其他资格重置，答案键不支持，本次未外部核验。
"연 20%의 지연이자(같은 법 제17조 제3항, ...)": mis-citation. 퇴직급여법 제17조 covers DB pension benefits; the delay interest on 퇴직금 comes from 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조
'7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘게 충족': 기준은 늦은 달 수가 아니라 전액 지연·미지급 날수 합계 60일이라 과장(날수 확인 없음)
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(같은 법 제44조 제1호)": outdated. Since 2026-09-18 it is 제43조, 5년/5천만 원 (minor deduction per key)
"신청 기한: 이직일 다음날부터 12개월 안에 수급자격 신청": presents the benefit period as a filing deadline and does not say that late filing loses paid days.

"확정일자 — 주민센터나 인터넷등기소에서 계약서 원본으로. 전입신고와 같은 날": 인터넷등기소 is offered as an equal option with no warning that an application after 16시/18시 is dated the next working day. An online application uses a scanned copy, not the original.
"형사처벌(3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금)" is outdated. It has been 5 years or 50M won since 2026-09-18 (minor, per key).

"Do not have the 529 send him a check — that becomes ... an excess Roth contribution (6% excise tax per year)": overstated. A redeposited check is a nonqualified withdrawal plus a regular contribution, which is excess only if it goes over his limit.
Says that if 2,192 is gross and 800 is net, "能主张的差额会少很多". It does not state the majority view that the minimum excludes personal contributions, so net pay should still be at least 2,192.
两种计算方式相差约827.59元，差的只是那4天休息日按200%还是150%: misleading. Under an approved comprehensive-hours scheme, Oct 4-7 are normal working time, and 150% applies only to hours over the cycle total.
「有給を取ったことを理由に不利益に扱うことも、法律で禁じられています」: 根拠は附則第136条で、この条自体に罰則はなく、「しないようにしなければならない」という配慮的な規定。「禁じられている」はやや強め（軽微）
Applies the $660 carryover for 2025 funds to this 2026 scenario; the applicable maximum is $680, making the spend-down $1,220 rather than $1,240.

Table row '合同沿用旧"本人工资=实得工资 70%"口径 8000×70%×80% = 4480 元' is mislabeled and unsupported: the old 70% figure was a default base when nothing was agreed, not a contract term, and 10号第九条 sets the base as the contract wage (not below 2740), so 4480 has no clear basis
10月应发约 9,000 + 7,034.48 = 16,034.48元: arithmetic right, but it assumes the overtime pay lands in the same month's payroll, which is not established.
"설령 합의로 미뤘더라도 지연이자는 원칙적으로 그대로 붙어요(고용노동부 행정해석)": cites an unnamed administrative interpretation with no number or link, so it cannot be verified.

"risks forfeiting roughly $1,220–$1,240": the $1,240 end uses the $660 cap that applies to the 2025 plan year, not this 2026 year, so the range muddles the figure (should be $1,220 at the IRS maximum)
「山东高院〔2018〕鲁民再154号」said to hold that approval rules are only management rules and the agreement stays valid, in a duty-shift case: case number and holding unverifiable, no link given
Two Medicare.gov source links are cited and cannot be verified from the packet.
The LINE draft states 「10月1日から有給休暇が付与されています」 as fact, although the 80% attendance condition is unconfirmed. The main text already says the leave depends on it (minor).

Cites a KFF FAQ about a 65-year-old covered under a working spouse's plan, and an "ARPI" codex page on IRMAA. Neither can be checked from the packet, and the KFF page is a different scenario from the asker's.
'주민센터에서 전입세대 열람으로 선순위 임차인도 확인 가능': plausible, but it needs a contract or landlord consent and the answer does not say so; unverified
"长护险（45元/年）": the 45 yuan/year figure is not in the key; unverified. The 48 yuan/year 大病 figure matches the key.
“계약서 명의자 본인이”: incorrectly presents personal filing by the named tenant as mandatory; based on general procedural knowledge, eligible household members or proxies can also file.
“Re-enrolling later is more complicated than never enrolling”: an unsupported blanket procedural comparison.
“花3,300元买7个月年限，对你没有实际收益”: overstated. The 7 months count toward the 10-year and 20-year requirements and would avoid the retirement lump sum (743.60元/月, 5,205.20元 for 7 months) if she ends up short.
"정확한 재직일수에 따라 1,020만~1,030만 원 사이": presents a narrow range as the answer and leaves out the ordinary-wage floor, which can raise the amount to about 1,202만 원
"At most $660 of 2025 funds can move into 2026" uses the stale cap for the wrong year. For 2026 money moving into 2027 the cap is $680.
"coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form": imprecise. SEP coverage starts the month after sign-up (or a chosen later month), not after processing.
国税庁No.1119を「医療費控除の手続」として引用: 開いておらず、タイトルとの対応は未確認
「代わりに出られる日を添えるのが、実は一番効きます」：効果を最上位とする根拠がない。
'임금이 밀리거나 늦게 지급돼서 그만둔 경우는 자발적 퇴사로 보지 않고' - loose; it is still a voluntary separation, but with a 정당한 사유
Quotes a Changzhou HRSS reply ('300%和200%都是支付月工资之后另外支付'). The wording and the link cannot be checked.
“降薪、调岗或辞退……可主张2N”：降薪、调岗本身不等于违法解除；2N须以符合违法解除或终止的条件为前提。
"Form 1099-Q to you as account owner" is wrong for this direct transfer: the son is the reportable recipient. Checked [IRS Form 1099-Q instructions](https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i1099q).
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」：頻度を裏付ける証拠がない。

Scenario B gives a concrete 150% figure: 最多约2482.76元 (32h × 51.72 × 150%) and a total of 6206.90元. The key says this amount cannot be computed from the facts given. It is also not a real ceiling, because the excess is measured over the whole cycle's total hours.
“고용노동부(1350)나 관할 지청에 … 진정을”: 1350 상담과 진정 접수 경로를 혼동한다.
The 근거 line gives a law.go.kr link with a specific article ID that cannot be checked from the packet.
「費用対効果は十分あります」: asserts litigation is worthwhile without knowing the costs, evidence, or user's circumstances.
Cites secondary sources (LIMO, FP総合研究所, 日経) with links. Not checked; they support the stated figures but are not official sources
「通常の使用によって生じた損耗・経年変化は含まれないのが判例・通説」: since 2020-04-01 this rule is written into 民法621条. Calling it case law and academic consensus misses the codification.

"The transfer must be completed by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 annual limit ... if you miss it, it becomes a 2027 rollover": wrong as a legal rule, since a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027. Minor error.
'설령 합의로 미뤘더라도 지연이자는 원칙적으로 그대로 붙어요(고용노동부 행정해석)' gives no checkable document, so it is unverifiable, and it ignores the 시행령 제18조 exclusions.
"补缴...记入累计年限": the key says the supplement counts as 实际缴费年限. This is imprecise but not contradictory.
"Some do; most don't": the claim about how many employer plans require Medicare enrollment is unsupported.

'to count for 2026 the money needs to land in the Roth by December 31, 2026 - don't rely on the April 2027 filing deadline' and 'a January arrival may count against 2027'. This states December as the deadline and denies the April 15, 2027 designation, which is wrong. Per the key it is a minor error, and plan-level processing varies.
Uses “March 15, 2026” for the upcoming grace period; the maximum applicable date is March 15, 2027, and a plan may end it earlier.
“人社部办公厅的相关通知”及直接引文：未给出该通知名称、文号或直接链接，地方答复不能充分核实这段部级通知引文。
"퇴직금은 원칙적으로 IRP 계정으로 이전": leaves out the under-55 condition (minor).
Linked mlit.go.jp/common/001238428.pdf as the guideline: I opened it. It is an MLIT PDF whose metadata reads 'ガイドライン201801契約書', but I could not confirm its body text. Unverified, not shown wrong.
Says 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 已于2026年8月15日到期失效 as fact. The key treats this as inferred, with no explicit official statement.
“약 178만 원을 덜 받는 것”: 월급 구성과 근로시간이 확인되지 않아 해당 차액이 반드시 체불액이라고 단정할 수 없다.
文面の「学校行事」「急なお願い」「代わりに入れる日や引き継ぎがあれば対応します」：行事の種類、緊急性、対応可能性は相談者から示されていない。
「ガイドライン上も」: the source attribution supplies no checkable link or document number.
“两种计算方式相差约827.59元，差的只是……200%还是150%”：算术差值成立，但把4天全部视为周期超时没有依据，实际差额无法确定。
11月参保“是唯一有时限的事”：与本答案已说明的2026年12月31日补缴截止期限矛盾。
"지연이자까지 한 번에 청구되고" through a 노동청 진정: unverifiable and doubtful. Late-payment interest is not normally enforced through a 진정.
「いきなり『有給をください』と書くより…角が立ちにくい」「有給の話はこのLINEでぶつけず」は助言として、欠勤扱いで処理されるリスクを残す（誤りではないが回答の方針が不利）

"to count for 2026 the money needs to land in the Roth by December 31, 2026": treats December as the legal deadline, but a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027 (2026 Form 5498 instructions, 219(f)(3)). Minor error.
「賃貸の原状回復は相談実績が非常に多い分野」: this additional empirical claim is unsupported by the packet or a cited source.
긴급복지지원은 실직이 위기사유라 대상이 될 수 있다: 키에서 감점하지 않는 사례별 항목이다. 조건부로 썼다.
Omits the 443.75 yuan/month 延缴 option and the fact that retirement-time 补缴 does not go into the personal account.

"Finish by December 31, 2026 so it counts against the 2026 limit": treats December as the deadline and never mentions that a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027. This is a minor error under the key.
山东〔2018〕鲁民再154号的裁判理由及“值班”案情：包内未核实这些额外内容，本次未外查。
少額訴訟「費用も数万円程度です」 is wrong. The filing fee for a claim of about 100,000 yen is a few thousand yen, not tens of thousands.
The govinfo link labelled "2026 premium notice" gives a document number that was not opened; the $202.90 and $283 figures themselves match the key
"Scholarships ... do not" count as earned income: slightly imprecise. Under 219(f)(1), taxable graduate fellowship and stipend payments do count as IRA compensation. Minor.
「健康診断」は一律に対象外とは限らない。自身の知識では、重大な疾病の発見後に引き続き治療した場合などに例外がある。
'If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years' does not support the key's minimum-five-year planning conclusion; future limits are unannounced.
'설령 합의로 미뤘더라도 지연이자는 원칙적으로 그대로 붙어요(고용노동부 행정해석)' cites an administrative interpretation with no document number, so it is unverifiable.
"目前仅支持线下办理，带身份证或市民卡去区医保经办机构": unverifiable.
「家族の分も合算できます」：生計を一にし、申告者が支払った費用という条件を欠く。
The headline "세전 약 1,200만 원" and the text figure assume the whole 3.3 million won is ordinary wage; the answer does disclose the 10,242,000 won alternative and the caveat about non-ordinary items.
“7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 충족할 가능성이 높으니” infers likely eligibility from the number of late months without knowing the delayed days or unpaid amounts.
北京高院2024年解答（一）第56条（值班不支持加班费）：条号和内容无法核实。

「子の看護休暇は病気・けがの看護」 is outdated. Since the April 2025 revision, 子の看護等休暇 also covers entrance and graduation ceremonies and class closures. The conclusion that ordinary school events are not guaranteed still holds. Judged from my own knowledge, not checked online.
Includes 'not actively working' among disqualifying circumstances without preserving eligibility through a spouse's current employment.
Table shows 413.79 × 300% × 3 = 3724.14 and 413.79 × 200% × 4 = 3310.34. With the rounded daily wage these give 3724.11 and 3310.32. The cent-level inconsistency is tolerated by the key.
“现在补大约能省1,800—1,900元”：按2026年标准比较大致成立，但没有说明未来退休补缴标准每年调整。
Says 杭州报销比例不跟连续年限挂钩. Plausible but unverified.
“전입신고로 생기는 건 대항력” and “신고 다음 날 0시부터”: omit possession as a necessary condition, which the key explicitly requires.
Links to the Proskauer blog are unverified. The two cap figures it is cited for are right as labelled.

"If the money lands in January, it generally counts for 2027, and the 2026 room is lost" is wrong. A rollover designated for 2026 can go through April 15, 2027 (219(f)(3), 2026 Form 5498 instructions), though plan handling varies. It treats December 31 as a hard deadline.
“문자를 보내두는 것 자체가” 연장에 합의하지 않았다는 증거: 문자 발송 자체만으로 기존 합의 유무가 입증되지는 않는다.
"you usually have until March-April to submit receipts" is a typical run-out range given with no source. It is unverifiable and plan-specific.
如果这7天每天超过8小时，超过部分另按150%主张: likely wrong. Hours worked on a statutory holiday or an uncompensated rest day are generally paid at 300% or 200%, not 150%.
「事前に承認された休暇」として扱われているか確認、という言い方は法的な区分ではなく根拠のない言い回し（承認は年休の成立要件ではない）
“연 1.5%”: omits the temporary 1.0% rate applicable through October 31, 2026.
The four listed policy links are given as sources but cannot be confirmed from the answer alone.
구직촉진수당(월 50만원, 최대 6개월): 2026년 금액이 맞는지 확인하지 못했다. 키에서 감점하지 않는 항목이다. 구직급여와 동시 수령을 단정하지 않고 고용센터에서 자격을 확인하라고 열어 두었다.
"Enrolling [in Part A] now is often sensible" is an unsourced judgment, though it is qualified by the HSA caveat.
'Part D within 63 days' confuses the penalty threshold with the enrollment deadline of two full months after employer coverage ends.
实际发放高于合同约定的，按实际发放: unverifiable. The key says the base is the contractually agreed wage (北京工资支付规定第44条).
长护险“45元/年”: a figure the key does not give, so unverifiable
「e-Taxなら30分ほど」: an unverifiable time estimate, though a minor one.
'仲裁免费，时效1年' oversimplified: a wage-arrears claim made while still employed is not bound by the one-year limit (劳动争议调解仲裁法第27条); the limit runs from leaving the job.
"coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form" is loosely worded and not verified

Never addresses what happens to the excess if all $48,000 were moved in 2026: no 6% excise tax and no taxable earnings plus 10% on the non-qualifying part. The headline says 'tax mess' without the specifics.
「医療費控除を受けるには確定申告が必要」：住民税申告だけで住民税の控除を受ける方法を除外している。

Says Beijing uses 'normal labour earnings' as the overtime base and 'cannot use only basic salary'. The key says the base is the contract-agreed wage (not below minimum wage), so this is over-assertive and may contradict the key.
Says 现行文件也没有规定补缴可以免掉等待期. The key marks this as unverified, though the answer hedges and tells her not to rely on it.
第三方挂靠代缴“违法且容易被骗”：题包未核实这一概括性法律及风险断言。
"Part B ... covering little your plan doesn't already cover" and "mostly duplicates" depend on the plan and are asserted without evidence (minor).
"실무에서는 두 방식이 갈리므로 … 1,200만 원을 기준으로 협의": 통상임금 하한 적용이 해석상 확립됐다는 앞 문장과 어긋난다. 문자에 "세전 약 1,200만 원으로 산정"이라고 적은 것은 통상임금 구성 확인 전의 상단 값을 확정처럼 쓴 것이다.
「医療費控除を受けるには確定申告が必要」は断定が広すぎる。住民税申告だけで控除を受ける方法もある。
Describes the no-penalty exception as applying to coverage "from an employer with 20+ employees": imprecise, because employer size is not a condition of the SEP (it decides who pays first). Minor.

Cites '国家医保局口径：断缴3个月内补缴不设等待期、可追溯待遇' as a general national rule. The key says this comes from 医保办发〔2021〕43号第十一条 and covers only cross-region transfers or switches between 职工 and 居民 insurance. It is used only to say she is outside the window, so the verdict is still right.

"Subtract that too" after taking the minimum of all limits can understate eligibility: with $3,000 eligible funds, $7,500 compensation and $2,000 other contributions, the maximum is $3,000, not $1,000.
"这份文件和沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号已于 2026年8月15日 到期失效": states as fact that 14号 lapsed, but the key says that lapse is only presumed, with no official statement
“休息日调休要有书面记录”：书面记录有助举证，但包内没有支持其为补休生效必备条件的依据。
「付与日や日数は就業規則にも書いてある」 - 就業規則の記載内容は職場次第で、断定は根拠なし（軽微）
“在1年内申请劳动仲裁”未说明在职追讨欠薪的例外，容易误导；答案键明确在职期间不受该一年限制，离职后一年内提出。
"7个月年限以后随时能缴回来": overstates, because the later top-up is only through 一次性补缴 or 延缴 at retirement, and no amounts or conditions are given.
少額訴訟の「費用も数万円程度」：費用の範囲・内訳がなく検証不能。キー記載の本件請求額に対応する申立手数料とも整合する説明がない。
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금…제44조”: outdated penalty and provision; the key specifies Article 43 and five years or 50 million won.
「サインは『内容を確認した』以上の意味を持ちません」 is false: a signature can evidence agreement, including to a valid specific clause.
"Most do by 2026, but not all" (plan support) is unverifiable. No source is given.
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”: 키에 따르면 현행 벌칙은 5년 이하 징역 또는 5천만 원 이하 벌금이다.
「相談実績が非常に多い分野です」: 数字・出典なしの主張で検証不能。
Implies the delay is allowed because the employer has 20+ employees ('well above the 20-employee threshold'); the SEP has no size condition. Imprecise, minor.
Automatic enrollment “effective your birthday month” omits the earlier start for someone born on the first of the month.
"근로복지공단 소액체당금": an outdated name. The scheme has been 간이대지급금 since 2021.
「来年1〜3月に申告」 ties filing to the Jan–Mar season, which sits awkwardly with the answer's own correct statement that a refund return can be filed for 5 years.
"Usually ~90 days after Dec 31" for run-out: a common plan design but varies by plan. It is hedged, so plausible but unverified.
Defines Part B penalty protection using 'creditable coverage'; qualifying current-employment group coverage is required, unlike Part D's creditable-coverage rule.
考勤记录单位有保存义务: no source or document number given, so unverifiable.
Cites 《杭州市基本医疗保障办法》第五十五条 for transfer and continued accumulation: unverifiable article number.
“If you're not on Social Security, nothing happens automatically” overlooks Railroad Retirement benefits (assessed from my own knowledge).
将“按国家和上海有关规定执行”直接对应2192元：未保留标准答案要求的合同全文、以往发放实践及解释不确定性。
"지자체 생계비 지원" is vague and does not name the 생계비 융자 (living-expense loan) of up to 1,000만 won.
“对你没有实际收益”“最划算”：缺少退休时间等信息，无法排除补缴对满足退休年限的实际价值。
「仮に借主負担が認められる部分があっても、満額12万円にはなりません」：耐用年数後も工事費・人件費が請求されうるため、内訳未確認で金額を断定できない。
“All $1,900 stays usable, but only through March 15”: assumes the maximum grace period; the plan may end it earlier.
「先に『休ませてほしい』と頼めば、欠勤ではなく休暇の相談になります」は誤解を招く。有給と明示しなければ実際は無給の欠勤扱いになりうる

"So at most $660 of your $1,900 survives on its own ... The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240" is wrong if the plan has a grace period. The grace period lets the whole balance pay for March work through March 15. B's step 1 then says the grace period "may qualify", which contradicts this.
"人社厅函〔2025〕1号进一步明确：这300%是'另外支付'": I could not verify that the notice says this. The linked IP-address page would not load because of a certificate error, and a web search did not find the text
“Unused carryover still expires later”: misleading; unused carryover can carry forward again, subject to plan rules and the applicable cap.
Cites a themjcos.com summary and the Rev. Proc. 2025-32 PDF: checkable links, not opened by me
「社会保険料控除：約20〜40万円」 invents a personal deduction amount not supplied by the user.
'계약 후 잔금 사이에 근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다': 빈도 주장이며 확인 불가
'The 529 plan will issue Form 1099-Q to you as account owner' is unverifiable. The recipient of a 1099-Q for a transfer into the beneficiary's Roth may be the beneficiary.
"이직일부터 12개월 안이지만": imprecise. The period runs from the day after leaving, and it is the 수급기간, so applying late loses benefit days. The phrasing suggests waiting costs nothing.

The Part B penalty "applies to people who go without creditable coverage": misleading. The Part B exemption needs a group health plan based on current employment. 'Creditable coverage' is a Part D idea, and retiree or COBRA coverage would not protect against the Part B penalty.
“800元肯定不合法”“无论按哪种口径”：未保留实发800元在少数扣缴口径下存在争议的例外，与后文提醒也不一致。
"省内换工作不用转移，跨省才需要办医保关系转移接续": unverifiable. Intra-Zhejiang transfer rules are outside what the key verified, and A gives no source.
"Coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form": loosely worded and not verified.
'이직일 다음 날부터 12개월 안에 신청해야 하고' — imprecise. The 12 months is the 수급기간, so filing late loses benefit days. It is not just a deadline to file (key).

「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ、つまり更新の必要があっても借主負担分は生じません」: overstated. The residual value is 1円, not zero, and for intentional or negligent damage the tenant can still be charged work and labor costs after the 6-year useful life
“可能另扣大病保险等几十元”：the amount is unsupported; the answer does not clarify that deductions come from credited personal-account funds.
"Many offer neither" adds an unsupported claim about plan prevalence.
"You'll need" an HR letter overstates a requirement; the key specifies CMS-L564, not a mandatory separate letter.
"可能另扣大病保险等几十元": the key says these premiums come out of the back-credited personal account funds, not as an extra charge; the answer is ambiguous here
'Coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form' and 'disenrolling then re-enrolling is more complicated': stated without a source, loosely accurate.
'계약 후 잔금 사이에 근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다': unsourced frequency claim
Never ties the 83号 scenario to the 4-years = 80% tier. 6400 appears only as the case where the contract says 按本人工资的80%.
「敷金から引くには修繕内容と費用の内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: 622条の2は敷金の返還と差し引ける債務の範囲を定める条文で、内訳提示義務を定めたものではない。条文の中身を取り違えている。
LIMO、FP総合研究所、日経のリンクを根拠として挙げているが、内容が主張と一致するかは確認できない。
'전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만 비용 발생': oversimplified. It also leaves out that 전세권 registration needs the landlord's cooperation.
Presents 20+ employees as what "lets you delay Part B with no penalty". The SEP does not depend on employer size; the 20-employee line only decides who pays first.
"7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고" is stated flatly. The test is a 60-day total of late or unpaid days, so three months does not automatically meet it. The key calls this an overstatement.
'一个月的病假在医疗期内，公司不能以病假为由解除合同': roughly right but over-broad (the bar is on terminations under Labor Contract Law Arts. 40/41) and the medical period (Shanghai N+2 = 6 months) is not given.
"Unused carryover still expires later": imprecise; carryover money can itself be carried again under a plan's cap, so this is loosely stated

「特約は、借主がその内容を認識し、契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効（同ガイドライン）」: imprecise. The guideline's three requirements also include necessity/reasonableness and the tenant's expressed intent to bear the cost, and the 2005 Supreme Court ruling also accepts a clause stated specifically in the contract itself
“Confirm the office will charge before the 15th”: the service date determines eligibility, not the charge date.
"재직기간 3년 2개월 ≈ 1,155일": the key counts 1,158 days. Small effect on the total (minor)
“把某一天的300%和200%对调”：10月3日仍是法定节假日，不能因其为周六而把300%待遇转移至补假日。
「費用対効果は十分あります」 for 少額訴訟 is an unsupported judgement. The 60万円以下 / 原則1回 facts are correct.

'Complete the transfer by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 limit' treats December as the deadline. A rollover designated for 2026 can run to April 15, 2027, though plans vary. Minor error, softened by 'Before December is fine'.

"If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years": not realistic. The key notes that even at $8,000 a year, 4 years gives $32,000 < $35,000. Finishing in four years would need the 2027-2029 limits to average about $9,167, and limits rise in $500 steps.
「出せない請求は、根拠も怪しいことが多い」：頻度と請求の妥当性について裏付けがない。
“If your appointment is after it, treat the money as use-it-or-lose-it by December 31”: other eligible expenses can still be incurred during the plan's grace period.
「社会保険料控除：約20〜40万円」：本人の加入制度・支払額がなく、根拠のない個人向け推計。
노동청 진정 에서 지연이자까지 한 번에 청구: the labor office does not adjudicate interest, so this is loosely stated.
“也不会缩短……等待期”：标准答案明确此项未核实，不能肯定断言。
'근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호': a rule-of-thumb threshold given without any source.
"Run-out period, often ~90 days" adds an unsupported frequency claim; the packet establishes only a plan-specific deadline.
“另加大病、长护险几十元”：题包明确从补划个人账户扣减，不另交现金。
Quotes the Hangzhou rule as '中断缴费4个月及以上，重新参保后从参保缴费次次月起享受待遇'. The key says 'third natural month from resumed payment'. The result is the same (2027-01), but the quoted wording is unverified.
"If you're not on Social Security, nothing happens automatically" is too broad: Railroad Retirement beneficiaries can also be automatically enrolled (assessed from my own knowledge).
The cited links (m.163.com dy article, bendibao page) are secondary sources, and their content was not verified against the answer's claims.

"퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원" is wrong. At 4 years of service it comes to about 9.4만-14.1만 including local tax (I recomputed it), and nothing is withheld when the money goes to an IRP, which B itself says is the default.

“另扣大病保险（48元/年）、长护险（45元/年）…约54元；合计约3,370元”: per the key, these premiums are deducted from the money credited to the personal account, not paid as extra cash. The 45元/年 long-term-care figure is also unverifiable.
「内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」：同条が修繕内容・費用内訳の提示義務を直接定めているという説明は不正確。
"some do; most don't" (plans that require Medicare enrollment at 65) is an unsourced frequency claim.
The minimum formula is wrong: with $4,000 compensation and $2,000 already contributed, it permits $4,000 rather than $2,000.

The cited links (ft22.com mirror of the 10号 text, the rsj.sh.gov.cn 2025 Q&A, Ebner Stolz) cannot be verified from the answer. The Zhonglun link is real (opened). The ft22.com link is a non-official mirror.

Step 4 lists 인터넷등기소 as an equal option for 확정일자 "같은 날" with no caveat. An application after 18:00 (even after 16:00) on Friday is dated the next business day, Monday 10-26, so the 확정일자 and the 우선변제권 would slip.
반려되면 이의제기 → 심사청구 순: the formal route is 심사청구 then 재심사청구, so 이의제기 is loose wording.
"This compresses to four or five years" is unsupported: future limits are unannounced, and even $8,000 × 4 = $32,000 falls short.
"Usually have until March–April" adds an unverified typical filing deadline; the actual run-out deadline is plan-specific.

Table row '制度照搬旧上海算法（先按实得工资70%，再按4—6年80%）8000×70%×80%=4480元' mischaracterizes the old rule: the 70% base was a fallback only when nothing set the base, and it was 70% of the normal attendance wage, not 实得工资. The key does not cover this; judged from my own knowledge of the 2016 Shanghai wage payment rules

"The transfer must be completed by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 annual limit... if you miss it, it becomes a 2027 rollover" is wrong as a legal deadline. A rollover designated for 2026 can run to April 15, 2027, and plan handling varies. Only "finish by December to be safe" would be fine.
"(you can start three months before your birthday)" for declining Part B with SSA: an unverifiable timing detail (plausible, since it matches the start of the IEP).
「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ、つまり更新の必要があっても借主負担分は生じません」: 残存価値は1円の下限があり、故意・過失の毀損なら耐用年数後も工事費・人件費を請求されうる。日焼けには当てはまるが、一般論としては言い過ぎ。
법정 기한을 '10월 4일'로 확정했다. 키에서는 퇴직일 해석과 휴일 계산 때문에 정확한 날짜가 확정되지 않았다.
"The limits may rise with inflation, which would shorten the schedule" is unrealistic. Indexed rises in $500 steps cannot bring $35,000 under five tax years.
建议询问补“3–9月”：与3月已缴、11月恢复的计算假设不符，应为4–10月。
有效综合工时下“最多再拿约2482.76元、合计最多6206.90元”没有依据；缺少整个计算周期的工时，不能确定该金额或上限。
“向公司注册地或劳动合同履行地的劳动保障监察投诉”：混用了劳动仲裁的地域选择，劳动监察一般按用工所在地管辖。
"杭州职工医保的报销比例不跟连续年限挂钩": unverifiable.
Applies “$660 of 2025 funds” to this scenario: the relevant 2026 carryover maximum is $680, making the maximum-cap spend-down $1,220 rather than $1,240.
"Unused carryover still expires later" is imprecise: carried-over money can itself carry over again up to the cap, so only the excess is forfeited.

The 'use the smallest of' formula lists '$7,500 minus any other 2026 IRA contributions' but never compensation minus other contributions. Someone who earns $4,000 and contributes $2,000 gets $4,000 from it, but the correct cap is $2,000.
「所得税自体が約1,000円」：社会保険料控除などを考慮しない場合の概算を、本人の税額として述べている。

社会保険料控除「約20〜40万円（国民年金・国保など）」: an assumed figure placed in the calculation table. The request gives no social insurance amount, so it cannot be verified. A does caveat it later (社会保険料の金額が分かれば、所得税0が確定します).
"대항력은 신고 다음 날 0시부터라 오전에 끝내는 게 좋아요" has a weak rationale. The 0시 start is the same whether the filing is in the morning or the afternoon.
'제44조, 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금'은 키 기준으로 개정 전 규정이다.
Cites the 人社局 reply link as showing that both 83号 and 14号 expired on 2026-08-15; per the key the official reply covers 83号, and 14号's expiry is only presumed
法定节假日的工时不计入综合计算周期的总工时: no source, not in the key; plausible from my own knowledge but unverified.
“报销比例只看医院等级和费用段”：排他性说法未获题包支持。
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated. From 2026.9.18 퇴직급여법 제43조 sets 5년/5천만 원 (minor deduction).
“퇴직금은 IRP 계정으로 이전”: 나이가 확인되지 않았는데 55세 이상 등 예외 없이 의무로 안내한다.
"$1,220+ evaporates on January 1": loosely worded. Forfeiture is measured at the end of the run-out, and 2026 claims filed during it still count

The S. 5550 claim (introduced September 24, 2026, referred to Finance, would eliminate the aggregate rollover limit) is correct. I opened the govinfo link. The bill text does not state the $35,000 figure, but the claim is fair.
“购房、落户等‘连续社保’资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）”：the packet does not establish these separate eligibility rules.
「壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」: 言い過ぎ。ガイドラインは通常損耗なら貸主負担、故意・過失の毀損なら借主負担(経過年数を考慮)としており、クロス張替え一般が貸主負担とは書いていない。
Treats 인터넷등기소 확정일자 as equal to a visit with no 18시 cutoff warning; this can push the date to the next working day.

The four-way minimum is wrong when compensation is below $7,500 and other IRA contributions exist: $4,000 compensation and $2,000 contributed yields $4,000 under its formula, but only $2,000 is permitted.

"coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form": imprecise. SEP coverage starts the month after sign-up, or the month of sign-up if you enroll while still covered; processing time does not set it.

Says in the present tense that the base is 70% of normal wage when the contract is silent. The key cites 10号第九条 only as contract wage with a 2740 floor, so whether the new rules keep the 70% fallback is unverifiable.
源泉徴収票で「基礎控除104万円が反映されているか確認」: 源泉徴収票は基礎控除を個別には記載しないので不正確。確認すべき「源泉徴収税額」欄には触れていない。
States as fact that 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 expired on 2026-08-15. The key says this is only inferred, and the official reply covers 83号.
"The excess is a nonqualified withdrawal, tax and 10% penalty on the earnings" is incomplete. It omits the 6% excise tax on the Roth side for excess contributions.
"This is the most commonly missed cost" adds an unsupported ranking of state-tax mistakes.
“32小时全超时……2,482.76元”“大约在3,724～6,207元之间”：假设下的乘法正确，但缺少实际每日工时和周期总工时，不能据此确定本案金额范围。
States as fact that the 14号 file expired on 2026-08-15, though the key says this is only inferred.

7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘게 충족: stated flatly with no day-count criterion (60 days of full delay or non-payment, 1 month = 30 days) and no question about how late each month was. This is the 'three months so automatically' overstatement, softened by 가능성이 꽤 높아요 and 심사예요.
Says 劳部发〔1994〕503号 and 京劳社资发〔2003〕157号 both require filing with the 区人社局. Only 157号 (Art. 15) says that; 503号 leaves local approval to provincial rules. Minor misattribution.
'반려되면 이의제기 → 심사청구 순': 법정 불복은 심사청구 → 재심사청구라 '이의제기' 단계는 부정확(본인 지식으로 판단)
"퇴직소득세가 원천징수되어 실수령액은 조금 줄어듭니다": when the money goes to an IRP (which A itself says is the default), no tax is withheld at payment (소득세법 제146조②)
IRP 계좌를 “미리 만들어두면 지급이 빨라집니다”: 지급 지연의 원인이 확인되지 않아 지급이 빨라진다는 결과는 보장할 수 없다.
「e-Taxなら30分ほど」：本人の準備状況や操作経験に依存する所要時間で、根拠が示されていない。
将“照搬旧上海口径”算成4480元，并称无约定时按正常工资70%作基数；该额外规则未获答案键支持，键中照搬83号分档的示例为6400元。
“12개월 안에 수급자격 신청”: misleadingly presents the benefit-payment window as merely an application deadline; applying near its end can forfeit payable days.
Dates the eight-month SEP from loss of employment or coverage; it begins the following month.
LINE本文の「10月1日から有給休暇が付与されています」: 6か月の8割出勤が前提で、本文では断定しているが前置きでは条件付きなので、実際に8割未満なら誤りになる（軽微）
“在职期间追劳动报酬不受1年时效限制；离职后1年内提出”：直接用于本案加班费而未说明适用口径差异，比题包支持的结论更确定。
"confirm the office will charge before the 15th": expenses count when the service is provided, not when the office charges, so this is misleading

'应发是2192元左右、扣掉个人社保和公积金后实发800元：公司是按最低线在发' implies the employer may be compliant. The majority view (key) is that the minimum excludes personal contributions, so take-home pay should not fall below 2192. Partly hedged by '口径不完全一致'.
'You'll need' an HR letter overstates a separate letter as mandatory; the key specifies CMS-L564 as the employer-coverage evidence.
HUG·SGI 반환보증 "전입신고·확정일자 후 신청 가능" — consistent with the key for HUG, but the SGI condition is unverified.
The email asks for 「経年減価（残存価値）の算定方法」 for sun-yellowing. That implicitly accepts some tenant share where the key says none exists before any depreciation calculation (framing problem, minor).
The HR message sets a 3-working-day reply deadline and asks for 民主程序记录 and 公示证据. These are the drafter's own additions and not in the key; they are harmless but add length.
Never gives the 6400 figure that applies if the company system adopts the 83号 tiers (4 years = 80%). It only says company standards are 通常远高于 2192 元.
「实际发放高于合同约定的，按实际发放」for the overtime base: unverifiable, and it conflicts with the key (base is the contract wage, Beijing wage regulation Art 44)
「欠勤」ではなく「事前に承認された休暇」なら安心という助言：事前承認だけでは有給扱いや賃金・手当の保護は確保されない。
「室内の写真は当方でも保管しております」: invents an existing photographic record the user never mentioned.
A "not tax or benefits advice" disclaimer and an extra "two traps" section add length without content
"법제처 해석(2026. 5. 26.)": I cannot verify the date, though a moleg.go.kr link is given and the key confirms 26-0209.

"There is no separate December 31 deadline for the rollover itself; if you miss it, it becomes a 2027 rollover" is wrong or confusing. A 2026-designated rollover can be made through April 15, 2027, though plans vary. Minor error per the key.
日付が不明なのに「来月の行事は付与後の日付」と断定し、LINEにも「10月1日から有給休暇が付与されています」と書く。実施日（10月下旬）なら正しいが、依頼文に日付がないため条件付きで書く方が確実
Says "到退休年龄就能享受退休医保" and omits the requirement to keep contributing in Hangzhou until retirement. Minor omission.
"3개월 총일수 약 89~92일" and "≈ 1,155일": the 6/21-9/20 window is 92 days and service is about 1,158 days. The 89-day figure pushes the top of the average-wage range to 1,060만 (minor imprecision).
The law.go.kr link and statute citations are plausible but not verified here.
“10월 4일이 법정 기한”, “21일 지났어요”: 퇴직일 해석과 휴일 처리를 확인하지 않아 확정할 수 없다.
지연이자 근거로 추가한 '같은 법 제17조 제3항'은 제공된 키로 확인되지 않는 인용이다.
“10월 4일이 기한”: asserts an exact deadline despite unresolved retirement-date and holiday calculations.
Cites "沪劳保发〔2000〕14号"; the correct number is 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 (minor).
"roughly $1,220-$1,240" forfeited: the $1,240 end uses the 2025 cap of $660; for 2026 it is $1,220 (minor, hedged with "roughly")
The 20-employee threshold is presented as what "lets you delay Part B with no late-enrollment penalty". The SEP is not size-conditional; size decides who pays first (imprecise, minor).

"The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240"; the figure should be $1,220 at the $680 cap, and the statement is wrong if the plan has a grace period, where the whole $1,900 can pay for work through March 15.
「少額調停・少額訴訟という手段もあります」: 「少額調停」は正式な手続名ではない（民事調停と少額訴訟）。不正確。

住まいるダイヤル（0570-016-100）: the number matches my own knowledge, but that service mainly covers buying and renovating homes, so it may not help with a rental restoration dispute (judged from my knowledge, not checked)
“근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다”: 빈도를 뒷받침하는 근거가 없어 검증 불가.
'근로복지공단 소액체당금' is the old name of 간이대지급금, and the condition '회사가 사실상 도산했다면' is wrong: 간이대지급금 can be claimed while the business is still operating.
'Finish by December 31, 2026 so it counts' incorrectly treats December as the federal deadline; a 2026-designated transfer can occur through April 15, 2027, subject to institutional processing.
“요건을 넘길 가능성이 높습니다”: 지연일수나 미지급액을 모르므로 석 달이라는 사실만으로 인정 가능성을 높게 평가할 근거가 부족합니다.
“At most $660 ... survives” and March work cannot use “the other $1,240” ignore the grace-period possibility, which can preserve the entire $1,900 for qualifying March care.
The 95-day approximation (30×38/12) and the "1,020만~1,045만" range: the range holds if the 3 months total 90 days (990만÷90×95 = 1,045만). Slightly loose, still within the key's range.

The table labels ~$680 carried over as the "best case" and ~$1,220 forfeited as the "realistic math": misleading, because a grace-period plan covers all $1,900. The grace period only comes later as a "nuance".
「所定労働日の8割以上」は法の文言「全労働日」と微妙に異なる（実質ほぼ同じで軽微）
ホワイトニングなどの対象外の記述にNo.1128の出典リンクを付けており、国税庁が明記しているように読める。キーでは国税庁の例示にないとされる。
The source list at the end gives links but quotes no wording from them. What each source is said to support cannot be checked without opening it.
“계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다” adds an unsupported prevalence claim.
"Complete the transfer by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 limit" contradicts the key's April 15, 2027 federal deadline, subject to provider processing.

Table row "制度照搬旧上海算法（先按实得工资70%，再按4—6年80%）" = 4480 calls a 70% base the old Shanghai algorithm. Under the old rules the 70% base (of 正常出勤月工资, not 实得工资) applied only when no wage was agreed at all, and with an agreed 8000 wage the result was 6400. Misleading.

“같은 법 제17조 제3항” as the basis for delayed severance interest is misplaced; the key identifies Labor Standards Act Article 37 and Enforcement Decree Article 17. The unconditional wording also omits statutory exclusions.
Opens with 「文面はこれで大丈夫です」 as if reviewing a draft the user never sent. This confuses the reader but is not a factual error.
将14号文也称为工龄分档规则，并写作“沪劳保发〔2000〕14号”：文件性质和文号不准确，应为沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号。

National Employment Support: says the leftover can be received after unemployment benefits end, so apply now. The key says someone still receiving benefits, or within 6 months after they end, may be excluded. Over-optimistic and unverified.
A check to the son 'becomes ... an excess Roth contribution (6% excise tax per year)' is overstated. An indirect deposit within his limit is a regular contribution, not necessarily an excess.
“购房、落户等‘连续社保’资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）”：将医保断缴直接推广到其他资格，所给材料无法支持。

"The Part B late-enrollment penalty ... applies to people who go without creditable coverage": imprecise. Penalty-free delay of Part B depends on a group health plan based on current employment (the SEP). "Creditable coverage" is the Part D concept, and COBRA or retiree coverage does not protect Part B.
“3개월치 월급”: the request does not establish that three months of wages remain unpaid.
“杭州退休医保待遇不看20年以上的年限”“不会让退休报销比例更高”：给定材料无法核实这些待遇计算结论。
「通常損耗を借主負担とする特約は、借主がその内容を認識し、契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効」: ガイドラインの3要件（必要性・合理性、借主の認識、負担の意思表示）の簡略化で、要件の一部を欠く。最高裁判決への言及もない。
"补缴超过1个月通常要去医保经办窗口，带身份证、居住证或户口本、就业登记材料、补缴申请表": unverifiable procedural detail with no source.
「e-Taxなら30分ほど」: an unverifiable time estimate.
Says the employer completes CMS-L564; the applicant completes Section A and the employer Section B.
称分析依据包括“裁审口径”：未提供可识别的裁判或裁审文件，所给材料无法核实。
“12개월 안에 신청해야” misleadingly presents the benefit-payment window as merely an application deadline; late application can forfeit payable days.
“Unused carryover still expires later” implies mandatory expiration; continued carryover can preserve unused funds in subsequent years.
The deadlines in the HR message ("本周内", "下个工资发放日前") are invented demands, not legal rules. Minor.
「所得税5%で約850円、住民税10%で約1,700円、合わせて2,500円程度」は所得税の還付を前提にしている。2026年分は基礎控除104万円のため、社会保険料控除が2万円以上あれば課税所得は0で、源泉徴収税額が0なら還付も0円（キー）。源泉徴収税額欄の確認にも触れていない
'고용24에서 수급자격 신청' omits 구직신청, the online education and the 고용센터 visit, so the procedure is incomplete.
全宅連解説リンク（rp2011_11.pdf）と消費者庁の相談ページへのリンクは内容を確認できていない（消費者庁側は403）。
“운영시간…을 놓치면…인터넷등기소 확정일자로 대체”: misleading for Friday evening; applications after 18:00 receive Monday’s date, according to the key.
"也可以在 1 年内申请劳动仲裁": oversimplified; a wage-arrears claim made while still employed is not bound by the one-year limit, which runs from leaving the job (Arbitration Law Art. 27)
“식대·차량보조 등 통상임금이 아닌 항목”: 일반 법률 지식에 비추어, 수당 명칭만으로 통상임금에서 제외할 수 없다.
将“在职期间……不受一年限制，离职后一年内”直接用于本案加班费：未说明加班费适用该规则存在地域口径差异，确定性超过答案键支持的范围。
「所得税自体が約1,000円」: (106万−104万)×5%＝1,000円 only holds if there is no 社会保険料控除, an assumption the answer does not state.

"대항력은 신고 다음 날 0시부터라 오전에 끝내는 게 좋아요": the reasoning does not hold. Protection starts at 0:00 the next day whether you file in the morning or the afternoon, so this is a non-sequitur rather than a factual error (minor).
"같은 법 제17조에 따라 연 20%의 지연이자" misattributes the basis. Delay interest on severance comes from 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조; 퇴직급여법 제17조 deals with DB pension benefits. Judged from my own knowledge.

"운영시간...을 놓치면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 확정일자로 대체하세요": misleading. An 인터넷등기소 확정일자 filed after 18:00 Friday is granted on the next working day, 10-26 (Mon), and the date an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 counts from is unverified. So this fallback does not give the same-day protection the answer implies.
"at most $660 of 2025 funds can move into 2026": wrong plan year; the user's plan year ends Dec 31, 2026, and the 2026-to-2027 carryover cap is $680 (Rev. Proc. 2025-32)
「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ、つまり…借主負担分は生じません」 overgeneralizes: the guideline retains a residual value of 1 yen, and depreciation does not eliminate every possible charge for negligent damage.
The "北京丰台法院2026年的案例解读" and "光明网" links are claims about sources I could not open; unverifiable.

'If you contributed in 2021-2026, that money isn't eligible' is imprecise. Only contributions within five years before the transfer date are excluded, so early-2021 money can qualify for a late-2026 transfer.
“你离退休还远”：请求没有年龄或退休时间，属于无依据假设。
“Carried into next year (best case) ~$680” misleadingly excludes a grace period preserving access to all $1,900 for timely March care.
The Federal Register link (FR-2025-11-19, 2025-20251) and the Medicare.gov links were not opened. The $202.90 figure matches the key.
Penalty given as 3 years / 30 million won: old rule; since 2026.9.18 it is 5 years / 50 million won (minor deduction).
「合わせて2,500円程度」 assumes income-tax savings without checking liability or withholding; the income-tax refund may be zero.

It cites 国税庁 No.1128 for a list that includes クリーニング・ホワイトニング and ガソリン代・駐車場代. No.1128 does not list whitening or cleaning, and gasoline and parking come from No.1122, so the citation suggests NTA wording that does not exist (the key says calling whitening 「国税庁が明記」 is wrong).

Ties the no-penalty delay to the 400-employee size ("That lets you delay Part B"; "Under 20 ... you'd want to enroll at 65"). The SEP does not depend on employer size; the key calls this imprecise but minor.
Leaves out the calculation base and the daily conversion (÷21.75). It uses 8000 only as the social-insurance contribution base.

Puts 8000×70%×80% = 4480 in the headline and labels it 照搬旧上海口径. The arithmetic is right, and the 70% fallback base does appear in 沪人社规〔2026〕10号 第九条 (I fetched the rsj.sh.gov.cn page it links). But the base here is the contract wage 8000, so 4480 applies only if neither contract nor collective agreement sets a wage. The key does not mention it, and it can confuse the reader.
