"If the money lands in January, it generally counts for 2027, and the 2026 room is lost" (and "Confirm the deposit before December 31"): wrong per the key. The 2026 Form 5498 instructions and 219(f)(3) allow a rollover designated for 2026 through April 15, 2027, though whether the plan will process it that way varies.
「基礎控除104万円（合計所得132万円以下。令和8年分）」: the key (No.1199) gives the 104万円 condition as 合計所得金額489万円以下, not 132万円以下. The conclusion is unaffected because 106万円 is below both thresholds.
'워크넷 구직등록 후 ... 수급자격을 신청하세요' - wrong, 워크넷 job-seeker registration has been folded into 고용24
“Some do; most don't” asserts an unsupported prevalence of employer enrollment requirements.
“连续缴费年限……重新计算”：材料只确认中断参保及等待期规则，不支持职工医保存在这一概括性的重算规则。
“퇴직금(2년 근무면 발생)”: 근속기간만으로 단정했으며 주 15시간 이상 요건을 확인하지 않았습니다.
"a few plans do [require Part B] for certain employee classes": unverifiable, no source given.

Quotes 劳部发〔1997〕271号第四条 ('应另外支付不低于工资的300%') and 第五条 as primary sources; I could not find these article texts, and the 300% rule is normally traced to 劳动法第44条第3项 / 劳部发〔1995〕309号第62条. Unverifiable and possibly misattributed.
“2년 근무라 퇴직금 대상입니다” omits the required weekly working-hours condition.
“正常上班到退休只会超过，不会不够”: depends on her age, which the answer does not know; stated as certain.
「あとから有給に戻すのが面倒になります」 asserts an administrative difficulty not established by the packet.
'진정 결과는 실업급여 심사에도 도움이 됩니다' has no source and depends on the case.
The attribution 「国土交通省…では」 supplies no checkable link or document number; its broad wallpaper-replacement claim also exceeds the key.
'购房、落户等连续社保资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）' is beyond scope and unverifiable; housing and hukou eligibility rules are not established by the medical-insurance rules in the key
'If you're not on Social Security, nothing happens automatically' overlooks automatic enrollment through Railroad Retirement benefits.
杭州退休医保待遇不看20年以上的年限 - unverifiable (judged from my own knowledge, plausible).
询问补“3–9月”：按3月已缴、11月恢复的假设，应为4–10月。
“기한은 10월 4일”: states an exact deadline despite unresolved retirement-date and holiday calculations.
「今回は通常の医療費控除が有利」は比較に必要な対象市販薬の購入額などがなく、判断できない。
“这是唯一有时限的事”：与其自己写出的2026年12月31日补缴期限矛盾。
"A few plans do [require Medicare] for certain employee classes": unverifiable.
「原状回復は相談実績が非常に多い分野です」: 出典なし、検証不可
「今の文面は早めに言っている点で正しい」：送信日と行事日が不明なので、十分早いとは確認できない。
“The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240”: contradicts the grace-period branch, which can cover the entire $1,900 if the service date qualifies.
“같은 법 제17조에 따라 연 20%”: cites the wrong legal basis for this severance-payment interest; the key identifies Labor Standards Act Article 37 and Enforcement Decree Article 17.
“회사가 문 닫으면 회수율이 뚝 떨어지니”: the asserted sharp reduction in recovery is unsupported.
“近期可能看病、生育：建议补”：补缴能否改善等待期或恢复生育连续资格尚未确定，不能据此直接建议补缴。
所得税の課税所得0を「可能性が高い」とするだけで、源泉徴収票の「源泉徴収税額」欄の確認を促していない。
'현행법상 퇴직금은 IRP 계정으로 이전하는 방식' leaves out the conditions (amount over 3 million won, under 55). This is a mild oversimplification, and the HR text repeats it.
“确认新公司11月及时给你参保，这是唯一有时限的事”: contradicts B's own 2026-12-31 补缴 deadline.
末尾八条“依据”链接未逐条核实，其中114.255.111.180镜像站、2026-05丰台报道的链接无法确认。
源泉徴収票の「源泉徴収税額」欄の確認を促していない(所得税の還付が0円になり得る点が抜けている)
"Premiums aren't refunded": unsupported categorical claim about terminating Part B; the packet does not establish this refund rule.
Cites 京劳社资发〔2005〕94号 as part of Beijing's administrative-permit regime. I could not verify the number or what it covers, so it is unverifiable.

Calls 2,192 yuan the "应发下限" flatly. The key says there is no official position and the majority view is that the minimum excludes personal contributions. The answer does flag the dispute after 14号 expired, so this is a minor overstatement.
“12개월 안에 수급자격 신청” omits that benefits must generally be paid within that window, so applying near its end loses entitlement days.
'근로감독관이 시정지시를 하고' and the '3~5일 안에 회신이 없으면' timeline are unverified procedural claims.
「所得税自体が約1,000円」：社会保険料控除などを考慮しない条件付きの計算を、本人の税額として提示している。
The HR letter attributes the 80%-of-minimum floor to "上海现行规定". The floor comes from national 劳部发〔1995〕309号第59条, not a current Shanghai rule. Minor misattribution.

"Scholarships do not" count as compensation is overbroad: W-2 scholarship income and certain taxable graduate/postdoctoral stipends qualify. See [IRS Publication 970](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p970).

The ordering "체불임금 회수 → 수급자격 신청 → 단기 현금흐름" puts the unemployment application second and never says to file before looking for work. It does not delay the filing, but it is not the advice the key wants.
“12개월 안에 신청해야 합니다”: 수급기간을 신청기한처럼 설명하여 늦은 신청에 따른 급여일수 소멸을 놓쳤다.
근로복지공단 소액체당금: 2021년에 간이대지급금으로 명칭이 바뀐 낡은 용어이고, 회사가 사실상 도산했다면이라는 조건도 맞지 않는다(간이대지급금은 진정 후 체불 확인서로 청구).
「民法621条ただし書き」 is the wrong pinpoint for the ordinary-wear exclusion; that exclusion appears in the main clause's parenthesis.
「申告が扶養判定に影響」：医療費控除の申告自体が税の扶養判定を変えるかのようで不正確。医療費控除は合計所得金額を変えない。
“현행법상 퇴직금은 IRP 계정으로 이전”: 나이를 확인하지 않고 일률적으로 안내했다. 키는 55세 이상 등의 예외를 명시한다.

"Scholarships ... do not" count as compensation is overbroad: qualifying W-2 scholarship income and certain taxable graduate/postdoctoral stipends count. See [IRS Publication 970](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p970).
Asking HR whether the company has 20+ employees is redundant when the asker already said about 400; harmless
“杭州职工医保的报销比例不跟‘连续年限’挂钩”：给定材料无法核实这一概括。
The two 1350 links (id=1000319196, id=1000261514) are offered as sources but I did not open them, so what they say is unverifiable
「壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」：通常損耗の場合という限定を外して一般化している。
Step 1 "나가기 전·도착 직후" puts the registry re-check right after arrival and never ties it to 잔금. That leaves out the key's "잔금 전 열람, 변동 시 보류". A new 근저당 found after paying cannot be undone.

「所得税5%で約850円…合わせて2,500円程度」: states an income-tax refund of about 850 yen as expected, but taxable income is likely 0 and a withholding tax of 0 means a 0 yen refund. The answer never mentions checking the 源泉徴収税額 field, so the total is overstated and the real gain is mostly about 1,700 yen of resident tax
另可能补扣大病保险48元/年、长护险等几十元 - the key says these premiums are deducted from the back-credited personal-account funds, so no extra cash is due. The wording suggests an extra charge.
“대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면”: incomplete early-reemployment eligibility; the key requires reemployment after 14 days from reporting and at least half the prescribed benefit days remaining.
将近期生育、买房列为补缴适用情形，未证实此次补缴能恢复相应连续资格，建议的依据不足。
'Some plans also require a signature guarantee' and 'Some plans take two to four weeks' are plan-specific and unverifiable, but plausible and marked as 'some'.
「今回は通常の医療費控除が有利」：対象市販薬の購入額などが不明で、比較結果を断定できない。
将14号文列为工龄分档规则，并写作“沪劳保发〔2000〕14号”：答案键列的是最低标准文件“沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号”。
"근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호" — a rule-of-thumb threshold with no source, not in the key (unverifiable).
"人社厅函〔2025〕1号进一步明确：这300%是'另外支付'" attributes a specific holding to a notice. A link is given, but I did not check that the notice says this; unverifiable.

The 'smallest of' list treats compensation and '$7,500 minus other IRA contributions' as separate items. For $4,000 earned plus $2,000 contributed it gives $4,000, but the right figure is min(7,500, 4,000) minus 2,000 = $2,000. The table's wording ('Reduced by any other 2026 IRA contributions') is right, so this is a minor internal inconsistency.

"合计约3,370元" and "约3,850元" (8 months) add the 大病/长护 personal share as extra cash; the key says it is deducted from the 补划 personal-account funds, so the cash is 3,315.69 yuan. The answer then says net outlay is "略低于3,370元", which is self-contradictory.
メール案が「費用の内訳が示されていない」と前提している: 依頼文からは内訳の有無が不明で、未確認の仮定

「所得税自体が約1,000円」: works out 106万−104万=2万×5% but leaves out the 社会保険料控除. A part-timer earning 180万 almost certainly pays social insurance of 2万 or more, so the taxable income is likely 0 and so is the income tax.
"$1,900 becomes $0 on January 1": loosely stated. Expenses must be incurred by Dec 31, but forfeiture is measured at the end of the run-out period. Minor
“20-employee threshold ... lets you delay Part B” conflates primary-payer rules with SEP eligibility; employer size is not an SEP condition.
"With distribution code 1 in Box 7" implies a required reporting detail; the code is optional under the [IRS Form 1099-Q instructions](https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i1099q).
“평일 18시까지”를 해당 주민센터 확인 없이 일반화했습니다. 제시한 특정 주민센터 링크만으로 이용할 주민센터의 운영시간까지 확정할 수 없습니다.
"如果这7天每天超过8小时，超过部分另按150%主张" is wrong for holiday and rest-day work. Every hour on those days is already paid at 300% or 200%, so there is no extra 150% on hours over 8.
「受けるには自分で確定申告」は断定が広すぎる。所得税の申告をせず、住民税申告で控除を受ける方法もある。
CMS-L564 "completed by your employer": Section A is completed by the enrollee and Section B by the employer (minor).
“补缴超过1个月通常要去医保经办窗口”及所列材料：题包未提供该期限或材料清单。
“12개월 안에 신청” misstates the benefit-payment window as merely an application deadline; applying near its end can forfeit benefits.
“Through March 15, 2026”: uses the wrong year and initially presents the maximum grace period as automatic; the relevant latest date is March 15, 2027, and plans may shorten it.
'If the annual limit rises with inflation, this compresses to four or five years'. Wrong: 8,000 x 4 = 32,000 is below 35,000, so it still takes five tax years.
“본인이 처벌을 원하지 않으면”: 키에 있는 명단공개 기간 중 재위반 예외를 생략한 포괄적 설명이다.
“고용노동부(1350)…에…진정”: conflates the counseling number with the complaint-filing channels.
"이직확인서를 회사가 안 써주면 고용센터에 발급 요청하면 됩니다" is loosely put. The 고용센터 can press the company, but the key point is that the application can go in without the form; judged from own knowledge.
“실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분”, “지금 미리 신청”: 구직촉진수당의 잔여분을 이어 받는다는 근거가 없고, 실업급여 종료 후 6개월 이내 제외 가능성도 누락했습니다.
Quotes a 人社部办公厅 notice word for word ("在正常发放的当日工资（100%）之外，再额外支付300%") with no document number or link. Unverifiable quoted wording.
잔금 지급 단계를 아예 빠뜨림. 등기부 확인을 '나가기 전·도착 직후'로 잡아 잔금 전 확인·잔금 보류와 연결하지 않음(누락이지 사실 오류는 아님)
“3개월치 + 퇴직금을 진정”, “당장 가장 큰 현금”: 이미 지급된 임금이 있을 수 있고, 진정이 즉시 현금 지급으로 이어진다는 보장도 없습니다.
The uniform-coverage question ("Is my full $1,900 available now?") is a tangent: the $1,900 is already the remaining balance. The rule matters for the 2027 election, which the answer never mentions.
"budget to spend roughly $1,240+": this uses the 2025 $660 cap. For a 2026 plan year the cap is $680, so the spend needed is $1,220.
京劳社资发〔2005〕94号 said to set a full administrative-licence procedure: the 10-working-day figure matches the key, but the rest is unverified.
住まいるダイヤル 0570-016-100: not in the key. I judged it correct from my own knowledge and did not check it on the web.
Cites a third-party site (lhdbenefits.com/resources/2026-fsa-limits) for the 2026 limits. The link is checkable but its support for the figure is not verified. Rev. Proc. 2025-32 is correctly cited.
Table labels the $680 carryover as the "best case", but a grace period covering March would save all $1,900, which A itself admits a few lines later
“전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만” asserts blanket superiority and omits landlord cooperation; registration does not defeat existing senior mortgages.
「有給休暇を一律に拒否することはできず」は正しいが、「単なる忙しさでは時季変更できない」点は書かれていない（欠落であり誤りではない）
“这7个月不用补”“这两个条件都还不急”：仅凭已缴8年不能确定补缴必要性或紧迫性。

The 1099-Q claim (Box 4b, code 1 in Box 7) matches the IRS Form 1099-Q instructions page I fetched, where Box 7 codes are optional. The Form 5498 Box 10 claim matches the key. I list no error for either.
「できれば今週中に」 - 法律上の期限はなく、根拠のない目安（法的主張ではない）
「2か所以上から給与がある…場合は別途申告が必要」：複数勤務だけで必ず申告義務が生じるわけではない。
"If you're not on Social Security, nothing is automatic": overbroad; Railroad Retirement benefits can also trigger automatic enrollment.
「7年住んだ物件では残存価値はゼロです」: the guideline's residual value is 1円 (about 0%); this is close enough, but it is again used as an argument for the sunburn, where depreciation does not apply
Opens with 「文面はこれで大丈夫です」 although the user gave no draft. Incoherent opener, not a factual claim, but it misleads.
文面に「前後の日で調整できるところがあれば対応します」とあり、年休は代替出勤なしに取れる権利なので、やや下手に出すぎている（軽微）。
"7 个月年限以后随时能缴回来": loose. The months themselves cannot be back-paid after 2026. A shortfall is only made up at retirement (one-time payment or monthly deferral) or by working longer.
The $1,240 forfeiture figure is built on the wrong $660 cap. The right carryover-case figure is $1,220.
States the gap between the two methods as 827.59元; 3310.34 - 2482.76 = 827.58, so off by one cent.
'If the annual limit rises with inflation, this compresses to four or five years' is wrong about four: even at $8,000 a year, four years gives only $32,000, short of $35,000, so it still takes five.
'이직일부터 12개월 안이지만': the period runs from the day after leaving, and calling it an application window hides that benefit days are lost if you apply late.
Gives the daily wage 413.79 with no legal basis (人社部发〔2025〕2号 is not mentioned)
「確定申告か住民税申告が必要」とするが、年末調整では受けられない点(所得税法190条)には触れていない(誤りではなく欠落)
“10월 30일 이후 노동청에 진정”: supplies an unsupported waiting date when a complaint is already available.
“12개월 안에 신청”: 12개월은 단순 신청기한이 아니라 급여를 받을 수 있는 기간입니다. 늦으면 손해라는 설명은 있지만 구분이 불명확합니다.
"If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years" is misleading. With $500-step indexing (for example 8,000 x 4 = 32,000 < 35,000) it still takes five years.
'apply the month before you retire' to have Medicare start when coverage ends: consistent with the key's 'about a month before'; wording is loose but not wrong.
“Forfeiting roughly $1,220–$1,240”: $1,900 − $680 = $1,220 for the maximum 2026 carryover. Actual forfeiture depends on the plan; $1,240 uses the older cap.
"you can incur expenses through March 15, 2026": wrong year (latest is March 15, 2027), and it is stated as a fixed date when March 15 is only the maximum a plan may set

The closing "依据" list gives links, but the text cites no instrument by number except 309号第59条 in the link label. The letter itself cites no instrument by number, so the legal basis cannot be checked from the text.

"California taxes the earnings plus a 2.5% penalty" is one accepted reading. The key calls whether California taxes the whole rollover or only the earnings unresolved, and the answer states it as settled.
문자의 “지급기일 연장에 합의한 사실이 없다”: 질문자가 실제로 합의하지 않았는지는 확인되지 않았다.
'미가입이면 고용센터에 피보험자격 확인을 신청' is unverifiable (A names 근로복지공단 instead).
'회사가 이직확인서에 자발적 사직으로 올리면 1차로 반려될 수 있어요': 키에 없는 단정, 검증 불가
"大病保险等可能另计几十元" contradicts the key: the individual share of 大病保险/长护险 is deducted from the 补划 personal-account funds, not paid in extra cash.
「ICカード履歴でも可」：履歴だけで必要な通院記録を満たすという意味なら、キーにも提示された根拠にも裏付けがない。
"계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다": a claim about how often this happens, with no source given
「雇い入れから6か月たつと法律上の有給休暇が付きます」は8割出勤の要件を落としており、無条件のように読める(不正確)
「源泉徴収票で、給与所得控除74万円…が反映されているか確認」: the 源泉徴収票 shows the amount after the employment-income deduction, not the deduction itself. It also points at the wrong check, since the key wants the 源泉徴収税額 column
“Finish by December 31, 2026 so it counts” incorrectly makes December the federal deadline.
“You can incur expenses through March 15” treats the maximum grace period as guaranteed; plans may set an earlier deadline.
最多约2482.76元、合计最多约6206.90元：凭空给情形B的150%算出具体金额。它假设32小时全部超出周期总工时，答案键说凭现有信息算不出，而且“最多”并不是真上限。
“워크넷 구직등록”: obsolete; registration is through 고용24.
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」 is an unverifiable generalization.
임금체불확인서(회사 발급) is listed as evidence to prepare; a non-paying employer rarely issues one and the usual document comes from the labor office after a complaint. Unverifiable and doubtful.
“December slots fill fast” is an unsupported availability claim.
Says 断缴 only affects "连续记录和当期待遇" and cites links generally without article numbers; the legal basis (社保法27条, 43号文12条, scope of 38号文) is not given.
“有审批时这7天大约在3724～6207元之间”：条件示例被转成金额范围；综合周期总工时未知，不能据此确定上限。
Gives only the cumulative gap ("还差12年") and never states the 24-month gap in actual Hangzhou contribution.
NTA No.1120/1410/1199 のリンクを挙げている。リンクは確認できるが、内容が主張と一致するかは答えからは確認できない。
LINE本文の「10月1日から有給休暇が付与されています」：説明部分には条件があるが、本文では未確認の8割出勤を満たしたものとして断定している。
「民法621条ただし書きにより」 misidentifies the provision: ordinary wear and aging are excluded in the parenthetical text, not the proviso.
"고용노동부와 법제처도 퇴직금 산정에 이 조항이 적용된다고 해석": 문서번호가 없어 확인할 수 없다. 키의 법제처-26-0209와 방향은 같다.

Special-clause test given as 「契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効」 (同ガイドライン): narrower than the 2005 Supreme Court rule, which also accepts the scope being written specifically in the contract, and it leaves out the necessity/reasonableness element. Minor.
Gives a specific Scenario-B figure ('按这4天32小时全超时粗算约2,482.76元') although the key says it cannot be computed from the given information; hedged as a rough upper bound ('若周期内总工时没超就是0').
称“在1年内申请劳动仲裁”：遗漏在职追讨欠薪不受一年时效限制、离职后一年内提出的特别规则。

"회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우에는 지급 방식이 조금 다르지만": confused. IRP is an individual account, and transfer to IRP also applies under the plain 퇴직금 system (over 300만 원, under 55), not only when the company has a pension plan

'基数要先按正常工资的70%计算…8000×70%×80%=4480元，并非6400元' is wrong: the old 70% base applied only when neither the labour contract nor the collective contract set a monthly wage. With an agreed 8000 salary the old 4-6 year tier gives 8000×80% = 6400 (key).
"하루 늦으면 그 사이 근저당·경매가 들어올 수 있습니다" is imprecise. The exposure runs from move-in until 0:00 of the day after the filing, and a same-day 근저당 still outranks. The answer does not say this.
把“近期生育、买房”列为适合补缴的情形：未证明此次补缴能恢复相应资格或待遇。

"spending $1,500 on stuff you wouldn't otherwise buy to save $680 is a loss": the math is muddled. On a carryover plan the $680 carries over anyway, and spending protects the $1,220 that would be forfeited, not $680.
「国交省の…ガイドラインでも」 and 「同ガイドライン」: these source attributions supply no checkable link or document number.
“把某一天的300%和200%对调”：10月3日仍应按法定节假日支付，不能因周六补假而任意交换适用日期。
Quote attributed to 人社部办公厅的相关通知 (在正常发放的当日工资（100%）之外，再额外支付300%): the notice is not identified, so unverifiable.
"HUG·HF ... 전입신고·확정일자 후 신청 가능" is generally true but loosely stated. It gives no eligibility or timing conditions.
"另加大病、长护险几十元": the key says the personal share of 大病/长护 is deducted from the 补划 personal-account funds, not paid as extra cash.
2026年分の基礎控除104万円に一切言及せず、所得税の判断材料が欠けている
「扶養に入っている場合、収入や申告が扶養判定に影響することがあります」 is misleading: claiming 医療費控除 does not change 合計所得金額, so filing for it cannot affect whether someone counts as a dependent.
「直前だと時季変更権…の余地が広がります」：申請が直前というだけで変更権が広がるとはキーから確認できず、正常な事業運営を妨げるという条件も説明していない。
회사가 이직확인서에 '자발적 사직'으로 올리면 1차로 반려될 수 있어요: the 반려 outcome is asserted without a source.
'一般也不能免除上面那 2 个月等待期' is stated as near-certain, but per the key whether paying the arrears removes the waiting period is unverified
"It's an employer plan account, not your money" is a loose legal characterization. It is unverifiable as stated.

"risks forfeiting roughly $1,220–$1,240": the $1,240 figure uses the 2025 $660 cap, which does not apply to a 2026 plan year (minor). The line also leaves out the no-feature branch, where all $1,900 is at risk.
“남은 수급기간의 절반을 조기재취업수당으로”: 남은 소정급여일수에 따른 금액이며, 신고 후 14일 경과·절반 이상 잔여·12개월 고용 등의 조건을 빠뜨렸다.
It never says the final decision rests with the Employment Center and only mentions that an appeal exists.
'北京高院2024年解答（一）第56条' on duty shifts (值班): the article number and content are unverifiable, and no link is given

'unless you changed the beneficiary ... which can restart the clock', repeated in the checklist, leans toward treating the reset as real. The key says this is unresolved with no IRS guidance, though the answer says 'can' and 'Confirm'.

Table row 3 says a company copying the old Shanghai method pays '8000 × 70% × 80% = 4480元' ('先按实得工资70%，再按4—6年80%'). The key says 83号 gives 80% for a 4-year employee, so 8000 × 80% = 6400. The 70% stacking is an invented rule and is also the 70% error the key penalises.
The sources are secondary pages (Savingforcollege.com 'updated Aug. 2026', IRAR). The links are checkable, but there are no IRS or statute citations.
“约定了加班费基数的，按约定；实际发放高于约定的，按实发”：把专门约定的加班基数与合同工资标准混为一谈，不能不加条件地以实际发放额覆盖约定。
「所得税5%で約850円…合わせて2,500円程度」: 基礎控除104万円・社会保険料控除に触れず、所得税の還付があるかのように断定。実際は課税所得0・源泉徴収税額0なら還付は0円で、得は主に住民税約1,700円。結論が過大
将“制度照搬旧上海算法”算成4480元，引入实得工资70%的基数；该额外规则未获答案键支持，键中照搬83号分档的示例为6400元。
Cites the 全宅連 explanatory PDF (rp2011_11.pdf) for the 6-year useful life. I did not open it, so it is unverified. The MLIT link does open a real MLIT guideline-related PDF.
“전세권 설정 등기 — 확정일자보다 강하지만”: 권리의 장단점과 순위를 단순화함. 기존 근저당보다 앞서지는 않으며 임대인 협조도 필요함.
“累计年限少7个月，对20年门槛几乎没影响”：影响取决于退休时的实际缺口，不能直接淡化。

"18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다" is wrong or unverified. An internet-registry 확정일자 filed after 18시 is granted on the next business day, and the 신고일 of an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 is unconfirmed. Stated as certain.

The state list (30 states follow federal; Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Utah and Vermont recapture deductions; Colorado, Missouri and New Jersey undecided) comes from one secondary survey (praetorianguard.biz). It is unverifiable and may be stale. California "earnings plus 2.5% penalty" is an acceptable reading, and the key treats whole versus earnings as unresolved.
“The reporting is cleaner” when both transactions occur in 2026 is an unsupported procedural assertion.
“워크넷 구직등록”: 종료된 경로이며 고용24로 안내해야 합니다.

"Grace period — you can incur expenses through March 15, 2026": wrong year (the latest possible date is March 15, 2027). It is also stated as a fixed date when March 15 is only the maximum and plans may set a shorter period.

Tells the asker to get a "letter stating your coverage start date and that it's based on current employment" as proof for Part B. The required proof is form CMS-L564, which is never named, so this is incomplete and could point the asker to the wrong document.
Opens by saying the Part B penalty applies to people who go without "creditable coverage". Creditable coverage is the Part D term, so this is imprecise for Part B.
「2027年2月16日〜3月15日に確定申告」：還付申告を通常の申告期間に限定する案内。2027年1月1日から2031年12月31日まで提出できる。

'If you transfer more than the eligible amount, the excess is a nonqualified withdrawal, tax and 10% penalty on the earnings' covers only the 529 side. It omits the 6% Roth excise and the $40,500 figure for moving all $48,000.
“You usually have until March–April to submit receipts” adds an unverified typical deadline; the plan sets its run-out deadline.
「出せない請求は、根拠も怪しいことが多い」：頻度を裏付ける根拠がなく、検証不能。
“18시를 넘겼다면 … 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다”는 틀립니다. 인터넷등기소 확정일자는 금요일 18시 이후 신청하면 다음 근무일에 부여됩니다. 정부24의 근무시간 외 신고 처리일도 단정할 근거가 없습니다.
“지급기일 연장에 합의한 사실이 없다는”: the ready-to-send message asserts a fact the request does not establish.
Says flatly "不建议补". The reasoning (8年7个月 still short of 10 and 20) is sound, but the key treats 补缴 as optional and dependent on later years, so this is firmer than the evidence.
'10月3日恰逢周六，公司若主张按补假日折算，只会把某一天的300%和200%对调，7天总额不变': confusing reasoning with no source; harmless because the total is unchanged.
"Your coworker would be right" for an employer under 20 employees: wrong; employer size determines payer order, not eligibility for the employment-based SEP.
"Risks forfeiting roughly $1,220-$1,240" is a range that mixes the 2026 figure ($1,220) with the 2025 figure ($1,240). It is hedged, but the $1,240 end is stale.
Cites Labor Contract Law art. 26 for 'violates mandatory provisions of law'. That is 26(1)(3), not the key's 26(1)(2). The principle is right.
Same “连续缴费年限…重新计算” framing for employee insurance; per the key, “重新计算” appears only in the resident major-illness reward. Unverifiable.

Asks whether the plan will check "Box 4b" on Form 1099-Q for a 529-to-Roth transfer: the key does not cover this, so it is unverifiable here. It is plausible from my own knowledge of the revised form.
Says 补缴 costs 473.67元/月 and then "另加大病、长护险几十元". The key says these are deducted from the personal-account funds credited by the 补缴, with no extra cash.
Step 3 says 전입신고 should be done "계약서 명의자 본인이": not in the key. The required filer is overstated, because the person moving in or a household member can file. I judge this from my own knowledge.
"目前仅支持线下办理，带身份证或市民卡去区医保经办机构": unverifiable procedural claim, not in the key
“断缴3个月以内补缴，才不设等待期、可追溯待遇”：遗漏43号文适用于跨统筹区转移或职工、居民医保切换的条件，不能概括为一般断缴规则。
Recommended order "체불임금 회수 → 수급자격 신청": putting wage recovery first delays the benefit claim, against the advice to file immediately. The 12-month benefit period runs from the day after leaving.
“18시를 넘겼다면…그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다”는 틀립니다. 인터넷등기소 확정일자는 금요일 18시 이후 신청하면 다음 근무일에 부여되며, 정부24 야간 신고의 처리일도 확인되지 않았습니다.
「この1万7,000円を損します」は所得控除額と実際の節税額を混同させる表現。現金の損失が1万7,000円になるわけではない。
Says 'the company got two things wrong' but lists three numbered points. Minor inconsistency.
Cites Medicare.gov and Federal Register (govinfo FR-2025-11-19) links as sources: checkable links given, but page contents not confirmed here.

"Well over Medicare's 20-employee threshold. That lets you delay Part B with no late-enrollment penalty": imprecise. Employer size is not a condition of the SEP; it decides which plan pays first. B's later under-20 explanation is right in practice (minor).
「LINEで残しておくと、『言った言わない』になりません」 overstates what keeping a written record guarantees.
"一般也不能免除上面那 2 个月等待期": unverifiable. The key marks waiting-period exemption after back-payment as unverified either way. B hedges with 一般 but still states it as fact.
日焼けの黄ばみに経過年数の減価計算（耐用年数6年、残存価値ゼロ）を当てて説明している。日焼けは通常損耗であり計算以前に負担義務がない、という整理にはなっていない（軽微）。
“另可能补扣……几十元”未说明从补划个人账户扣减、不另交现金，容易让人误以为3,315.69元之外还需现金缴费。

"18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다" — wrong or overconfident: an internet 확정일자 filed after 18:00 is given the next working day (Mon 10-26), and the key says the 정부24 off-hours filing date is unconfirmed and must not be asserted.
代办者“多半是骗钱或伪造材料”：材料没有支持这一比例判断的证据。
"Confirm the office will charge before the 15th" uses the payment date instead of the date care is provided.

劳部发〔1997〕271号第四条 quoted as 应另外支付不低于工资的300%: from memory, that sentence sits in the Q&A item on rest-day and holiday overtime (item 三), not 第四条. The article number is likely wrong or at least unverifiable.
'也可以在 1 年内申请劳动仲裁': oversimplified; while still employed, wage-arrears claims are not bound by the one-year limit (only within one year after leaving).
“按现行口径，也不会缩短重新参保后的等待期”: stated as certain, but whether back-payment waives the waiting period is unverified in the key; it should be hedged with “ask the office”
“503号……和……157号……都要求向区人社局申报”：把北京具体审批机关的规定同时归给全国性审批办法，表述不准确。
「少額調停」: 標準的な手続名ではない（民事調停または少額訴訟のことか）。不正確。
"Most do by 2026, but not all" (plans that support the transfer): no source given, so unverifiable.

Says 10月3日恰逢周六 and the company may 按补假日折算, swapping a 300% day with a 200% day. This is confusing and unnecessary, because the key treats 3日 as a statutory holiday. The total stays 7034.48, so the arithmetic is not wrong.
'고용노동부 실무는 통상임금을 적용하는 쪽입니다' is unverifiable.
「基礎控除が104万円に上がっているため、所得税自体が約1,000円と小さい」は、社会保険料控除を無視した計算。実際は所得税が0円になりやすい。
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금” uses the outdated penalty; the key specifies five years or 50 million won.
'남은 수급기간의 절반을 조기재취업수당': 실제는 남은 소정급여일수 x 일액 x 1/2이고, 소정일수 1/2 이상 남기고 12개월 이상 고용돼야 한다는 조건이 빠짐
“0571-89583017”: hotline number; unverifiable.
"coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form": under current rules, SEP coverage starts the month after you sign up, not after processing. Minor imprecision.
The 1350 link (id=1000294486) is offered as support but I did not open it, so what it says is unverifiable
Table shows 413.79×300%×3 = 3724.14. Multiplying by the rounded 413.79 gives 3724.11; 3724.14 comes from the unrounded figure. The key accepts both, so this is cosmetic.
'1,020만~1,030만 원 사이'라는 범위는 통상임금 하한을 누락해 가능한 지급액을 과도하게 좁힌다.
「効果があるのは住民税だけ」：所得税額・源泉徴収税額が未確認なので限定できない。

Step 3's "smallest of $7,500; his 2026 earned income; [eligible portion]" and "earned income at least equal to the amount rolled over" leave out his other IRA contributions. With $4,000 earned and $2,000 contributed, this gives $4,000, but the correct figure is $2,000 (step 8 only partly fixes this).
"spending $1,500 on stuff you wouldn't otherwise buy to save $680 is a loss": the numbers don't match any real scenario (at the $680 cap the spend-down is $1,220), so this is confused
Says 补缴 "一般也不能免除上面那2个月等待期". The key marks a waiting-period waiver after 补缴 as unverified, so this is a mildly firm claim, though softened with "一般".
'Most do by 2026, but not all' (plans supporting the rollover) is unverifiable.
생계비 융자 '연 1.5%': 시점 없이 적음. 키 기준 10월 현재는 한시 1.0%(2026.9.1~10.31), 1.5%는 11월부터
"you usually have until March–April to submit receipts": run-out periods vary by plan; generic and unverifiable, though hedged with "usually"
Cites 《杭州市基本医疗保障办法》第五十五条 for transfer and continued accumulation of years; the article number is not verifiable from the packet, and the key rests on 社保法27条 / 43号文.
'7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다' - overclaim; the test is a 60-day sum of unpaid or late days, so a few days late each month may not qualify
“你离退休还远”“这两个条件都还不急”：用户没有提供年龄或退休时间。
“10월 4일이 법정 기한…21일”: the subtraction is correct, but the exact legal deadline is not established.
“另可能补扣大病保险48元/年、长护险等几十元”: implies an extra cash charge, while the key says these are deducted from the re-credited personal-account funds (hedged with 可能 and 以核定单为准, so a minor issue)

京劳社资发〔2005〕94号 and the Xicheng office guide on union opinion and publicity materials: links are given but I did not open them, so these are unchecked. The other links I opened (gov.cn notice 国办发明电〔2025〕7号, the Fengtai court report, the ACFTU explainer, the Beijing HRSS Q&A) all match what A says
Table row "制度照搬旧上海算法（先按实得工资70%，再按4—6年80%）= 4480" is unverifiable and conflicts with the key's 6400 for 83号 tiers. It also never says when the base would be 8000 and not 70%.
“503号……和……157号……都要求向区人社局申报”：将北京的审批机关规定泛化到全国审批办法；依据法律知识判断，表述不准确。
"最好在11月新单位增员前"办理补缴: no source or reason is given for this timing, so it is unverifiable.
「残存価値はゼロ」「仮に借主負担が生じる場合でも…負担額は0円」：残存価値は1円。過失による破損では工事費・人件費が残りうるため、請求額まで一律0円とはいえない。
10월 30일까지 지급 요청, 10월 30일 이후 진정: 임의로 정한 날짜이며 법정 기한이 아님(제안으로는 무해)
“이직일부터 12개월”: the period starts the day after separation.
Says back payment is 目前仅支持线下办理 at the district office with an ID card or 市民卡: unverifiable.
Cites TKC, 財務省 and keisan.nta.go.jp URLs. Links are given but not opened
The 1350 link (id=1000294810) opened and is a real Q&A on resigning because of wage arrears, so it is not an error.
“식대·차량보조 등 통상임금이 아닌 항목”: 명칭만으로 통상임금에서 제외할 수 없으며, 키에도 이런 분류 근거가 없다.
Cites 《杭州市基本医疗保障办法》第五十五条 for accumulation after a transfer. The article number is unverifiable, and the link goes to a third-party reprint.
Three Medicare.gov URLs are given as citations. None can be checked from the packet, so they are unverifiable. I found no specific error in them.
Retirement steps omit CMS-L564, CMS-40B and the Part D 2-month window, offering only an HR letter. This is an omission, not an error.
增加“合同沿用旧‘本人工资=实得工资70%’”的4480元口径：包内依据不足以确认该基数规则及其现行适用性。
“빌라는 근저당이 잡힌 경우가 적지 않아” adds an unsupported prevalence claim.
“浙里办—浙里医保”的具体查询路径及入职前先停灵活就业的操作要求：材料未核实。
Cites 北京高院2024年解答(一)第56条 on 值班 overtime, with no link or text. Unverifiable.
The 'smallest of' formula mishandles compensation below $7,500: $4,000 earned and $2,000 already contributed produces $4,000, but the correct remaining room is $2,000.
“退休补缴标准还会随省平工资上涨”：标准每年调整不等于未来必然上涨。
"Call Social Security at 1-800-772-1213 and ask about withdrawing it before it takes effect": the number is correct, but the withdrawal procedure is not covered by the key and is unverified.
「所得税は0円…医療費控除で所得税は戻りません」 is stated as certain, but the answer never says to check the 源泉徴収税額 field on the 源泉徴収票, and it does not give the about-850円 fallback for the case where some tax was withheld.

"설령 합의로 미뤘더라도 지연이자는 원칙적으로 그대로 붙어요(고용노동부 행정해석)": no document number given, so unverifiable. By my own knowledge the 행정해석 usually starts the interest after the agreed extended date, so this is probably wrong.
「北京高院2024年解答（一）第56条」on duty shifts not earning overtime pay: article number and wording unverifiable, no link
Gives retaliation (2N damages) and 加付50%至100%赔偿金 without citing articles. These are plausible but unverified, and they lengthen the answer beyond what was asked.
LINE文面が有給の請求になっておらず、「代わりに入れる日…対応します」と穴埋めを申し出ているため、欠勤扱いで処理されても文面上は矛盾しない(誤りではないが前提訂正と噛み合わない)
Says 连续缴费年限 is used only for 生育津贴等少数待遇 and does not affect retirement: not covered by the key, unverifiable.
'14일을 넘기면' 벌칙과 지연이자가 붙는다는 설명은 유효한 지급기일 연장과 지연이자 적용 제외 사유를 구분하지 않는다.
"All $1,900 stays usable, but only through March 15" treats the maximum grace period as the actual period; plans may provide less time.
Advises doing the back payment 最好在11月新单位增员前 and gives the route 浙里办 搜 医保补缴 or 灵活就业参保: unverifiable.
"我能不能以灵活就业身份补3–9月": wrong months. She stopped paying after March and resumes in November, so the gap is April to October (4–10月), which A itself counts as 7 months elsewhere.
"민원마당에 진정": outdated name for MOEL's online petition channel (now 노동포털); minor

"The transfer must be completed by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 annual limit": wrong per the key. A rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027 (2026 Form 5498 instructions, 219(f)(3)). The follow-on line "There is no separate December 31 deadline for the rollover itself" is muddled.
The "전입세대 열람" step for 선순위 세입자 is stated without checking who may request it or when. Plausible but unverified.
将“降薪、调岗或辞退”一并连接到违法解除及2N：降薪、调岗本身不等于解除劳动合同，救济条件需要区分。
The HR text and section 1 cite the delay interest under '근로자퇴직급여 보장법 제17조'. The 연 20% rate comes from 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조, so the statute cited to the HR team is wrong.
“이의제기 → 심사청구 순” presents an unverified mandatory appeal sequence.

"But the 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary": states a settled rule on the 15-year reset after a beneficiary change, which is unresolved and has no IRS guidance. Elsewhere A hedges with "can restart".
「民法上の原状回復義務に…含まれないのが判例・通説」: 2020年4月施行の民法621条ただし書きで明文化済み。条文に触れず、判例・通説とだけ書くのは不正確。
Links penalty-free delay to being "above the 20-employee threshold": imprecise, because size is not an SEP condition. Minor.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 대상입니다(제44조)": outdated; since 2026.9.18 it is 제43조, 5년 이하 징역 또는 5천만 원 이하 벌금 (minor per key)
The S. 5550 claim (introduced September 24, 2026, referred to Finance, would remove the aggregate cap) is verified at the cited govinfo page. It is extra but correct.
"퇴사 후 14일 안에 청산하지 않으면 바로 진정할 수 있습니다": misleading; a complaint can be filed at any time, including while still employed, so there is no need to wait 14 days
“전입세대 열람으로 선순위 임차인도 확인 가능” overstates what residency records establish; they alone do not determine other tenants’ legal priority.
Lists 上海人社局, 中伦 and Ebner Stolz links as sources. The packet gives no way to confirm that the pages say what is claimed.
Says the 法定节假日 part cannot be 包干 and that Beijing always uses 正常劳动应得工资 as the base; stated more firmly than the evidence allows.
「クリーニング」 is listed as excluded without qualification. Scaling done as treatment (歯石除去) is covered; only cosmetic cleaning is excluded.
Recommending补缴 for imminent childbirth, home purchase or settlement implies benefits that the packet does not establish.
"반려되면 이의제기 → 심사청구 순": unverifiable. The formal remedies are 심사청구 and then 재심사청구, and no formal 이의제기 stage is shown.

Scenario B: '按这4天32小时全超时粗算约2,482.76元' and '有审批时这7天大约在3,724～6,207元之间'. The key says the 150% amount cannot be computed from the facts given. The arithmetic is right (9000/21.75/8×1.5×32 = 2,482.76), and B does add '若周期内总工时没超就是0'. Still, comprehensive-hours overtime is counted over the whole period and cannot be tied to these days, so the range is speculative.

"전입세대 열람" at the 주민센터 with the contract to see senior tenants, and the rule that mortgage ceiling plus senior deposits above the house price means rethinking the contract — not in the key; plausible but unverifiable here.
“실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분…지금 미리 신청” invents a residual job-seeking allowance entitlement and ignores the possible six-month exclusion after unemployment benefits.
The closing tip that 买房、落户、车牌摇号 count "连续社保" and are hit by the gap: not tied to any source, off-topic padding, and the rules were not checked.
"可能另扣大病保险等几十元": the key says the personal 大病保险/长护险 amounts are deducted from the 补划 personal-account funds with no extra cash, so this contradicts it, and the "几十元" figure is unverified.
Says 可能另扣大病保险等几十元. The key says these come out of the personal account credited by the back payment, so the wording is ambiguous and may imply a separate charge.
「社会保険料控除 約20〜40万円」: 依頼文にない前提の仮定。幅のある推定で根拠なし
건강보험료 감면: the real measure is an income-based premium adjustment, so the wording is loose. Unverifiable.
No 간이대지급금, no amounts and no 소정급여일수 are given. These are omissions and not errors.

Case B: computes a specific 150% figure (32 hours, about 2482.76 yuan, total about 6206.90 yuan). The key says this cannot be computed from the information given. The figure is hedged as 'if all 32 hours are cycle overtime', but it is still an invented amount that rests on an assumed 8 hours a day.
'법제처 해석(2026. 5. 26.)' gives a date that is unverifiable, although the number 26-0209 matches the key.
'申请劳动仲裁，免费，时效1年' oversimplifies the time limit: while still employed, a claim for unpaid wages is not bound by the one-year limit, and the year runs from leaving the job (劳动争议调解仲裁法第27条)
「直前だと時季変更権の余地が広がります」: a plausible reading of case law, stated without support (judged from my own knowledge, not checked).
“只要……实际在做调度工作、不能自由休息，就属于加班”：表述过于绝对；实际履行工作职责能帮助区分值班，但是否属于加班仍须结合适用工时制度判断。
"Satisfied (opened 2004)" prematurely treats the 15-year test as established without beneficiary history; the later caveat only partially repairs this.
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”: outdated; the key gives five years or 50 million won from September 18, 2026.
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」：給与明細に有給日数が記載されるとは限らず、この職場で確認できるかは不明。
"건강보험료 감면" for the unemployed is stated without conditions; unverified.
'임금이 밀리거나 늦게 지급돼서 그만둔 경우는 자발적 퇴사로 보지 않고' mischaracterizes the law. It is still a 자기사정 이직 that is allowed through a 정당한 사유 exception.
“14号已于2026年8月15日到期失效” states a definite conclusion where the key records inferred expiry without explicit official confirmation.
「少額調停」: based on general legal knowledge, this is not the formal procedure name; civil mediation and small-claims litigation are distinct.
“근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다” adds an unsupported frequency claim.
“断缴3个月以内补缴，才不设等待期、可追溯待遇”遗漏跨统筹区转移或职工、居民医保切换的适用条件，泛化了国家规定。

Advises checking that the day is treated as 「事前に承認された休暇」 rather than 欠勤. That is not a legal category: an approved unpaid day off is still unpaid, so it is no substitute for designating paid leave, and it misleads.
国交省ガイドラインの根拠として、民間の管理会社系ブログ（kurashitokanri.jpm.jp）を「国交省ガイドライン関連の解説」として挙げている。一次資料ではなく、内容を確認できなかった。
Cites 《劳动合同法》第26条 for 违反强制性规定 (that is item 三) instead of the key's item 二 (免除用人单位法定责任、排除劳动者权利). The article is right but the ground is imprecise. Minor.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 (제44조)": outdated. Since 2026-09-18 it is 제43조, 5년/5천만 원 (minor deduction per key)

"the 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary" (in the change-beneficiary option) is stated as settled. The key says the reset is unresolved with no IRS guidance. Elsewhere A hedges with "can restart".
Says to sign up for Part D "within 63 days" of losing creditable drug coverage. The Part D SEP is 2 full months. 63 days is the penalty-free gap, so this is a conservative approximation.
"CMS-L564 form (your employer fills it out)": incomplete procedural instruction; the applicant completes Section A and the employer completes Section B.
“14일이 지나면 … 연 20%의 지연이자가 붙습니다”: 법정 적용 제외 사유가 있어 무조건 발생한다고 단정하기는 어렵다.
'The limits may rise with inflation, which would shorten the schedule' is doubtful, since at $8,000 a year it still takes five years.
“报销比例不跟连续年限挂钩”“多补7个月不会让退休报销比例更高”：答案键未核实这些待遇规则，本次未外部核验。
"the run-out period, often ~90 days after year-end": a typical-practice figure with no source, and it varies by plan.
"설령 합의로 미뤘더라도 지연이자는 원칙적으로 그대로 붙어요(고용노동부 행정해석)": cites an administrative interpretation with no number or link, so it is unverifiable
Tells the user to file 2027年2月16日〜3月15日 and never mentions that a 還付申告 can be filed from 1月1日 for 5 years; the key penalises limiting it to 3月15日
Says 令和8年度税制改正 rests on a 2025年12月 閣議決定; plausible but not checked

Says the Part B late penalty 'applies to people who go without creditable coverage'. 'Creditable coverage' is the Part D concept; the Part B rule turns on current-employment group coverage and the SEP. Conflates the two.
'회사에 임금체불로 인한 퇴사임을 내용증명이나 문자로 남겨두세요' - practical advice with no source, not in the key
고용노동부 퇴직금 계산기 링크(moel.go.kr/retirementpayCal.do)와 생활법령 링크: 확인되지 않은 출처 표기다.
“正常上班到退休只会超过，不会不够”：不知道年龄及未来缴费情况，无法保证。
“合同没约定，按正常劳动应得工资”：遗漏北京规定中先看集体合同约定的中间层级。
"run-out period, often ~90 days after year-end": a typical figure but unverifiable; it varies by plan (minor).
'퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우'라는 설명은 퇴직연금제도와 개인 IRP 계좌를 혼동한다. IRP 이전 의무는 퇴직금제도에도 적용된다.
Treats "连续缴费年限" as a separate count that "断缴3个月以上会重新计算". The key finds no such reset for 职工医保 in Hangzhou, and only the waiting period applies, so the framing is loose.
The letter to HR cites neither 劳部发〔1995〕309号第59条 nor 沪人社规〔2026〕10号第九条, and does not ask whether 800 is gross or net. 309号 appears only as a link title.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 ... 제44조": outdated penalty. The key says 5년/5천만 원 under 제43조 since 2026.9.18 (minor deduction).

Cites 근로자퇴직급여 보장법 제17조 as the basis of the 연 20% 지연이자, both in the explanation and inside the HR text. The key puts it in 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조, so the cited article is wrong and would weaken the message if sent as written.
퇴직 후 건강보험료가 지역가입자로 바뀐다: 맞는 말이다(임의계속가입 선택지는 빠짐). 키에 없는 유용한 추가 정보다.
“你离退休还远”: assumes the user's age, which the request never gives. B's advice not to back-pay rests on this assumption.
Cites a 울산 남구 대현동 page for 확정일자. I opened it: it confirms 수수료 600원 and 계약서 원본, but it does not say the two can be done at the same visit, and it is another city's office, not Seoul
"Grace period: you can incur expenses through March 15" / "counts only if it's dated on or before March 15": overstated. March 15 is the latest a plan can set, and plans may choose a shorter period.
Says 미지급 시 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금. The key says this is the old rule and the penalty is 5년/5천만 원 from 2026.9.18 (minor deduction).
Penalty '3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(같은 법 제44조 제1호)' is the old rule; the key says that since 2026.9.18 it is 제43조, 5 years or 50 million won (minor deduction).
The links (rsj.sh.gov.cn 83号 extension, 20260731 new measure, mohrss 309号) cannot be verified from the answer. The Zhonglun link is real (opened).

"18시를 넘겼다면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 전자확정일자로 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다": wrong. An 인터넷등기소 확정일자 applied for after 18:00 on Friday is granted on the next working day (Mon 10-26). The answer also states as fact that a 정부24 전입신고 filed out of hours counts that same day, which is unverified.
“7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘게 충족”: three delayed paydays do not establish the required delay duration or unpaid amount.

"신청은 퇴사 다음 날부터 12개월 이내": treats the 12-month benefit period (제48조) as an application deadline. If you apply late, the remaining benefit days are lost, so the framing is misleading. The answer softens this by saying to apply this week.
Grace period given as ending March 15, 2026 against 2025 funds; the March dental work falls in March 2027, so the date is the wrong year.
Table says 连续缴费年限 "会重新计算" for 职工医保; the key says 重新计算 appears only in 居民医保 reward rules. Loose and unsupported.

国家医保局的口径也是：断缴3个月以内补缴，才不设等待期、可追溯待遇 - this treats the rule as general. 43号文第十一条 only covers transfers between pooling regions or switching between employee and resident insurance. The answer still concludes correctly that it does not apply to her.
Gives a specific Scenario-B figure ('最多约2482.76元', total up to 6206.90元) although the key says it cannot be computed from the given information; hedged as an upper bound but still a headline number.
「残存価値はゼロ」: ガイドラインの残存価値は1円であり不正確（結論の0円は同じ）。算定式も示していない
The '1,040만 안팎' midpoint and the '89~92일' span are hedged estimates, not the exact 92-day figure (107,609 won per day, about 10.24 million won).

"Leaving the full $1,900 untouched risks forfeiting roughly $1,220–$1,240": the $1,240 end of the range uses the 2025 $660 cap, which does not apply to a 2026 plan year. The sentence also understates the no-feature case, where all $1,900 is at risk (minor).
Cites a Linping district and a Xiaoshan district Q&A as 依据. Their content cannot be verified from the packet.
Does not cite Labor Contract Law art. 26(1)(2). The point that a signature does not waive the right is argued only in general terms.
'The 529 plan probably will not verify his income or other contributions' is unverifiable.
浙里办具体菜单、税务缴费路径、“补缴超过1个月通常要去窗口”及材料清单：答案键未核实这些操作细节，本次未外部核验。
"위반건축물이면 가입이 막힐 수 있고 ... HUG·HF 가입 요건이 까다롭고": plausible but unsourced.
"Must be completed by December 31, 2026" and "it becomes a 2027 rollover" contradict the federal April 15, 2027 designation window, subject to provider processing.

"to count for 2026 the money needs to land in the Roth by December 31, 2026" and "a January arrival may count against 2027" treat December as the deadline. A rollover designated for 2026 can run to April 15, 2027, though plans vary.
"you usually have until March-April to submit receipts": typical run-out range, unverifiable as a general claim
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」: 給与明細に有給日数が載るとは限らず、検証できない。
「所得税は0円」「効果があるのは住民税だけ」 are unsupported certainties; the necessary deductions and withholding amount are unknown.
「戻る税金は所得税が約850円…合わせて2,500円ほど」と所得税の還付を断定している。基礎控除104万円と社会保険料控除で課税所得が0になり、源泉徴収税額が0なら所得税の還付は0円になる可能性が高い。源泉徴収票の確認にも触れておらず、得を過大に見せる。
“Coverage generally starts the month after Social Security processes your form” incorrectly ties coverage commencement to processing.
Opens with 800 元肯定不合法 before separating gross from net. If 800 is net pay, the key says it is still illegal on the majority reading but doubtful on the minority one, so 肯定 is somewhat overconfident.
称“上海人社局尚未发布新的分档规定”：将标准答案中有限核查下的“未找到”扩大为确定的不存在。
基礎控除104万円の適用範囲を「合計所得132万円以下」としているが、キーでは489万円以下。
"If you change jobs, the whole balance ... is gone" omits the COBRA exception and is overly absolute.
「民法上の原状回復義務に…含まれないのが判例・通説です」: outdated basis. Since 2020-04-01 this is written into 民法621条, which the answer never cites (minor)
'为什么不再是当然的6400元' implies the old 83号 method gave 6400, which contradicts its own table showing 4480 for the old method. The two figures are inconsistent.
Says that adding the sentence 「早期解決のため例外的に応じる」 prevents a later finding that the tenant 「納得して払った」. This overstates the legal effect and is unverifiable.
The KFF, ARPI and Federal Register/govinfo links are given as sources with nothing checkable beyond the URLs. ARPI is not an official source. Unverifiable.
“고용노동부…도…해석합니다”: the ministry attribution lacks a checkable interpretation citation; the packet establishes the Ministry of Government Legislation interpretation.
“문자를 보내두는 것 자체가 … 증거” and “합의했다는 말을 막을 수 있습니다”: sending a message does not itself establish that no extension agreement existed.
「具体的に書かれ、重要事項説明でその説明を受けていた…事情がない限り」: misleadingly presents written specification plus an important-matters explanation as necessary; the key recognizes alternative ways to establish clear agreement.
「休みが認められたら『事前に承認された休暇』として扱われているか確認」: 承認が成立要件であるかのような含みがあり、有給は承認不要という点と整合しない
The Medicare.gov "Working past 65" and "When can I sign up" URLs and the shiphelp.org link are cited as sources. They could not be verified from the packet, though they are plausible.
Opening '800 元肯定不合法' is stated flatly although the 应发/实发 question is unresolved (under the minority view, net pay near 800 is open to doubt). Section 二 later hedges this, so the error is minor.
中介“多半是骗钱或伪造材料”：比例判断未获题包支持。
“하루 6만6,048~6만8,100원” presents the eight-hour minimum without establishing daily working hours.
‘하루 6만6,048~6만8,100원’ presents the eight-hour minimum without establishing daily working hours.
Cites a 163.com article and a bendibao page: the links cannot be checked from the packet.
「少額調停」: this is not a formal procedure name (the formal one is 民事調停). Minor and unverifiable as written.
"另加大病、长护险几十元": contradicts the key, which says these are deducted from the re-credited personal account funds, with no extra cash.
“생계비 융자까지 받으면 석 달은 확보”: eligibility, payment timing, expenses and available funds are unknown, so three months of coverage cannot be guaranteed.
Says 若是外地户口，这条路可能走不通 because she has only 8 years. This blurs the 居住证加就业登记 route, which does not need 10 years.
「所得税自体が約1,000円と小さいです」 sits next to 「約850円」 and the two figures do not fit together. It also assumes no 社会保険料控除 and gives no basis for it.
"구직촉진수당(월 50만원, 최대 6개월)": the 2026 amount is unverified (the key does not penalize it, but it needs checking). It is listed as a source alongside 구직급여 even though receiving 구직급여 can exclude it.
'남은 수급기간의 절반을 조기재취업수당으로' - imprecise; it is 1/2 of the remaining 소정급여일수 x 일액, and requires at least half of the days left plus 12 months of employment
称网上很多答案写旧标准是因为页面发表于2026年8月15日前：未提供支持这一概括的证据。
「2027年2月16日〜3月15日に確定申告」 misleadingly confines the recommended filing window; this refund claim can be filed from January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2031.
“如果9000是到手工资，基数更高”：到手金额不足以确定加班工资基数，结论缺少工资构成及约定条件。
Puts “安排劳动者在法定休假日工作的,按300%” in quotation marks as Beijing regulation text. I opened the gov.cn text of Article 16: it says “应当按照本规定第十四条第(三)项的规定支付加班工资”, so this is a paraphrase presented as a quote.

"如果800元是扣完个人社保、公积金后的实发金额……公司可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额": this takes the minority reading as the outcome and does not say the point is disputed; the majority view (the 14号 text, CMS) is that the minimum excludes personal contributions, so 800 net would still be unlawful
称应发2192元、实发800元时“能主张的差额会少很多”：未说明多数口径仍要求实发达到2192元，该结论不能确定。
'퇴직소득세가 원천징수되어 실수령액은 조금 줄어듭니다' ignores that an IRP transfer means no withholding at payment. It is vague, with no wrong figure given.
“석 달치 임금”: 지급이 늦었다는 사실을 석 달치 전액이 아직 미지급된 것으로 바꿨습니다.
"7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘게 충족": overclaim. The test is a cumulative 60 days of full delay or non-payment, not a count of late months, so three late months may not qualify.
'Not every 529 plan has its rollover process running smoothly yet' and 'December is a busy month for processors' are unverifiable generalities.
Cites "《劳动法》第44条第3款". Art. 44 is split into 项, not 款, though 157号's own text uses the same wording. Cosmetic only.

"If you contributed in 2021-2026, that money isn't eligible": too broad; the lookback is the 5 years before the transfer date, so 2021 contributions made more than 5 years before a late-2026 transfer do qualify
「付与日数は…給与明細で確認できます」: this employer's payslip contents are unverified; payslips do not necessarily show leave entitlement (general payroll knowledge).
“10월 30일 이후 노동청에 진정”: 그때까지 기다려야 할 근거가 없으며, 법정 기한이 지났다면 바로 진정할 수 있다.
'워크넷 구직등록 후': wrong. WorkNet has closed and been merged into 고용24.
A check to the son does not automatically create 'an excess Roth contribution'; that requires an actual Roth contribution exceeding applicable eligibility or limits.
Deadline "10월 4일" stated as fixed: the key says the deadline falls between 10/3 and 10/6 depending on how the retirement date and holidays are counted (minor)
Attributes the expiry of both 83号 and 14号 to the 上海人社局答复; per the key, the official reply confirmed only 83号, and 14号's expiry is a presumption with no explicit official statement. Overstated.
“目前仅支持线下办理”及“带身份证或市民卡”的材料要求：答案键未核实，本次未外部核验。
“10월 4일이 법정 기한”, “21일 지났어요”: 키는 퇴직일 해석과 휴일 계산에 따라 정확한 기한을 확정하지 않는다.

"The Part B late-enrollment penalty ... applies to people who go without creditable coverage": wrong framing. The Part B SEP depends on a group health plan based on current employment, not on 'creditable coverage' (a Part D term). Retiree or COBRA coverage can be creditable for drugs and still not protect against the Part B penalty.
“在1年内申请劳动仲裁” misleadingly suggests a general one-year deadline; the key exempts wage arrears claims during employment and specifies one year after departure.
The extras (증액 재계약 시 확정일자 재취득, 경매 시 배당요구, 다가구 선순위 보증금) are generally correct, so no error is listed.
“已经发过……节日补贴，要抵扣”：节日补贴不能仅凭名称当然抵扣法定加班工资。
「少額訴訟（60万円以下）：…費用も数万円程度です」: wrong. The filing fee for a claim around 10–12万円 is a few thousand yen, not several tens of thousands
“近两年要孩子才需留意”：两年的界限没有依据。
“퇴직 후 건강보험료가 지역가입자로 바뀌니” is categorical; general knowledge allows exceptions such as dependent status or continued employee coverage.
“퇴직소득세를 공제한 실수령액은 이보다 적습니다”: fails to distinguish cash payment or withdrawal from IRP transfer, for which withholding is deferred.
“近12个月平均应发工资作为基数”：答案键未支持这一替代算法，也未说明适用条件，不能直接作为本案北京加班费基数规则。
特約は「契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効」は条件を誤って限定している。具体的な書面記載による合意もあり、必要性・合理性などの検討も必要。
「内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」：同条が内訳提示を敷金控除の法定条件として定めているわけではない。
“전입세대 열람으로 선순위 임차인도 확인 가능” overstates what that record establishes: prior registration alone does not establish another tenant’s legal priority.
'Only happens if you're ... still enrolled' presents an unverified, plan-dependent enrollment condition as universal.
S. 5550 (introduced September 24, 2026, referred to Finance, would eliminate the aggregate limit) checked on govinfo and correct.
Cites 劳部发〔1997〕271号 articles 4 and 5 with quoted wording. The document exists and a secondary source supports the 300% and 一般不安排补休 content, but the article numbers and exact quotes are unverified.
The HR message says the amount "세전 약 1,200만 원으로 산정됩니다" as if settled, though it depends on what the 330만 is made of, as B admits in its own body text.
"He is 22" is not established: someone born in 2004 could still be 21 on the request date.

Under the approved scheme it computes a concrete figure: 最多约2482.76元 (32小时×51.72×150%), total 3724.14—6206.90元. The key says this cannot be computed from the facts given; the 最多 also assumes 8 hours on each of the 4 days.
"Enrolling now [in Part A] is often sensible" omits the 10-year work-history condition and that Part A pays second (minor omission, not an error).
“12개월 안에 신청”: 12개월은 단순 신청기한이 아니라 급여를 받을 수 있는 기간이므로 늦게 신청하면 지급일수를 잃을 수 있습니다.
"Scholarships ... don't count" is overbroad: qualifying taxable scholarships and graduate-study stipends can count. Checked [IRS Publication 590-A](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p590a).
“你现在还在职，时效上问题不大”：忽略标准答案提示的加班费时效适用口径差异，保证过强。
'法定节假日的工时不计入综合计算周期的总工时': no Beijing source is given and the key does not cover it, so it is unverifiable as a rule
'sign up for Part D within 63 days of losing creditable drug coverage': loose. The Part D SEP is 2 full months after coverage ends; 63 days is the penalty threshold.
'집이 팔리거나 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 권리': oversimplified. In an auction, 대항력 holds only if it ranks ahead of the 말소기준권리.
「来月の休みは有給で取れる可能性が高いです」: 10月1日付与と5日という具体値を示さず、不必要にぼかしている（誤りではないが弱い）
“4주마다 실업인정”: 일반적인 제도 지식상 인정 주기는 달라질 수 있어 일률적인 설명은 부정확합니다.

Says arbitration limitation is 时效1年 with no qualification. The key says an in-service employee chasing unpaid wages is not bound by the one-year limit, which applies only within one year after leaving. This is a small oversimplification.
이직확인서를 회사가 안 써주면 고용센터에 발급 요청하면 된다: 이직확인서 없이도 신청할 수 있다는 점과 회사에 10일 내 발급 의무가 있다는 점이 빠졌다. 고용센터가 직접 발급한다는 표현은 부정확하다(사업주에게 제출을 요청하는 절차).
'실무에서는 두 방식이 갈리므로 1,200만 원을 기준으로 협의하시는 편이 유리' is unverifiable advice. The HR text also states 약 1,200만 원 as the amount, which is aggressive given the uncertainty over 통상임금.
メールの「室内の写真は当方でも保管しております」：依頼者が写真を保管している事実は提示されていない。
「壁紙の残存価値はゼロです」 is slightly off. The standard residual value is 1円, not zero. The practical result (0円) is the same.
"HUG·HF 가입 — 이사 직후" gives no conditions, such as the requirement for 전입+확정일자 first or the deadline.

"to count for 2026 the money needs to land in the Roth by December 31, 2026" presents December 31 as the legal deadline. Under the 2026 Form 5498 instructions and 219(f)(3), a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027, though whether the plan will process it that way varies (minor).

Advice to cover cash flow with 단기 알바든 뭐든 omits the duty to report work or income while receiving benefits (unreported work counts as improper receipt). It also says nothing about the early re-employment allowance, so it nudges against quick job-hunting without telling her it costs nothing.

"That lets you delay Part B with no late-enrollment penalty" is attributed to the company being over the 20-employee threshold. The SEP does not depend on employer size; size only decides who pays first. Minor imprecision.
'대항력(집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리)': oversimplified, since a prior mortgage can extinguish it at auction.
北京高院2024年解答（一）第56条 on 值班: article number with no link. Unverifiable.
“如果发生”降薪、调岗、辞退，“可以另行主张违法解除赔偿金”：降薪或调岗本身不等于违法解除，不能一概适用违法解除赔偿金。
Says 국민취업지원제도 can pick up after 실업급여 ends ('잔여분') and to apply now; it ignores that 구직촉진수당 may be excluded for 6 months after 구직급여 ends. Oversimplified, unverifiable.
Link to 1350.moel.go.kr/rtmview.do?id=1000294810 is cited as support but was not verified here.
“실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분을 받을 수 있으니 지금 미리 신청”: invents an automatic remaining entitlement and overlooks the possible six-month exclusion after unemployment benefits end.
'이직일 다음날부터 12개월 안에 신청해야': presented as an application deadline, which hides that benefit days are lost on a late application (about 208 days for 150 days of benefit).

"the 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary" states a settled rule. The key says whether a beneficiary change resets the clock is unresolved, with no IRS guidance (a major deduction). Elsewhere A hedges with "can restart", so the answer contradicts itself.
'Your 2004 account passes the 15-year test' omits the beneficiary-history qualification; effects of beneficiary changes remain unresolved.
开头直接断言“还应补你约7,034.48元”：未同时限定每天8小时、4天未补休及尚未支付，结论比已知事实更确定。
「2か所以上から給与がある…場合は別途申告が必要」は一律には正しくない。年末調整されなかった給与額などによる例外がある。
「タクシーは緊急時のみ」: narrower than the rule, under which taxis count when public transport cannot be used (No.1122). Minor imprecision.
“报销比例只看医院等级和费用段”：排他性表述超出材料支持范围。
「サインすると合意したと扱われます」: やや断定的で、署名しても通常損耗の負担が当然に成立するわけではない（本回答の他の部分とも緊張）
“지연이자까지 한 번에 청구”: a labor-office complaint does not itself establish recovery of statutory interest; the asserted procedure needs confirmation.
「医療費通知を添付すると明細書の記載を省略できます」: 通知は明細書の記載を簡略化するだけで、明細書の代わりにはならない（キー）。表現がやや不正確。
“가장 큰 목돈입니다”: unsupported because the request does not establish whether any wages remain unpaid or their amount.
「治療は2026年中にまとめる」: 控除額を増やす理由として示した所得・足切りの説明が不正確で、助言としても根拠が弱い
Says that if 800 is 实发, '公司可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额'; the key treats this as the minority view and still questionable, while the majority view says it is still unlawful.

「令和8年度税制改正は2025年12月の閣議決定に基づくもの」: describes the reform as resting on the cabinet decision (大綱). By October 2026 the reform has presumably been enacted, so this framing is out of date, though not wrong on substance (judged from my own knowledge).
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」: 根拠のない経験則。
"公司有两处说错了" is followed by three numbered items, so the framing is internally inconsistent.
「来月の行事は付与後の日付なので」: 今日の日付が10月以降という前提を条件なしに置いている（実施日では正しいが、依頼文には日付がない）
'3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금' is the old rule; the key says 5 years / 50 million won under Article 43 from 2026.9.18 (minor deduction).
'실업급여 150일 + 생계비 융자까지 받으면 석 달은 확보': 계산 근거가 없고 문장이 뒤섞여 검증 불가
"퇴직소득세가 원천징수되어 실수령액은 조금 줄어": if the severance goes into an IRP (as the answer itself says in section 5), no tax is withheld at payment, so this is misleading.

「戻る税金は所得税が約850円…合わせて2,500円ほど」: this states an income-tax refund as fact. With the 104万円 basic deduction, 106万 − 104万 leaves only 2万円, so any social insurance deduction of 2万円 or more brings taxable income to 0 and the refund to 0. The answer never asks the reader to check 源泉徴収税額.
「給与が1か所で年末調整が済んでいるなら、申告の義務はありません」：他の所得がない等の条件が抜けており、断定できない。
'등기부등본 재발급' and bringing a '잔금 영수증' to the 전입신고: loose wording, since a receipt is not required to file and the register is viewed or issued, not 're-issued'.

Scenario B estimate "按这4天32小时全超时粗算约2,482.76元…有审批时这7天大约在3,724～6,207元之间": the arithmetic checks out (9000/21.75/8×1.5×32 = 2482.76), but the key says the 150% amount cannot be worked out from the facts given. It is hedged, but it still gives a concrete figure
可向“公司注册地或劳动合同履行地”的劳动保障监察投诉，混用了监察与仲裁的管辖规则；注册地并非当然具有监察管辖权。
「この1万7,000円を損します」：所得控除額をそのまま金銭的損失として表現しており、実際の税負担軽減額と混同させる。
HR message says "세전 약 1,020만 원": this contradicts B's own calculation (1,024만, up to 1,202만) and understates the claim to HR.

'the 529 plan probably will not verify his income or other contributions', and the signature-guarantee and letter-of-acceptance requirements, are plan-specific guesses. They are hedged, not stated as fact.

"按这4天32小时全超时粗算约2,482.76元……有审批时这7天大约在3,724～6,207元之间" gives a concrete figure for the 150% part in scenario B. The key says it cannot be computed from the information given. It is also not a true upper bound, because excess hours from other days in the cycle also count. The arithmetic itself (9000÷21.75÷8×1.5×32) is right.
“퇴직금(2년 근무면 발생)”: omits the weekly working-hours qualification.
“2192元/月（应发）” and “可能刚好达到下限，并没有差额” present the disputed gross-pay interpretation without disclosing the majority interpretation that the minimum excludes personal contributions.
"평일 18시까지" is given as a general fact, but resident-center hours vary by 동. Minor.
「家族の医療費も、生計を一にしていれば合算できます」 omits the condition that the claimant must have paid those expenses.
“大病保险等可能另计几十元”：key specifies deductions from credited personal-account funds, not additional cash; the amount is unsupported.
"Don't enroll in Part B, Medicare Advantage, or Part D this month" is unconditional; if the plan's drug coverage turns out not to be creditable, waiting on Part D risks a permanent penalty.
「確定申告期限から5年間保存」: the retention start point is stated loosely; the key gives only '5 years' and the point was not checked
“合计约3,370元”及8个月约3,850元、每月约480元：把个人账户扣款加进现金补缴额；7个月应交3,315.69元。
"不要找第三方挂靠单位代缴，违法": plausible but unsourced.
"With distribution code 1 in Box 7" implies required reporting; code 1 is appropriate, but Box 7 codes are optional. Checked [IRS Form 1099-Q instructions](https://www.irs.gov/instructions/i1099q).
“빌라·다가구는 HUG·HF…가입 요건이 까다롭고”: an unsupported generalization about eligibility across property types and providers.
平罗县法院2025年案例及丰台法院2026年发布会的具体内容：有链接，但包内无法核实所述案例内容；未外查，不判定为已证实。
실업급여 150일 plus 생계비 융자 means 석 달은 확보: vague and unsupported arithmetic.
'같은 법 제17조 제3항' cited as the basis for the 20% late interest: unverifiable/misapplied; for a 퇴직금제도 the basis is 근로기준법 제37조 and its enforcement decree

「サインは「内容を確認した」以上の意味を持ちません」: overbroad and legally dubious; a signed contract does bind the signer. The key's point is only that a bare 「原状回復」 clause does not create a special agreement on normal wear.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated. Since 2026.9.18 the penalty under 제43조 is up to 5 years or 5천만 원 (minor, per the key).
1350 링크(id=1000294486)를 근거로 인용했으나 열어 확인하지 못했다. 링크 내용이 본문 주장과 맞는지는 확인되지 않는다.
医療費通知を「添付すると明細書の記載を省略できます」: 実際は記載の簡略化であり、省略・代替ではないので言い過ぎ。
Says 考勤记录单位有保存义务 without any source.
'京劳社资发〔2005〕94号' given as a Beijing licensing basis: unverifiable. The key names only 157号, and this number may not be a 综合工时 document.
'고용노동부 상담 사례' 링크(1350.moel.go.kr id=1000319196)와 간이대지급금 '안내' 링크는 열어 확인하지 못함, 검증 불가
"확정일자는 주민센터에서 무료" — wrong: per the key, a confirmed date costs 600원 when you visit in person (500원 through the internet registry).
“상여·연장수당이 전혀 없어서”: the request excludes bonuses, but does not exclude overtime pay.
'연 20%의 지연이자(같은 법 제17조 제3항, 근로기준법 제37조)': the key gives the interest basis as 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조, so '같은 법 제17조 제3항' looks like a mis-citation and is unverifiable.
참고 링크 2개(eiac.ei.go.kr, 강남구청 복지게시판)는 열어 확인하지 못함. 융자 근거가 구청 게시판이라 출처 신뢰도 낮음
"국민취업지원제도... 실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분을 받을 수 있으니 지금 미리 신청해 두세요" is unverified and risky. The key says 구직촉진수당 can be excluded during and for 6 months after 구직급여, so applying now is not clearly safe.

"the carryover only happens if you're still employed and still enrolled in the FSA in the new plan year": the enrollment condition is stated as certain, but it varies by plan and the key could not verify it
Cites a hznews article and the z.hangzhou.com.cn full text: the links cannot be checked from the packet.
The "Medicare.gov HSA note" is cited to the Working-past-65 page; whether that page has the HSA note is unverifiable
"고용노동부 실무는 통상임금을 적용하는 쪽입니다": no source is given for MOEL practice, so this is unverifiable
"网上很多答案还在写旧标准，是因为那些页面发布在2026年8月15日之前" is speculation about why online answers differ, with no source.

“连续缴费年限：断缴3个月以上会重新计算”: presents recalculated continuous years as a concept in Hangzhou employee insurance. Per the key, “重新计算” appears only in the resident major-illness continuous-enrolment reward. Unverifiable.
Says 10号第九条 "只规定了病假工资的计算基数". This is incomplete: 第九条 also requires the employer to pay 假期工资 per the rules. A's own HR message does cite 第九条 for that duty.
Cites 山东高院〔2018〕鲁民再154号 (a 值班 case) with no checkable source; unverifiable.

'국민취업지원제도 — 구직촉진수당(월 50만원, 최대 6개월)' listed as a living-cost source next to 실업급여. Someone receiving 구직급여 can be excluded from the allowance, so presenting it as an extra income stream is misleading. The answer does not say outright that both can be paid at once, and the amount is not penalized (judged from own knowledge and the key).
Says lacking 40 quarters means Part A carries a premium; premium-free eligibility can come through a spouse's work history.
「仮に借主負担が生じる理屈を立てても按分後の負担額は0円」: overstated. For intentional or negligent damage, labor and construction costs can still be charged after the useful life has passed.
将“照搬旧上海算法”算成8000×70%×80%=4480元；乘法正确，但额外的70%基数折扣没有答案键支持，照搬83号分档应为6400元。
“14일째는 10월 4일” and “10월 5일부터…지연이자”: present unresolved deadline and interest-start dates as certain.
「令和8年度税制改正は2025年12月の閣議決定に基づくもの」 frames the 74万/104万 figures as resting on a cabinet decision. The key treats them as enacted and already shown in NTA No.1410 (minor).
「健康診断は対象外」：一般的な税務知識では、重大な疾病の発見から継続治療につながった場合には例外がある。
Point 5, that a company calling Oct 3 a 补假日 would only swap one day between 300% and 200% with the total unchanged: the answer's own gloss, not covered by the key.

「2〜3月に申告」 together with 「2027年2月16日〜3月15日が申告期間」: the dates are right, but the answer never says the 還付申告 can be filed for 5 years (until 2031-12-31). That leaves the false impression that filing is tied to the Feb–Mar period.
"같은 법 제17조에 따라 연 20%의 지연이자": 근거는 근로기준법 제37조와 시행령 제17조다. 퇴직급여법 제17조는 잘못된 인용으로 보이며 문자에도 같은 인용이 들어갔다.
「対象外…健康診断」：一律の除外は不正確。一般的な税務知識では、重大な疾病が見つかり引き続き治療した場合には例外がある。
'A few plans do for certain employee classes' adds an unsubstantiated claim about the frequency and circumstances of enrollment requirements.

"If you contributed in 2021-2026, that money isn't eligible": too broad. For a December 2026 transfer, only contributions made within the 5 years before the transfer are ineligible, so most 2021 contributions would qualify.

Tells her to check the day is treated as 「事前に承認された休暇」 rather than 欠勤. There is no such legal category: leave that is not paid leave (or a special leave set by the work rules) is still an unpaid absence, so the advice misleads.
Table row '旧规满4年（2026年8月15日前）8000×70%×80% = 4480元': repeats the same error as the old legal standard.

'When your coworker would be right: ... an employer under 20 employees ... missing your Initial Enrollment Period can trigger the 10%-per-year penalty': imprecise or wrong. The SEP for current-employment GHP coverage doesn't require 20+ employees; size only sets which plan pays first (minor, per key).
Attributes to 劳部发〔1994〕503号 art. 7 the rule that local enterprises' approval rules are set by the provincial labor department. It is plausible, but the article number was not checked.
No days-late figure and no 60-day test, yet says 7~9월 요건을 넘길 가능성이 높습니다. Hedged, but unsupported.
「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ」: the guideline retains a residual value of 1 yen; the displayed formula also needs a lower bound.
「給与収入が約214万円を超えると控除はゼロ」は、給与所得控除が220万円まで74万円で固定されるため、(140万+74万=214万)となり正しいと確認した（国税庁No.1410をWebFetchで確認）。誤りではない。
「7年住んだ物件では残存価値はゼロ」: 定額法では残存価値は1円で、ゼロとは厳密には異なる（実質0円なので軽微）。
"금요일 안에 전입신고를 마쳐야 주말 공백이 없습니다" — slightly overstated: a mortgage set on Friday itself still beats the tenant, because the effect only starts Saturday 0:00.
"门槛看的是累计年限，没有另外的连续缴费年限要求": overstates; Hangzhou also requires continued payment in the city until retirement (办法第八条).
'확정일자가 없으면 일반 채권자로 밀려 2억 원을 거의 못 건질 수 있습니다': 과장됨. 대항력이 선순위이면 매수인이 보증금을 인수하게 되나, '~할 수 있습니다'로 한정은 함
Opens with '800 元肯定不合法'. If 800 is the net figure, the key says it depends on whether the minimum includes personal contributions. B only qualifies this later, in section two.
“不能只按基本工资；实际发放高于合同约定的，按实际发放”：与答案键所列北京按合同约定工资确定基数的规则不符，不能一概改用实际发放总额。
Advises adding 「早期解決のため例外的に応じる」 to a pay-in-full email, saying it prevents being found to have paid 「納得して」. Whether this works legally is unverified, and it softens the main advice.
The Savingforcollege guide link is a third-party source and its content was not verified. It is a checkable link, not a claim of having checked it.

Tells the asker to apply at retirement "using CMS-40B plus CMS-L564" with no condition, after advising HSA holders to skip Part A. CMS-40B is wrong for someone without Part A; they must apply for A and B together through SSA.
「社会保険料控除：約20〜40万円」 invents an amount and insurance circumstances absent from the request.
“18시를 넘겼다면 … 그날 안에 끝내면 됩니다” contradicts the key: Friday evening online fixed-date applications receive the date on the next working day; after-hours move-in processing is unverified.
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”: outdated; the key gives five years or 50 million won from September 18, 2026.
“A few plans do for certain employee classes” adds an unsupported claim about prevalence and employee classifications.
근로복지공단에 피보험자격 확인청구(1588-0075) for an uninsured worker: which body takes the claim could not be verified, so unverifiable.
「基礎控除104万円（合計所得132万円以下。令和8年分）」: wrong income condition. Per the key (No.1199), 104万 applies to 合計所得金額 up to 489万円. The result for this person (106万) is unaffected.
断言14号文已失效，并与83号文共用官方答复作依据；答案键仅确认14号有效期届满，失效结论仍属推定。

Puts quotation marks around paraphrased wording from the Beijing wage regulation (「安排劳动者在法定休假日工作的，按300%」); the actual Art 16 text points to Art 14(3) and does not say '300%'. The substance is right; I opened the gov.cn link to check.
“퇴직금(2년 근무면 발생)” omits the weekly working-hours eligibility condition.
国交省ガイドラインを根拠にするが、再改訂版・別表1・民法621条を特定していない。確認できず、曖昧。
“법을 착각했을 가능성이 커요”: unsupported speculation about the employer’s explanation.
"人社部办公厅的相关通知也是这个口径：'在正常发放的当日工资（100%）之外，再额外支付300%'": wording quoted from a ministry notice with no link to or number for that notice; only a Changzhou reply is linked. Unverifiable.
Part B penalties apply to people without 'creditable coverage': this conflates Part D terminology with the current-employment group coverage required for this Part B SEP.
임금체불확인서(회사 발급): a company that withheld wages is unlikely to issue this; the confirmation normally comes from the labor office, or deposit records stand in for it. Unverifiable and probably wrong.
“目前仅支持线下办理”：排他性办理渠道及所列证件要求未获所给材料验证。
Does not mention the retirement condition of contributing in Hangzhou until retirement. Omission, not stated as an error.
“자발적 퇴사로 보지 않고”: a justified voluntary resignation can qualify; it does not cease to be voluntary.

"the carryover only happens if you're still employed and still enrolled in the FSA in the new plan year": the enrollment condition is plan-dependent (the key leaves it open), so stating it as a universal rule overstates it
Gives 21.75 and 413.79 with no stated basis (人社部发〔2025〕2号), so the figure is unsourced.
'It should be recorded as a rollover contribution, not a regular contribution' is imprecise. The key reports the 529-to-Roth transfer in Form 5498 box 10.
Says waiting is necessarily 'the financially better move'; the employer plan's benefits and the person's medical costs are unknown.
The Medicare.gov and shiphelp.org links were not opened, and the "HSA note" link points to the same working-past-65 page.
구직촉진수당 '월 50만원, 최대 6개월' - the key does not cover it; the 2026 amount may have been raised, so possibly outdated and unverified

「住まいるダイヤル（0570-016-100）」: the number appears correct from my own knowledge, but this service mainly handles new-build and renovation disputes. Rental move-out restoration is likely outside its usual scope, so the referral is questionable.

"Health FSA money is use-it-or-lose-it, with only a capped carryover" and the table labeling ~$680 carried over as the "best case": this frames carryover as the only exception, while a grace period (the better outcome for March work) comes up only later as a "nuance".
The "realistic math" table treats ~$680 carried and ~$1,220 forfeited as the baseline before the grace-period caveat, which could read as near-certain loss (softened by the next paragraph)
HUG conditions are cited to a third-party blog (property.ambitstock.com) labelled 'HUG 가입 조건(2026. 10. 기준)', not to an official HUG page. The figures match the key, but the source is weak.
Step 1 timing '나가기 전·도착 직후' with no 잔금 step: ambiguous, can be read as checking after the balance is paid
“지연이자를 함께 청구”: recovery of interest through the stated labor-office procedure needs confirmation.
“집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리” overstates 대항력: enforceability against an auction purchaser depends on priority.
Premium given only as 'roughly $185-$210/month, set annually'; the 2026 standard premium is $202.90, so the range holds but is vague.
「直前だと時季変更権の余地が広がります」: loosely plausible but stated as a rule. The law sets no notice period. My own judgement, no source opened.
所得税の申告をしなくても住民税申告だけで控除できる経路に触れず「確定申告が必要」と断定
「通常損耗を借主負担とする特約は、借主がその内容を認識し、契約時に具体的な説明を受けていた場合に限り有効（同ガイドライン）」: ガイドラインの3要件の単純化で、判例（最判平成17年12月16日）は示していない
"If you don't have 40 quarters, Part A carries a premium" ignores qualification through a spouse's work history.
"부동산 말은 절반만 맞아요": the realtor's claim that 확정일자 can be ignored is wrong, so 'half right' is soft framing. The correction follows immediately.
「令和8年度税制改正は2025年12月の閣議決定に基づく」: the reform became law in 2026, so calling it only a cabinet decision is outdated framing (minor)
“3개월치 + 퇴직금을 진정하세요”: assumes three months of wages remain unpaid; the request establishes late payment, not three outstanding salaries.
“CMS-L564 form (your employer fills it out)” incorrectly assigns the whole form to the employer; the applicant completes Section A.
「日焼けの程度を示せるのはあなただけ」: unsupported exclusivity; inspection records and other evidence can also establish the condition.
少額訴訟の「費用対効果は十分あります」：契約内容、証拠、必要な時間などが未確認で、断定できない。
Message 1 says '지연이자(연 20%)와 고용노동부 진정 절차를 검토할 수밖에 없어', a mild warning tone that the key says to avoid (minor).
Says 2027年1月1日 as the exact date benefits resume. The key allows January or February and says to defer to the 经办 office, and the answer does mention the February case.
"$1,220+ evaporates on January 1": too absolute. Forfeiture is measured at the end of the run-out, and 2026 claims filed during it still count (A does mention the run-out elsewhere).
「直前だと時季変更権…の余地が広がります」：申請時期だけで判断できず、事業の正常な運営を妨げるという条件を説明していない。

Ties the no-penalty delay to the 400-employee size ("your coworker's penalty warning doesn't apply to you at 400 employees"). The SEP does not depend on employer size; the 20-employee line only decides who pays first. Minor imprecision.
"按旧口径补3680元": comes from the wrong 4480 figure

「所得税5%で約850円、住民税10%で約1,700円、合わせて2,500円程度」: states an income tax refund as fact. It ignores the 2026 basic deduction of 104万円 (106万−104万＝2万円, so taxable income is 0 once social insurance is deducted). The income tax refund is likely 0, and B never asks the user to check the withheld tax shown on the withholding slip.

“国家医保局的口径也是：断缴3个月以内补缴，才不设等待期、可追溯待遇”: overbroad. 43号文 Art. 11 covers only cross-region transfer or a switch between employee and resident schemes with a gap of 3 months or less, not any gap. The conclusion that it does not apply to her is still right.
「戻る税金は所得税が約850円」「合わせて2,500円ほど」は還付を断定。社会保険料控除や源泉徴収税額によって所得税の還付は0円になる。
HR message states "세전 약 1,020만 원": this contradicts A's own 1,024만~1,202만 calculation and understates the claim at the bottom edge
"형사처벌(3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금)": 옛 규정이다. 현재는 5년 이하 징역 또는 5천만 원 이하 벌금이다. 경미 감점.

"Finish by December 31, 2026 so it counts against the 2026 limit": presents December as the deadline, but a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027 (219(f)(3), 2026 Form 5498 instructions); minor error.
"회사가 '자발적 사직'으로 올리면 1차로 반려될 수 있어요": unverifiable procedural claim.
"10월 4일이 법정 기한" is stated as definite, but the exact deadline depends on how the retirement date and holidays are counted (10/3~10/6). The date falls in that range, so this is minor
"Carried into next year (best case) ~$680" overlooks the grace-period possibility of using all $1,900, despite acknowledging it later.
「後から『納得して払った』と認定されるのを防げます」 promises an unsupported legal effect from reserving objections while agreeing to pay.
“상여·연장수당이 전혀 없어서”: the request excludes bonuses, but does not establish that overtime allowances were absent.
"빌라는 근저당이 잡힌 경우가 적지 않아" is an unsourced generalization.
“확정일자가 없으면 일반 채권자로 밀려” is too categorical: enforceable 대항력 can preserve a claim against the purchaser despite lacking preferential distribution rights.
"The 529 plan probably will not verify his income or other contributions" is an unsupported prediction about an unidentified plan.
'근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호': 근거를 대지 않은 경험칙 수치로 확인 불가
“실무에서는 두 방식이 갈리므로 … 협의”: misleadingly presents the calculation basis as negotiable; the higher ordinary-wage floor is mandatory when applicable.
IRP described as the current-law payment method with no 3 million won threshold or under-55 condition.
「確定申告すれば、住民税の申告は別に要りません」は一般論としては正しいが、所得税の申告をしなくても住民税の申告だけで控除できる点には触れていない。

'7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고' — overstated. Eligibility depends on the total days paid late or unpaid reaching 60, not on the number of late months. Three months each paid a few days late may not qualify (key).
"확정일자는 주민센터에서 무료" is wrong: the key gives 600 won for an in-person 확정일자 (only 전입신고 is free).
“약 178만 원을 덜 받는 것”: 차액 계산은 맞지만, 전액 통상임금·월 209시간이라는 조건이 확인되지 않아 실제 미지급 차액으로 단정할 수 없다.
확정일자 안내 links to an Ulsan Nam-gu dong office page for a Seoul villa. The 600원 fee and documents are the same nationwide, so this is a weak source rather than a wrong one.
"购房、落户等连续社保资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续）": unverifiable, outside the key.
"Grace period: you can incur expenses through March 15" treats the maximum as guaranteed; plans may provide a shorter period.
Plan requires Medicare at 65 ('some do; most don't'): the frequency claim is unverifiable.
“Medigap guaranteed-issue window” conflates Medigap open enrollment with distinct guaranteed-issue rights.
The HR message and body never cite 309号第59条 or 10号第九条. They appear only as source links, and the 10号 link is not tied to 第九条's content.
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”, “제44조”: 키에 따르면 개정 전 규정이다. 현행은 제43조의 5년·5천만 원이며 경미 감점 대상이다.
The link labelled 「国交省ガイドライン関連の解説」 goes to a private explainer site (kurashitokanri.jpm.jp), not the MLIT guideline. It is offered as support for a guideline claim but is not an official source.
「基礎控除104万円（合計所得132万円以下。令和8年分）」: キーでは合計所得金額489万円以下。本人は106万円で結論は変わらないが条件が誤り

Cites "国家医保局口径" that 断缴3个月内补缴 means no waiting period and 可追溯. Per the key this rule (43号文第十一条) covers only cross-region transfers and 职工/居民 switches. B correctly says it does not apply to her, but describes its scope loosely.

「敷金から引くには修繕内容と費用の内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: 622条の2 says what may be deducted (only money debts arising under the lease, such as unpaid rent). It sets no itemization requirement, so the citation is wrong.
“첫 입금까지 몇 주 걸립니다” gives an unverified payment timeline; the packet establishes only the seven-day waiting period.
“10월 4일이 기한” asserts an exact deadline despite unresolved retirement-date interpretation and holiday adjustments.
「令和8年度税制改正は2025年12月の閣議決定に基づく」: 未確認(もっともらしいが鍵に記載なし)
“금액이 조금 달라질”: understates the possible change from the assumed upper estimate; the key’s endpoints differ by about 1.78 million won.
'어느 기준으로 봐도 요건에 해당할 가능성이 높고' never states the 60-day total-delay-days criterion; hedged by '아예 못 받으셨다면', so low severity.
