The email asks for the deposit back only 「負担が確定した分を除き」, which concedes deductions instead of demanding full return of the 100,000 yen (key: full return is the default).

'회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우에는 지급 방식이 조금 다르지만' mixes up IRP (the worker's account) with a company plan and implies IRP applies only to pension plan members, which the key calls wrong. The HR text never asks for an IRP account.
Early re-employment allowance as '남은 수급기간의 절반': leaves out the conditions (at least half of the benefit days still left, and 12 months of continued employment).
「残存価値はゼロです」は不正確。キーの基準は残存価値1円。
The LINE changes the user's 「子どもの行事」 to 「学校行事」, which assumes school; it may be a daycare event (minor).

"你可以主张按9000元或近12个月平均应发工资作为基数": Beijing wage-payment rule Art 44 bases overtime pay on the wage in the contract, then on actual normal pay. A 12-month average is not the Beijing rule (judged from my own knowledge).
「社会保険料控除があるので、所得税は0円」：控除の存在も金額も未確認。必要な2万円以上という条件も示していない。
"some do; most don't" (plans that require Medicare at 65): a generalization with no source. Plausible but unverifiable.
“已经发过……节日补贴，要抵扣”：节日补贴不能当然抵扣法定加班费，需确认款项性质。
Says that without 40 quarters Part A has "its own late penalty". A Part A premium late penalty exists, but a valid SEP avoids it, so this overstates the risk.

Says 퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원 would be deducted. The key's estimate is about 9.4만~14.1만 원, and nothing is withheld at payout when the money goes to an IRP, so the figure is wrong and contradicts the answer's own IRP statement.
「少額調停」：独立した正式な手続名としては不正確。民事調停と少額訴訟を区別すべき。
“退休补缴标准还会随省平工资上涨”把未来上涨说成确定事实；答案键只确认标准每年调整。
Table row '旧规满4年（2026年8月15日前） 4480元' and '按旧口径补3680元' repeat the wrong 4480 figure; the arithmetic itself (4480-800=3680) is correct.
첫 입금까지 몇 주 걸린다: 대기기간 7일이라는 구체 수치 없이 대기기간 등으로만 썼다. 대체로 맞으나 근거가 없다.
Two of the cited sources are non-official reposts (m.163.com, bendibao). The links are checkable but are not official guidance.

"Is my full $1,900 available now? Under the uniform-coverage rule it should be ... you can spend it before it's fully funded": muddled, since uniform coverage applies to the annual election from day one and the $1,900 is a leftover balance already available; it also misses the actual use of the rule, the 2027 election
「少額訴訟…費用も数万円程度」 is unsupported for this claim; the key gives substantially lower filing fees for a ¥100,000 claim.

Cites two links (kurashitokanri.jpm.jp article; warp.da.ndl.go.jp kokusen hanrei/data/200406) as support for the guideline claim. No document number or checkable content is given, and a kokusen 'hanrei' page is a court-case record that may not concern sunburned wallpaper. Unverifiable.
"0571-89583017": a phone number given with no checkable source; unverifiable.

Table lists 社会保険料控除 as 約20〜40万円 and concludes 所得税は0円 on that assumed range; the user never gave the premium amount and the 40万円 end is high (unverified assumption stated as fact, only hedged later in the notes)
The imaeil article and 1350 links are cited as the basis; they are checkable links, but I did not open them and cannot say how far they support the text.

'If the money lands in January, it generally counts for 2027, and the 2026 room is lost' and the 'Confirm the deposit before December 31' step treat December 31 as the federal deadline. The key says a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027, though plans vary. Minor error.
「年内に追加の治療があれば、その分だけ控除額も増えます」 omits that eligible expenses must actually be paid within the year and reduced by reimbursements.
States 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 expired on 2026-08-15 as fact; the key says this is only presumed
"stop HSA contributions first": incomplete. Part A taken later is backdated up to 6 months, so HSA contributions must stop 6 months before applying.
「敷金から引くには修繕内容と費用の内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: 622条の2は敷金返還と、控除できるのは賃貸借に基づく金銭債務という趣旨の規定で、内訳提示義務を定めたものではない。条文趣旨の取り違え。
The "전입세대 열람으로 선순위 임차인도 확인 가능" tip is not in the key. It is plausible but unverified.
「民法621条ただし書き」 is the wrong pinpoint for the ordinary-wear exclusion; that exclusion appears in the main clause's parenthesis.
Does not give the 4,986 base or 9.5% rate behind 473.67, so the 3,316 figure cannot be checked from the answer.
备用话术“我的合同或员工手册第X条明确约定了80%”：用户尚未确认存在此条款，不能直接作为已知事实发送。

"spending $1,500 on stuff you wouldn't otherwise buy to save $680 is a loss": muddled. FSA money is already contributed, so spending it before forfeiture costs nothing extra out of pocket, and the $1,500 and $680 figures do not match any branch.
Message 1 tells HR '제가 계산해 보면 세전 약 1,040만 원 안팎', anchoring below the 통상임금 floor of about 12.02 million won that B itself describes.
「ガイドライン上も」 supplies no checkable link or document identifier for its source attribution, although the underlying sunlight claim matches the key.
「収入や申告が扶養判定に影響することがあります」: filing for the medical deduction does not change 合計所得金額, so the filing itself does not affect dependency status (key)
“纯粹为了退休，不用补”“7个月影响微乎其微”缺少退休年龄和未来缴费时间依据；若退休时恰好不足，这7个月会影响是否需要补缴。
"운영시간(보통 09:00~18:00)": generic claim; the key says hours differ by 동.
국민취업지원제도: "실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분을 받을 수 있으니 지금 미리 신청해 두세요": unverifiable. Per the key, people still receiving 구직급여, or within 6 months after it ends, can be excluded from 구직촉진수당.
「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ」 omits the ¥1 residual-value floor; its stated formula yields −1/6 of acquisition cost at seven years, not zero.

Says to enroll in "Part D or a Medicare Advantage plan within 63 days if your drug coverage isn't creditable". This is muddled. If the employer drug coverage is not creditable, delaying Part D builds a penalty, so the asker should not wait until leaving the job.
“近两年要孩子才需留意”：题包没有两年的判断期限。
“杭州职工医保的报销比例不跟‘连续年限’挂钩” and “杭州退休医保待遇不看20年以上的年限”: unverifiable claims not covered by the key
'83号文、14号文已在2026年8月15日到期' presents 14号's lapse as certain; the key says it is only presumed
Scenario B 「最多再拿约2482.76元，合计最多约6206.90元」: puts a cap on the 150% amount, but the key says it cannot be computed from the facts given, and cycle overtime is not limited to these 32 hours
Email: 「敷金10万円につきましては、貸主様側で負担が確定した分を除き…ご返還」: drafting error (it should be the tenant's confirmed share), and it leaves room for deductions instead of asking for the full 10万円 back

「店側が変更できるのは本当に忙しくて回らないときだけです」: a loose paraphrase of the seasonal-change right. The legal test is 事業の正常な運営を妨げる場合, and the key says that simply being busy is not a reason, so framing it as busyness is imprecise.
「治療は2026年中にまとめる」：控除対象年を決めるのは原則として支払日であり、治療日ではない。
“사실상 도산했다면 … 소액체당금”: 현행 명칭은 간이대지급금이며, 도산하지 않은 사업장에서도 이용할 수 있어 안내가 낡고 불필요하게 좁다.
「消費者ホットライン（188）」 is given without noting that it has no area code and routes to the nearest consumer center. Minor omission, not an error.
'Usually have until March–April to submit receipts' is unsupported by the packet; the actual deadline is plan-specific.
Carryover cap given as $660 of 2025 funds moving into 2026; for the user's plan year ending Dec 31, 2026 the cap is $680 (the key treats $660 as minor).
“계약 후 잔금 사이에 근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다” adds an unsupported prevalence claim.
The 'smallest of' formula is wrong when compensation is below $7,500 and other IRA contributions exist: $4,000 compensation minus $2,000 contributed leaves $2,000, but its formula permits $4,000.
"通过'浙里办'搜'医保补缴'或'灵活就业参保'": unverifiable claim that the back-payment can be done online, not in the key
"也可以在1年内申请劳动仲裁": imprecise. Wage arrears claimed while still employed are not bound by the one-year limit; the one year runs from leaving (劳动争议调解仲裁法 art. 27)
Says CMS-L564 is "completed by your employer". The asker completes Section A and the employer completes Section B, so this is incomplete.
「クリーニング・ホワイトニング…は対象外」: クリーニングを一律に対象外とするのは言い過ぎ。治療目的の歯石除去などは対象になり得る。
“不会缩短……等待期”：答案键明确此事未核实，不能断言。
Living-cost loan at '연 1.5%' with no date: on 2026-10-25 the temporary 1.0% rate applies (until 10.31), and the separate 1% guarantee fee is not mentioned.
Fengtai court case (“批准期限届满没续的,也自动回到标准工时”): the linked source was not opened and the details are unverifiable.
Prescribes CMS-40B at retirement without requiring existing Part A; someone deferring both must apply for A and B together.
Link to 1350.moel.go.kr/rtmview.do?id=1000294810 is cited as support but was not verified here; the same link is in B.
“You'll have paid the premiums and re-enrolling later is more complicated” is an unsupported blanket claim; timing and continued SEP eligibility matter.
문자를 보내는 것 자체로 연장 합의가 없었다는 증거가 되고 합의 주장을 '막을 수 있습니다'라는 설명은 증거 효과를 과장한다.
"확정일자가 없으면 일반 채권자로 밀려 2억 원을 거의 못 건질 수 있습니다" overstates the outcome. The loss depends on the auction price and the senior claims.
"평일 18시까지" for the 주민센터, cited to a 강동구 FAQ link: not checked here. The key only says 'within working hours', so I judge it plausible but unverified.
“거절되면 그 자체가 위험 신호” overgeneralizes guarantee rejection, which can reflect applicant eligibility or documentation rather than property risk.
「過去の分も領収書があれば還付申告できます」 overstates eligibility: receipts alone do not establish a refund, and already-filed returns may require a different correction procedure.

Table puts 「社会保険料控除 約20〜40万円（国民年金・国保など）」 in as fact. The request gives no social insurance amount or type, and the answer assumes national pension or national health insurance for a part-timer. It is an unverifiable assumption that drives the flat 「所得税は0円」
「『欠勤扱いで構いません』と書くとあとから有給に戻すのが面倒」 - 根拠なしの助言（軽微）
"你的年限会从8年变成8年" is garbled and unclear (the point is that the 7 months simply do not count).
Cites 《杭州市基本医疗保障办法》第五十五条 for transfer and accumulation; the article number is unverifiable and the key does not cover it
The 'Sources' line gives IRS links (Topic 313, Pub 590-A, 529(c)(3)(E)). These are checkable and consistent with the key, and the answer does not claim to have checked them.
"Subtract that too" after taking the minimum can understate eligibility: with $3,000 eligible funds, ample compensation and $2,000 other IRA contributions, it gives $1,000 instead of $3,000.
"The limits may rise with inflation, which would shorten the schedule" is unsupported: future limits are unannounced, and even $8,000 × 4 = $32,000 still requires five years.
“현행법상 퇴직금은 IRP 계정으로 이전”: omits the age-based exception, although the user’s age is unknown.
「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」は、給与明細に有給日数が載るかは職場次第で、根拠のない言い切り(未検証)
横浜市の解説リンク: 内容は未確認(国税庁のNo.1120・1199は実在ページで内容もキーと整合)
“每天超过8小时，超过部分另按150%”：错误；法定节假日和休息日的超时不能一律改按150%。
"7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고": overstates the case. The test is a 60-day total of late or unpaid days, not the number of late months, so three late months do not by themselves meet it.
‘소액체당금’ is an outdated name for 간이대지급금 (general knowledge); the current scheme should be identified.
The 1350.moel.go.kr link was opened. It is a real Q&A page that covers the 2-month wage-arrears rule, so it supports the claim.
'퇴직소득세를 공제한 실수령액은 이보다 적습니다'라는 단정은 IRP 이전 시 원천징수하지 않는다는 키의 설명과 맞지 않는다.
「所得税自体が約1,000円」は他の所得控除を無視した条件付きの計算を、本人の税額として提示している。

Links to IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-32 and a Proskauer blog are given as support. I did not open them, and the blog's content is not checkable from the packet. The $680/$660 figures they support match the key.

"The 529 plan will issue Form 1099-Q to you as account owner": wrong. The IRS Form 1099-Q instructions (I opened irs.gov/instructions/i1099q) list the designated beneficiary as the recipient when the money moves trustee-to-trustee into a Roth IRA for the beneficiary.
购房、落户等连续社保资格也会重置（补缴一般不算连续） - goes beyond the medical-insurance question and is unverifiable.
「2か所以上から給与がある」場合に申告が必要と一括している。自身の知識では、金額などによる申告不要の例外がある。
"If you're not on Social Security, nothing is automatic": overlooks automatic enrollment through Railroad Retirement Board benefits.
「欠勤扱いで構いません」と書くと、あとから有給に戻すのが面倒になる: 実務上の推測で、根拠は示されていない。
"고용노동부와 법제처도 퇴직금 산정에 이 조항이 적용된다고 해석합니다" gives no document number. The 법제처 part matches the key (법제처-26-0209); the MOEL part is unverifiable.
「家族の分も合算できます」は、生計を一にすることと本人が支払ったことの条件を欠く。
「サインすると合意したと扱われます」: やや断定的。ただし実務上の注意としては妥当。
The 和歌山労働局 link is given as a source. I opened it and it supports the claims about part-timers, the 6-month and 80% requirements, and 3 days a week giving 5 days. This is not an error.
「欠勤にすると、その日は丸ごと無給になります」：職場の賃金規定が不明なため、必ず全額無給になるとの断定は裏付け不足。
Cites a 平罗县法院 2025 case and a 北京丰台法院 2026 press conference as authority for 'no approval means standard hours'. They are given with links only, and their contents cannot be checked.
"spending $1,500 on stuff you wouldn't otherwise buy to save $680": an illustrative figure that does not match the user's numbers and is confusing
留保文を残せば「後から『納得して払った』と認定されるのを防げます」：支払いへの合意がどう評価されるかを、その一文だけで保証できない。

"퇴직금 미지급은 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금 (퇴직급여법 제44조)": outdated. Since 2026.9.18 it is 제43조, up to 5 years or 5천만 원. This also contradicts B's opening claim that it used the law in force in October 2026 (minor, per the key).
“계약 후 이사 사이에 설정되는 경우가 많습니다” adds an unsupported prevalence claim.
Pay stubs/W-2s as backup alongside CMS-L564: unverifiable, and not part of the key.
Says that with only 8 years the flexible-employment route "可能走不通" for a non-local hukou. This contradicts its own listed 居住证+就业登记 path and the key's eligibility rule.
“퇴직 후 건강보험료가 지역가입자로 바뀌니” is too categorical; dependent coverage or continued employee coverage may apply.
"운영시간(보통 09:00~18:00)" is a general claim. The key says hours differ by dong.
“劳动关系存续期间追劳动报酬不受1年时效限制”：直接用于全部加班费请求，遗漏答案键提示的适用口径差异。
「来月の行事は付与後の日付なので」: 依頼文に今日の日付はなく、現在が10月以降であるという前提を置いている（解答キーは実施日前提で許容）

Cites 劳部发〔1997〕271号第4条 for holiday 300% 'another payment, generally no 补休': from my own knowledge that item exists, but it is a general rule, not one specific to 综合工时. A citation nuance, not an error.
"신청은 퇴사 다음 날부터 12개월 이내": imprecise. The 12 months is the 수급기간 (제48조), so a late claim loses days. A 150-day entitlement needs filing within about 208 days.
“집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호” introduces an unsupported numerical risk threshold.
「同ガイドライン」を根拠とする特約の有効要件の説明には、確認可能なリンクや文書番号がなく、その帰属を検証できない。
“워크넷 구직등록”: 종료된 경로이며 고용24를 안내해야 한다.
In the LINE draft, 「10月1日から有給休暇が付与されています」 is stated as fact, but the grant depends on the 8割 attendance condition. The answer gives that condition only outside the LINE (minor).
"고용노동부와 법제처도 퇴직금 산정에 이 조항이 적용된다고 해석": no document number or link is given. The key supports the substance (법제처-26-0209).
"Form 1099-Q to you as account owner" is wrong for this direct rollover: the designated beneficiary is the recipient. See [IRS Form 1099-Q instructions](https://www.irs.gov/pub/irs-pdf/i1099q.pdf).
'7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다' / '아직 못 받았다면 더 확실': 60일 날수 기준 없이 단정해 과장
“补缴超过1个月通常要去医保经办窗口”及指定材料清单：新增的办理门槛和材料要求无法从给定材料核实。
“3개월치 월급” assumes three salaries remain unpaid, although the request only establishes payment delays.

「2027年2月16日〜3月15日に確定申告」 tells the user to file in the regular filing period. A refund return for 2026 can be filed from 2027-01-01 and for five years after (to 2031-12-31). The answer mentions neither, which hits the key's penalty for limiting the refund return to the 3/15 deadline.
“The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240” contradicts the grace-period exception, which can cover the entire balance.
Says 「所定労働日の8割」 where the statute says 全労働日. Close in practice; very minor
“If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years” is unsupported by announced limits; even $8,000 annually requires five years.
'If annual limits rise, it could take fewer years' is speculative. At $8,000 x 4 = $32,000 it still takes five years, and later limits are not announced.
The answer never tells the person to elect 2027 FSA money at open enrollment for the March work.
'很多人（包括一些 HR）还没更新' is an unsupported generalization.
“多数情况下拿不到这么多”：缺乏工时周期、实际工时或统计依据，无法判断多数情况。
メール文面で敷金は「合意ができた後に精算」とし、全額返還を求めていない。敷金からの差引きを前提に含み、通常損耗には差引き根拠がないという立場と整合しない。
「今回は通常の医療費控除が有利です」 calls it a comparison, but dental treatment and travel costs are outside セルフメディケーション税制 altogether, so there is nothing to compare.
"很多人（包括一些HR）还没更新" is unsupported colour.
Bullet 5, “公司若主张按补假日折算,只会把某一天的300%和200%对调,7天总额不变”: speculative and unsupported, and it blurs that 10月3日 (Saturday) is plainly a statutory holiday.
“1,020만~1,030만 원”: misleadingly narrow estimate; omits the ordinary-wage floor that could raise payment to about 12.02 million won.

At retirement says to apply for Part B 'using CMS-40B plus CMS-L564' with no condition on Part A. The same list tells HSA holders to skip Part A, and CMS-40B is wrong for someone without Part A (A and B must be applied for together through SSA).
「社会保険料の金額が分かれば、所得税0が確定」：金額が判明するだけでは足りず、控除額が必要水準を満たすことが条件。
Early re-employment allowance is described as '남은 수급일수의 절반' and omits the condition that at least half of the 소정급여일수 must remain, so the explanation is imprecise.
「書面で同意すると債務を認めた記録が残り、後から覆すのが難しくなります」: 法的帰結を一般論として断定しており、出典なし（根拠は検証不能）。
"以上是按现行文件和裁审口径的分析" refers to a court and arbitration practice it does not cite, so it cannot be checked.

"Scholarships ... do not" count is too categorical: certain taxable scholarships and graduate stipends qualify, as confirmed in the opened [IRS Publication 590-A](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p590a).
The 조기재취업수당 description ("대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면 남은 수급일수의 절반") leaves out the condition that at least half of the 소정급여일수 must remain, and "수급일수의 절반" is imprecise.
'CMS-L564, completed by your employer': imprecise. Section A is completed by the asker and Section B by the employer.
“83号文、14号文已在2026年8月15日到期”：将14号文失效表述为确定事实，遗漏答案键注明的推定性质。
「急なご相談で申し訳ありません」: the event is next month, so calling it a sudden request is inaccurate (minor wording issue, not a legal error)
“퇴직소득세를 공제한 실수령액은 이보다 적습니다”: IRP 이전 시에는 지급 시점에 원천징수하지 않는다.
「申告が扶養判定に影響」はこの医療費控除の説明として不明確。医療費控除は合計所得金額を変えず、税の配偶者控除等の所得判定には影響しない。
"审批文件在公司手里，仲裁时你可以要求公司出示" is stated as something the worker can do. The key found no clear legal basis for a right to demand the approval document.
「敷金から引くには修繕内容と費用の内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: the statute does not say this. 622条の2 only lets the landlord deduct the tenant's monetary debts under the lease; it sets no itemization requirement.
"If you're not on Social Security, nothing happens automatically": overlooks automatic enrollment through Railroad Retirement Board benefits.
"Scholarships ... don't count" is too broad: qualifying taxable scholarship or fellowship compensation can count. Checked [IRS Publication 970](https://www.irs.gov/publications/p970).

Ties the no-penalty delay to the 400 employees ('well over Medicare's 20-employee threshold... it lets you delay Part B'). Under 20 employees, says 'you'd need to enroll'. This is imprecise: the SEP doesn't depend on employer size; size only decides which plan pays first (minor, per key).
"要等3个月才能报销": loose. Under the third-natural-month rule only November and December go unreimbursed (A's own example shows this).
「12万円の全額負担は根拠がなく」: too categorical before examining the complete contract and any specific special clause.
「扶養に入っている場合、収入や申告が扶養判定に影響することがあります」: 医療費控除は合計所得金額を変えず扶養・配偶者の判定に影響しない（キー）。誤解を招く。
补缴超过1个月通常要去医保经办窗口…补缴申请表 - unverifiable procedural detail.
将在职追索劳动报酬的时效例外直接用于本案加班费：未说明答案键提示的适用口径差异。
"国家医保局口径：断缴 3 个月以内补缴，才不设等待期、可追溯待遇": this is the 43号文 rule for cross-region transfer or switching insurance type. Stated as a general rule, it is over-generalized. A correctly says she is outside it.
"补缴买到的只是：这 7 个月记入累计年限": incomplete. Per the key, back-paid months count as actual contribution years, so they also count toward Hangzhou's 10 actual years.
"Covering little your plan doesn't already cover" is unsupported without knowing the employer plan's benefits.
Does not say the new employer cannot pay the April-October months.
“最省事也最划算”“对你没有实际收益”：缺少退休前剩余缴费时间，不能断言；补缴可增加7个月实际缴费年限。
Tells the asker not to enroll in Part D before confirming creditable drug coverage; delaying without that confirmation may be inappropriate.
劳部发〔1997〕271号第四条、第五条及其引号原文：没有链接或文号可核对，也不是键里的309号第62条，属无法核实的精确引注。

At retirement, "Apply for Part B ... using CMS-40B plus CMS-L564" with no caveat that CMS-40B is only for people who already have Part A. A also says Part A is optional and should be skipped with an HSA, so this sends some readers down the wrong route.
询问补“3–9月”：与本题假设的4–10月不符。
“浙里办→浙里医保→我要参保→职工参保登记”及税务缴费操作路径：给定材料无法核实，也未证明这些步骤可以办理所述补缴。
"이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)": the key fixes this Friday as 2026-10-23. The date is invented and wrong.
“长护险（45元/年）”：该具体金额无法从给定材料核实；93×7÷12＝54.25元的分摊算术正确，但不能据此增加应交现金。
「壁紙（クロス）の張り替えは原則として貸主負担」 is overbroad. The guideline puts normal wear on the landlord and tenant-caused damage on the tenant, so this is not a blanket rule.
「民法90条で争える余地」: 通常損耗特約の争い方としては一般的でなく、補足的で根拠が弱い。
"通过浙里办搜医保补缴或灵活就业参保，或打12393": the channels are plausible but unverified.
称14号文件已确定失效：答案键仅将其失效列为推定，未见官方明确表态。
'Not every 529 plan has its rollover process running smoothly yet' and 'December is a busy month for processors' are operational claims unsupported by the packet.
"You'll need it" about an HR letter: overstates a particular document as required; the key specifies CMS-L564.
“两种计算方式相差约827.59元，差的只是……200%还是150%”错误地把周期超时计算简化为四天固定按150%结算；差额并不固定。
"이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)" — the key fixes this Friday as 2026-10-23; the date is stated flatly and conflicts with the key.
“생활법령정보(2026. 9. 15. 기준)”의 정확한 기준일은 패킷으로 확인되지 않습니다. 링크는 있으나 해당 날짜는 검증되지 않았습니다.

Says that if 应发 is about 2192 and 实发 is 800 after personal social insurance and housing fund, the company "是按最低线在发，能主张的差额会少很多". The majority view (14号 text, CMS) is that the minimum excludes personal contributions, so this still underpays. B concedes the minority reading without saying so.

"Complete the transfer by December 31, 2026 to count against the 2026 limit": December treated as the legal deadline. Per the key, a rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027 (minor error).
"계약서를 들고 주민센터에서 전입세대 열람을 신청하면 선순위 세입자도 볼 수 있습니다": not in the key. It matches my own knowledge of the 전입세대 열람 rules, so I judge it plausible.
“7 个月年限以后随时能缴回来”: loose and misleading. 补缴 for 2026 must be done by 2026-12-31 (B says so itself), and later make-up happens only at retirement through a one-time payment or monthly 延缴.

"At most $660 of your $1,900 survives on its own... The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240" is wrong. Under a grace period the whole balance can pay for March work up to March 15. This also contradicts B's own grace-period bullet.
“법을 착각했을 가능성이 커요”: 회사의 설명이 틀린 이유나 의도는 확인되지 않았다.
“이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)” conflicts with the packet’s October 23 reference date.

"같은 법 제17조에 따라 연 20%의 지연이자" (repeated in the HR text as "근로자퇴직급여 보장법 제17조에 따른 지연이자"): wrong legal basis. The key puts severance delay interest under 근로기준법 제37조 and 시행령 제17조, not 퇴직급여법 제17조. Putting a wrong article in a message to HR weakens it.
Says holiday hours are not counted in the cycle's total hours. This has no source and no article number. It is plausible.
Describes CMS-L564 as completed by the employer without distinguishing the applicant's Section A from the employer's Section B.
The link to a payroll.org blog for the 2026 limits is not checkable against the key. The $680 figure matches the key, so I do not count it as an error.
“대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면”: 조기재취업수당의 신고 후 14일 경과 및 소정급여일수 절반 이상 잔여 요건을 빠뜨려 지급 조건을 잘못 안내합니다.
「医療費通知…これを添付すると明細書の記載を省略できます」は不正確。医療費通知は記載の簡略化にしか使えず、明細書の代わりにはならない。「省略」という語は誤解を招く。

「付与日数は就業規則か給与明細で確認できます」: the legal minimum is fixed by law (5 days under Enforcement Rule Art. 24-3), and many payslips do not show leave balances, so this deferral is unreliable (minor; judged from my own knowledge)
「受けるには確定申告が必要」 overlooks claiming the deduction through a municipal resident-tax return.
渋谷区のリンク（.../zeisei_kaisei09.html）は確認できるURLではあるが、パスが実在するか検証できず、内容が回答の主張を裏付けるかも確認できない
“Not every 529 plan has its rollover process running smoothly yet” and “December is a busy month for processors” are unsupported operational claims.
Reference links to law.go.kr and 1350.moel.go.kr (rtmview ids): not opened, so they are checkable but unverified.
「健康診断は対象外」 is too categorical: examinations leading to treatment of a discovered serious illness can qualify.
“如果9000是到手工资，基数更高”：到手工资不能直接确定加班费基数，也不能保证基数必然更高。
“4주마다 실업인정”: presents a common schedule as universal; recognition intervals can vary.
“Unused carryover still expires later”: there is no universal expiration; qualifying balances can carry over again.

"If you transfer more than the eligible amount, the excess is a nonqualified withdrawal — tax and 10% penalty on the earnings" is loosely framed around the eligible amount rather than the annual cap. It omits the 6% Roth excise tax.
给人事的话写“已按公司要求提交医院病假证明”；请求只说明持有证明，未说明已按要求提交。
"대항력은 신고 다음 날 0시부터": leaves out that 인도 (actually moving in) is also required. The next-day timing itself is right.
"杭州的报销比例只看医院等级和费用段,不看连续缴了几年" is not covered by the key and cannot be checked from the answer.

"the carryover only happens if you're still employed and still enrolled in the FSA in the new plan year" is stated flatly. The key leaves enrollment-conditionality open ("some plans require it, check yours"), so this is overstated and unverified as a general rule.
「課税所得は0…その場合、所得税は1円も戻りません」：課税所得だけでは還付の有無を断定できず、源泉徴収税額の確認が必要。
"$1,220+ evaporates on January 1" incorrectly fixes forfeiture before the run-out deadline; timely claims for eligible prior-year expenses still count.
“연 1.5%” omits the temporary 1.0% rate applicable in October 2026 and does not identify November as its effective period.
The smallest-of formula and instruction to subtract other contributions from $7,500 are wrong when compensation is lower: $4,000 compensation minus $2,000 contributions leaves $2,000, not $4,000.
Does not state the $40,500 minimum excess. Also omits the cure of withdrawing the excess with earnings by the return due date. These are omissions, not errors.
"Completed by December 31, 2026" and "if you miss it, it becomes a 2027 rollover" contradict the key's April 15, 2027 federal deadline, subject to provider processing.
Dates the eight-month SEP from loss of employment or coverage; it begins the following month.
“买房、落户、车牌摇号……那些会受断缴影响”：the packet does not establish these separate eligibility rules.
“北京高院2024年解答（一）第56条”的值班规则：未提供可核验链接或文件文号，答案键也未覆盖该条文。
'HUG·HF' as 반환보증 providers: HF is plausible, not verified
"re-enrolling later can be restricted" after CMS-1763 termination is stated loosely and unverified
Premium given as "roughly $185-$210/month, set annually": vague, and $185 is the 2025 figure. The 2026 standard premium is $202.90.
The link labelled 「国民生活センターの相談事例」 points to a kokusen 'hanrei' (court-case digest) path archived on WARP. I fetched it and got no content, so its label and its support for the claim are unverifiable.
「壁紙の残存価値はゼロ」「仮に借主負担が生じる場合でも…負担額は0円」: the residual value is 1 yen, approximately zero; depreciation does not categorically eliminate labor or construction charges for tenant-caused damage.

The "smallest of" list treats earned income and "$7,500 minus other IRA contributions" as separate caps. With $4,000 earned and $2,000 into his own Roth it gives $4,000. The correct figure is min(7,500, 4,000) - 2,000 = $2,000.
把2192元确定标为“应发”，并称扣款后800元可能“并没有差额”：未说明扣款口径存在争议，遗漏多数口径要求实发不低于2192元。
山东高院〔2018〕鲁民再154号属于“值班”的特殊情形：提供了案号，但该案件事实和裁判解释超出答案键，本次无法核实。
"北京157号文第8条也写明：……法定休假日……按第44条第3款支付" is an article-level citation I could not check against the text. The key gives Art 8 only for the 36-hour cap. Plausible but unverified.
"At most $660 of 2025 funds can move into 2026" puts the carryover in the wrong year. For the user's plan year ending Dec 31, 2026, the cap is $680, carrying into 2027.

Cites 《劳动合同法》第26条 for clauses that break mandatory provisions (item 3). The key's basis is item (2), clauses that exempt the employer from liability or exclude the worker's rights. Not false, but a weaker basis.
Says 沪劳保保发〔2000〕14号 failed on 2026-08-15 as fact. The key treats this as inferred.
“근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%”: 근거 없는 위험 기준이며 본인의 보증금도 빠져 있어 안전 판단에 부적절함.
"Usually ~90 days after Dec 31" for the run-out deadline: hedged with "usually" but unverified, and it varies by plan
“실무에서는 두 방식이 갈리므로” presents the ordinary-wage floor as a negotiable alternative, although it is mandatory when applicable.
Cross-check figures 8,275.86 and 1,241.38 are arithmetically fine (recomputed). 劳动合同法第85条加付赔偿金50%-100% and the 15-day suit period are correct to my knowledge.
「少額でも相談は無料です」: 188の通話料などの条件に触れておらず、断定がやや強め（軽微）。
"If the annual limit rises with inflation, this compresses to four or five years" is unrealistic. Even at $8,000 a year, 4 x 8,000 = 32,000 is less than 35,000, so it takes at least five tax years.
「12万円の全額負担は根拠がなく」：契約書の具体的な特約を未確認のまま断定している。
“近12个月平均应发工资作为基数”：未说明适用条件，题包不支持将其作为北京本案的一般替代计算基数。
"이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)": the key's Friday is 2026-10-23. The date comes from the answer, not the request, and does not match the key. It may only reflect when the answer was written.
Links to a Ulsan Nam-gu dong office page and a scourt.go.kr PDF are given as sources. They are checkable but unverified here, and the first is a different city's page.
'재직기간 3년 2개월 ≈ 1,155일': slightly off; the key has about 1,158 days (small effect on the amount)
“피보험단위기간 6개월”: the requirement is 180 insured qualifying days, not six calendar months.
The smallest-of formula is wrong: with $4,000 compensation and $2,000 other IRA contributions, it permits $4,000 instead of $2,000.
"现在离国庆不到一个月" assumes today's date, which the request does not give; unverifiable.
“$1,220–$1,240 still forfeits” and “spend roughly $1,240+” mix years: the 2026 maximum-cap calculation is $1,900 − $680 = $1,220; a lower plan cap requires a larger spend.
“休息日调休要有书面记录”：留存书面证据是建议，不能直接表述为补休有效的法定条件。
"申请劳动仲裁，免费，时效1年" is oversimplified: the key says wage claims made while still employed are not subject to the one-year limit, and the year runs from the end of employment.
iDeCo・ふるさと納税などの「他の控除もチェック」は、7万円の医療費の相談には関係が薄く、冗長。
Describes CMS-L564 as completed by the employer without distinguishing the applicant's Section A from the employer's Section B.
'워크넷 구직등록 후 관할 고용센터에' is wrong because worknet registration was merged into 고용24, and the key names it as an error.
「e-Taxなら30分ほど」: 所要時間の目安で根拠がなく、検証できない。
'Years before you need it' assumes a retirement timeline and lack of benefit from secondary coverage that the request does not establish.

Does not state the calculation base under the current rule (contract-agreed position wage, excluding bonuses, allowances and overtime, and not below 2740); the only base it gives is the dubious 70% one.
「所得税自体が約1,000円と小さい」: 根拠なし。直前の850円とも食い違い、数字として検証できない
The HR message says flatly '800元低于这个下限', assuming 800 is gross and never asking whether it is 应发 or 实发; it also sets deadlines ('本周内', '下个工资发放日前') that the user did not ask for.

"Grace period ... through March 15, 2026 ... against 2025 funds" and "does it run through March 15, 2026?" use the wrong year. The user's March dental work falls in March 2027, and March 15, 2026 has already passed.

"신청 기한: 이직일 다음날부터 12개월 안에 수급자격 신청" is misleading. The 12 months is the period in which benefits are paid (제48조), not a filing deadline, so applying late cuts the days paid. A never warns about this, and its order "체불임금 회수 → 수급자격 신청" can push the application back.
「給与収入が約214万円を超えると控除はゼロ」: 誤り。214万円は140万円+74万円の単純計算で、190万円超は給与所得控除が増えるため、給与所得140万円になるのは約224万円(0.7x−17万=140万 で x≈224万、自分で再計算)
Says the rumored 清零 refers to a 连续缴费年限 that '会重新计算' and governs 当前待遇/等待期; this is speculative, since the key ties 重新计算 only to the continuous-enrollment rewards in resident 大病保险
사직서 사유를 임금체불로 남기세요: 이미 사표를 낸 사람에게는 실효가 약하다. 이직사유는 고용센터가 증거로 판단한다. 내용증명이나 문자로 증빙을 남기라는 보완 조언은 합리적이다.
「少額調停・少額訴訟という手段もあります」: 「少額調停」は制度名として一般的でなく曖昧。少額訴訟は60万円以下で妥当。
"目前仅支持线下办理，带身份证或市民卡去区医保经办机构" is a procedural claim the key does not cover; unverifiable.
“纯粹为了退休，不用补”“3,300元花得不太值”：缺少年龄、退休时间及未来缴费安排，无法作此确定判断。
"roughly $185–$210/month, set annually": vague. The 2026 standard premium is $202.90; $185 was the 2025 figure.
“하루 약 6,600원씩 늘어요”: arithmetic is reasonable, but the statement omits statutory interest exclusions.
称503号和北京157号“都要求向区人社局申报、批准”：把北京具体申报机关要求扩大归于全国性文件。
「これで金額が動く可能性が十分あります」: 根拠のない見込みの断定。
'The 529 plan probably will not verify his income or other contributions' is an unsupported prediction about the unidentified plan.

"Opened in 2004, so this is satisfied — unless the account was rolled over to a different 529 plan or the beneficiary was changed": presents a reset of the 15-year clock after a rollover or beneficiary change as the rule. The key says this is unresolved. It is softened by "Ask the plan to confirm".
“北京各区……要求提交……公示情况、民主程序材料”仅举西城区指南，不能证明所有区都要求这些材料。

Attributes the quoted wording '另外支付'不低于300%……一般不安排补休 to 劳部发〔1997〕271号第4条; from my own knowledge that wording is in item 3 of the 复函 (item 4 covers comprehensive hours and holiday pay under 劳动法44(3)). Small misattribution. I tried the cited link but could not open it (certificate error on the IP-address host).
「差額ベッド代…は対象外」と一律に断定: 医師の指示や病院都合などで対象になる場合があり、単純化しすぎ(自己判断)

Gives a specific scenario-B figure: if all 32 hours are cycle overtime, about 2482.76, total about 6206.90. The arithmetic checks (413.7931 x 1.5 x 32 = 2482.76), but the key says the 150% amount cannot be computed from the facts given. The figure is hedged as a maximum, so this is a minor deduction.
The HUG/HF note on 위반건축물 and "임대인 협조 필요 여부" is unsourced. It is plausible but unverified.
“实际净支出会略低于3,370元”：沿用错误现金总额，并将个人账户划入等同现金支出减少，口径容易误导。
“法定节假日部分不能‘包干’”过于绝对；是否足额、明确支付法定加班报酬才是关键，不能仅凭支付形式判断。
「クリーニング」 is listed as not deductible without qualification. 歯石除去 done as insured gum treatment is deductible, so this is misleading.
「今回は通常の医療費控除が有利です」は判断材料不足。対象市販薬の購入額や適用条件が示されていない。
"The 10%-per-year lifetime penalty" is imprecise: the penalty is 10% per full 12 months without Part B.
“건강보험료가 지역가입자로 바뀌니”: overstates an automatic outcome; dependent coverage or continued employee coverage may apply.
"법제처 해석(2026. 5. 26.)과 고용노동부 실무는 통상임금을 적용하는 쪽": the Legislation Ministry interpretation matches the key (26-0209), but the claim about Ministry of Labor practice is unverifiable.
'If you change jobs, the whole balance ... is gone' omits the key's FSA COBRA exception.
有外地年限就“在杭州还要再缴满10年”：应扣除已经取得的杭州实际缴费年限，不能一概再缴10年。
“如果有外地年限……在杭州还要再缴满10年”：忽略已经缴纳的杭州实际年限，应补足杭州实际10年，而非一律再缴10年。
Says Part B would cover "little your plan doesn't already cover". This is a broad generalization about an unknown plan.
"짐을 다 들이지 않아도, 열쇠를 받아 쓸 수 있으면 '인도'는 됩니다" is a legal assertion with no case cited. Plausible but unverified.
「社会保険料控除もあります」：本人が控除できる保険料を支払ったかは不明。
조기재취업수당 is given as '남은 급여의 절반, 12개월 이상 근무 시' without the condition of at least half the 소정급여일수 remaining.
“7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다”: 지연된 달 수만으로 인정되지 않는다. 지연일수와 미지급 규모를 확인해야 한다.
"연 20%의 지연이자(같은 법 제17조 제3항, 근로기준법 제37조)": 근거는 근로기준법 제37조와 시행령 제17조다. 퇴직급여법 제17조 제3항은 근거로 확인되지 않았고 부정확해 보인다.
“못 쓴 연차수당도 같이 청구” assumes an accrued, unpaid leave entitlement that the request does not establish.
「差額ベッド代、健康診断など」を一律対象外としている。医学的必要性のある差額ベッド代や、重大な疾病の発見後に治療へ移った健康診断などには例外がある。

Labels the 2192 yuan floor as '(应发)' and states it flatly; the key says there is no official line and the majority view is that the minimum excludes personal contributions (take-home should not be below 2192), so this takes the minority view without flagging the dispute.
"Part D is 63 days" confuses the penalty threshold with the enrollment deadline: the key specifies 2 full months after coverage ends.
「口頭でも…一言添えると通りやすい」：この職場で承認されやすくなるという効果は確認できない。

Cites a Ulsan Nam-gu dong page and a scourt.go.kr PDF as sources for the fee and the next-day 0:00 rule. I did not open either link, so the support is unverified, and the Ulsan page is a local office for a Seoul home.
“加班费或补贴……扣掉已付部分”：过宽；普通补贴不能未经确认性质就抵扣法定加班费。
「健康診断は対象外」：例外を欠く断定。既有知識による判断では、重大な疾病が見つかり引き続き治療した場合などは対象になり得る。
"미지급 시 3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금": outdated. From 2026.9.18 it is 5년/5천만 원 under 제43조 (minor, per the key)
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」: unverifiable generalization
"Some plans take two to four weeks" supplies an unverified processing range without identifying a plan.
中介“声称能办的多半是骗钱或伪造材料”：关于发生比例的判断未经包内材料证实。
“7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘습니다”: 늦은 달 수만으로 인정되지 않습니다. 지연일수와 미지급액 확인이 필요합니다.
将14号文到期与强制效力终止作确定表述；答案键仅推定其失效，未见官方明确表态。
Says form CMS-L564 is one the 'employer signs'; the asker completes Section A and the employer Section B. Minor.
「給与が1か所で年末調整が済んでいるなら…申告の義務はありません」 omits the necessary qualification concerning other income.
"조기재취업수당(남은 급여의 절반, 12개월 이상 근무 시)" leaves out the requirement that at least half of the benefit days remain. This is a simplification.
Cites a 1350 case link (1350.moel.go.kr/rtmview.do?id=1000294810) as the basis for the conclusion. Not checked, so unverifiable.
Cites 「No.1119 医療費控除の手続」 as a source. I could not confirm from my own knowledge that this page number matches that title, so it is unverifiable.

Table row '制度照搬旧上海算法（先按实得工资70%，再按4—6年80%）8000×70%×80% = 4480元': under the old Shanghai rule the 70% base applied only when no wage was agreed at all (70% of 正常出勤月工资, not 实得工资), and the key gives the agreed post wage as the base under 10号第九条. So for an agreed 8000 salary this scenario is unsupported and could mislead.
“北京法院在类似案件中的口径是未履行行政审批的按标准工时制认定”（丰台法院报道链接）：无法核实。结论与答案键“北京仲裁实践”一致。
“소액체당금” uses the outdated name for 간이대지급금; linking the advice to insolvency misleadingly narrows when the user should investigate it.
留保の一文で「後から『納得して払った』と認定されるのを防げます」：その文言だけで認定を防げるという保証には根拠がない。

"you might need a Part D plan, and possibly Part B to get it": misleading. Part D needs Part A or Part B, and premium-free Part A is enough, so non-creditable drug coverage gives no reason to take Part B.
Says 「判例・通説」 for the rule that wear is excluded, but cites no case or article (no 民法621条 and no 最判平成17年).

「子どもの学校行事そのものを保障する法律はありません（子の看護休暇は病気・けがの看護…）」: outdated, from my own knowledge. Since the April 2025 amendment, 子の看護等休暇 also covers 入園・入学式 and 卒園式 for children up to the end of 3rd grade, so some school events are protected.

States as fact that under the old rule "基数要先按正常工资的70%计算...8000×70%×80%=4480元，并非6400元". This contradicts the key (83号 tier at 4 years = 80% of 8000 = 6400). Per Zhonglun the 70% base applies only when the contract or collective contract specifies no wage, so it is wrong for an 8000 contract wage. The 3680 shortfall derived from it is also unsupported.
조기재취업수당 "대기기간 후 12개월 이상 계속 고용되면 남은 수급일수의 절반": incomplete. It leaves out the condition that at least half of the 소정급여일수 must remain at re-employment (and that the claim comes 14 days after filing).

'7 个月年限以后随时能缴回来' is loose wording that can read as if the arrears can be paid at any time, which conflicts with the 2026-12-31 deadline B states elsewhere; the key only allows making up any shortfall at retirement by a one-time or monthly payment
"北京的规定写得很清楚……'安排劳动者在法定休假日工作的，按300%'" is quoted wording from an unnamed Beijing rule, given only as a link; I could not check the quotation.
"현행법상 퇴직금은 IRP 계정으로 이전하는 방식": leaves out the under-55 condition (minor).
人社厅函〔2025〕1号进一步明确 300%是'另外支付': the specific wording is attributed to the document but not quoted. A link is given, so this is checkable, but I could not confirm it from my own knowledge.
将83号、14号文一起称为工龄分档规则并断言失效：14号文涉及最低标准，其失效在答案键中仅属推定。
'Scholarships ... don't count' is too categorical: certain taxable graduate or postdoctoral fellowship and stipend payments qualify as IRA compensation, based on my own knowledge.
“法定节假日的工时不计入……总工时”：表述过宽；避免与150%重复计算，不等于这些实际工作小时不存在于实际总工时中。
“实际净支出会略低于3,370元”: muddled. Money credited to the personal account does not lower what she pays at the counter.
대항력을 '집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리'로 정의: 너무 넓음. 경매에서 대항력이 살아남는 것은 말소기준권리(선순위 근저당 등)보다 앞설 때뿐임

'Most do by 2026, but not all' (plans supporting 529-to-Roth) and 'distribution code 1 in Box 7' on Form 1099-Q. Plan support is unverifiable. The IRS instructions say the Box 7 code is optional ('may, but are not required'), so 'should be' is overstated.
“퇴직소득세가 원천징수되어” incorrectly implies withholding at payment without distinguishing IRP transfers, for which withholding is deferred.

Asserts that under the old rule '基数要先按正常工资的70%计算', so the old-rule figure is 8000×70%×80%=4480, '并非6400元'. The key gives 8000×80%=6400 for the 83号 tiers on the contract-agreed wage. A web search suggests the 70% base applies only where no wage is agreed (and its survival under the new rules is disputed), so applying it to someone with an agreed 8000 salary is misleading and contradicts the key.

Describes a 北京丰台法院 case (unapproved comprehensive-hours clause void, expired approval reverts to standard hours) and a Beijing HR bureau page. A link is given but the details are unverified. The HR bureau page matches the key's 2019 case.

"퇴직소득세·지방소득세 약 20만~25만 원": wrong. For about 1,024만~1,202만 with 4 service years, the tax including local tax is about 9.4만~14.1만 (I recomputed this). Also, with an IRP transfer nothing is withheld when the money is paid.
Step 3's maximum omits existing IRA contributions; the later combined Roth-cap warning does not fix the compensation-limited calculation.
"이번 주 금요일(10월 30일)": the key fixes this Friday as 2026-10-23, so the 10-30 date is an invented or conflicting specific.
「敷金から引くには修繕内容と費用の内訳を示す必要があります（民法622条の2）」: 622条の2は敷金の定義と返還、控除できる債務の範囲を定める条文で、内訳提示義務を定めたものではない。条文の誤用。
Checked against the IRS 1099-Q instructions page: the Box 4b, code 1 in Box 7 and son-as-recipient details are correct. The answer omits the 6% excess-contribution excise tax on over-transfers.

Telling the user to fall back to 정부24 전입신고 and 인터넷등기소 확정일자 after hours skips the risk that an online 확정일자 filed after 18:00 is dated the next business day. The key flags this, and the answer does not.
“把某一天的300%和200%对调”：缺乏依据；10月3日本身是法定节假日，不能任意与补假日交换计薪性质。
“3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”, “제44조 제1호”: 구 규정이다. 키에 따르면 현행은 제43조의 5년 이하 징역 또는 5천만 원 이하 벌금이다.
「e-Taxなら30分ほど」は利用者の準備状況によるため、この所要時間を裏付ける根拠がない。
"The money needs to land ... by December 31, 2026" contradicts the April 15, 2027 federal deadline for a designated 2026 rollover, subject to provider processing.
Says the supplement is "另加大病、长护险几十元" on top of 473.67元/月. The key says these personal premiums are deducted from the supplemented personal-account funds, with no extra cash. Wrong or unverifiable.
将在职追索劳动报酬的时效例外直接用于本案加班费：未说明答案键提示的适用口径差异。
Ties penalty-free delay to the 400 employees being above the 20-employee threshold: imprecise. Employer size decides which plan pays first, not whether the SEP applies (minor).
「給与が1か所で年末調整が済んでいるなら、申告の義務はありません」：他の所得がないという条件を欠く。
The Box 4b claim on Form 1099-Q matches the IRS 1099-Q instructions I opened (box 4b = QTP-to-Roth transfer). No error.
给人事的话写“病假证明已按时提交”；请求只说明持有证明，未说明已经按时提交。
"This compresses to four or five years" is unsupported: the key requires at least five; even $8,000 × 4 is only $32,000.
"大病保险等可能另计几十元": the key says the 大病保险 and 长护险 premiums are deducted from the back-credited personal account funds, not paid as extra cash
民法90条で争える: キーにない追加の法的根拠。軽微。
문자 1안의 '지연이자(연 20%)와 고용노동부 진정 절차를 검토할 수밖에 없어... 협의하고자 합니다': 키가 금지한 위협성 문구에 가깝고, '협의' 표현이 연장 동의로 읽힐 여지가 있음
"7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 충족할 가능성이 높으니" has no day-count test (60일 합계), so it is somewhat overconfident, though hedged with "가능성".
“2026年9月全国总工会的解读”及两段引文：有转载链接，但包内无法核实归属和逐字引文；未外查，不判定为已证实。

'应发是2192元左右、扣掉个人社保和公积金后实发800元：公司是按最低线在发': implies the company is compliant. The majority view in the key is that the minimum excludes personal contributions, so take-home pay should not fall below 2192. B adds only a light hedge.
「2027年2月16日〜3月15日に確定申告」を申告手順として示している。還付申告は2027年1月1日から5年間（2031年12月31日まで）提出でき、この期間に限られない（キー）
Cites Savingforcollege "(updated Aug. 2026)" and iraresources.com as sources: the update date and content cannot be verified from the packet.
"The drug coverage isn't creditable. Then you might need a Part D plan, and possibly Part B to get it." Misleading: Part D needs Part A or B enrollment, but the answer implies Part B specifically.
"3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금(같은 법 제44조 제1호)": 옛 규정이다. 키에 따르면 2026.9.18.부터 제43조의 5년 이하 징역 또는 5천만 원 이하 벌금이다. 경미 감점.
「戻る税金は所得税が約850円、住民税が約1,700円で、合わせて2,500円ほど」と所得税の還付を断定: 基礎控除104万円と社会保険料控除で課税所得が0になる見込みで、還付はおそらく0円。源泉徴収票の「源泉徴収税額」欄の確認にも触れていない
「合わせて2,500円ほど」：所得税の還付を断定。社会保険料控除や源泉徴収税額によって還付は0円になる。
The 1350 links (id=1000319196, id=1000261514) opened and match their topics, and the 1,000만원 간이대지급금 cap is correct, so these are not errors.
Never says the new employer cannot 补缴 2026-04 to 10 for her, which the key requires. It only warns about third-party 挂靠 and about 衔接 between 灵活就业 and 单位参保.
「残存価値はゼロです」：基準は残存価値1円であり、厳密なゼロではない。

Scenario B figure "如果这32小时全部构成周期超时，约2482.76元，合计约6206.90元": the key deducts for putting a number on the 150% part, which the facts given cannot support. The arithmetic itself is right (51.72×1.5×32), and A does frame it as conditional.
新增“旧‘本人工资=实得工资70%’口径”及4480元方案：算术正确，但该历史规则及其当前适用依据无法从所给材料核实。
'근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호': an unsourced rule-of-thumb threshold, not in the key and not tied to any official figure.
“一般也不能免除……等待期”：标准只确认补缴能否免等待期尚未核实，不能据此确定通常不能。
“两种计算方式相差约827.59元”：仅在特定工时和补休条件下成立，不能作为固定差额。
“这是唯一有时限的事”：与其自己列出的2026年12月31日补缴截止期限矛盾。
'7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 넘게 충족': treats the count of late months as the test. The real test is a 60-day total of delayed or unpaid days, so this overstates eligibility (softened by '가능성이 꽤 높습니다' and '심사예요').
"Save the CMS-L564 form (your employer fills it out)": imprecise. The enrollee completes Section A and the employer completes Section B.
“每天超过8小时，超过部分另按150%主张”：标准工时下休息日、法定节假日超过8小时的部分仍按200%、300%折算，不是150%。这一说法有疑问，且属于答案键之外。
"평일 18시까지" cites a Gangdong-gu page, but the user's 동 is unknown and 주민센터 hours differ by 동. Minor, since the link is checkable.
「更新の必要があっても借主負担分は生じません」 incorrectly makes age alone eliminate liability; labor or construction costs can remain for tenant-caused damage.

HUG return-guarantee conditions (90% limit, later of balance date or move-in date, half the contract term) are cited to property.ambitstock.com, a non-official third-party page. The figures match the key, but the source is not official and I did not open it.
退休差额公式只计算累计240个月：未纳入视同缴费抵扣，也未检验杭州实际120个月条件，不能作为通用差额公式。
Lists orthodontia among expenses to incur by Dec 31 without saying that advance-paid orthodontia treatment is plan-dependent; minor, and the answer does ask whether the plan reimburses orthodontia.

Living-cost loan quoted at 연 1.5% with no date. Per the key, 2026-09-01 to 10-31 is a temporary 1.0% and 1.5% applies from November, so 1.5% is wrong for today (2026-10-25) unless dated. The 1% guarantee fee is not mentioned.
“석 달이면 요건을 충족할 가능성이 높으니” gives an unsupported likelihood without knowing payment-delay days or outstanding amounts.
"7个月年限以后随时能缴回来" is loose. The retirement-time top-up has a specific payment (743.60元/月, 5,205.20元 for 7 months) that is not given.
「残存価値はゼロ」: ガイドラインの残存価値は1円（下限）であり、ゼロと書くのは不正確（結論の0円は同じ）
Table says 连续缴费年限 "会重新计算" and that the user's rumor refers to it: this edges toward the "连续年限重新计算" trap, which the key ties to the resident scheme, not the employee scheme.

Headline "如果劳动合同或公司制度沿用旧上海口径，可能是4480元" (8000×70%×80%) is misleading: the 70% base applied only when no wage was agreed at all. With an agreed 8000 wage, the old 83号 4–6-year tier gives 6400, which the key treats as the old-tier figure
'자발적 퇴사로 보지 않고': mislabels the legal position. It is still a quit for one's own reasons that is excused by a just cause, not a non-voluntary separation.
称新办法第九条“只规定了……计算基数”：该条也明确要求企业按规定支付假期工资。
"先问……我能不能以灵活就业身份补3–9月": the gap is April–October (March was paid), so the month range is inconsistent with the 7 months used elsewhere.
The answer never says what happens if more than the cap is moved (6% excise on the Roth side, taxable earnings plus 10% on the 529 side). Its only withdrawal warning is about the $13,000 leftover.
Cites an MLIT PDF (001238428.pdf), a 全宅連 PDF, a CAA page and a courts.go.jp page as sources. These are checkable links, but I did not open them, so what they say is unverified.
“人社部办公厅的相关通知”后的直接引语未给出可核对的通知编号或对应链接；常州答复不能核实该引语的归属和原文。
“계약서 명의자 본인이” 전입신고해야 한다는 제한은 부정확합니다. 제 지식에 따르면 방문 신고에는 세대주·세대원이나 적법한 위임을 통한 신고 등도 가능합니다.

The state survey claims (30 states follow federal; Indiana, Louisiana, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Utah and Vermont recapture; California taxes the rollover plus 2.5%; Colorado, Missouri and New Jersey undecided) match the cited secondary page. That page is dated September 2025 and the positions may be stale, and the key did not check other states.
'계약 후 잔금 사이에 근저당을 추가하는 경우가 흔합니다': a frequency claim with no source.
"문자를 보내두는 것 자체가 합의해서 기다려준 것이 아니라는 증거": 법적 효과를 단정한 과장이며 근거가 없다.
“Balance is forfeited at plan year end” and “$1,900 becomes $0 on January 1”: omit timely run-out claims for eligible expenses already incurred; forfeiture is determined after the filing deadline.
“目前仅支持线下办理”：this procedural restriction is not established by the packet.
"at most $660 of 2025 funds can move into 2026" uses the wrong plan year. The person's plan year ends Dec 31, 2026, and the 2026 cap is $680. B's own Proskauer link gives the 2026 limits.
3개월 총일수 약 89~92일: 지난달 20일 퇴사면 사실상 92일로 정해지는데 불필요하게 넓게 잡음(범위 1,020만~1,060만 원 자체는 키와 충돌하지 않음)

Day count of 1,156 used without explanation (the key has 1,158). The stated range "1,020만~1,030만 원" leaves out the ordinary-wage floor (about 1,202만), so 약 1,022만 is presented as nearly fixed (minor).
“现在补大约能省1,800—1,900元”：按2026年标准比较差额成立，但未说明退休补缴标准每年调整，不能当作未来实际节省额。
Counts the 3 months as 6/20~9/19 (퇴직일 taken as 9/20), where the key's labour-portal basis is 6/21~9/20. Both are 92 days and the result is the same, so the effect is negligible.

"실업급여가 끝난 뒤 잔여분을 받을 수 있으니 지금 미리 신청해 두세요" (국민취업지원제도) is wrong or unverifiable. There is no 'remaining portion' of 구직촉진수당, and people receiving 구직급여, or within 6 months of it ending, can be excluded (per the key).
Says back payment 一般不算连续 for home-purchase or hukou 连续社保 rules: unverifiable and outside the question.
“不能只按基本工资；实际发放高于合同约定的，按实际发放”过度概括，忽略北京以合同约定工资为基础的规则。
'Carried into next year (best case) ~$680' misleadingly excludes the grace-period possibility of using all $1,900.
Citations to a Pingluo court case (2025), a Fengtai court press conference (2026), a national trade union reading (2026-09) and a Beijing HR Q&A: links given but not opened, so unverifiable.
“집이 경매로 넘어가도 계속 살 수 있는 권리”: 선순위 담보권 등과의 관계에 따른 제한을 무시한 설명.

Tells the asker to apply for Part B at retirement with CMS-40B plus CMS-L564 without checking Part A status. CMS-40B is wrong if Part A was also deferred, and the asker may have deferred it under item 3.
'회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우에는 지급 방식이 조금 다르지만' mixes up IRP with a company pension plan; the key says IRP transfer also applies under the 퇴직금 system (over 3 million won, under age 55).
'근저당과 선순위 임차인 보증금 합계가 집값의 70~80%를 넘으면 위험 신호': unsourced rule-of-thumb threshold, unverifiable
Gives ft22.com as the 全文 link for 沪人社规〔2026〕10号. That is a non-official third-party site, and I could not check that it hosts the document.

Offers 정부24 for 전입신고 and 인터넷등기소 for 확정일자 with no warning that an after-hours filing may take effect on the next working day (Monday). That undercuts its own advice to go to the 주민센터 on Friday during the day.
「タクシーは緊急時のみ」：公共交通機関が使えない場合が基準で、緊急時に限定されない。
"식대·차량보조 등 통상임금이 아닌 항목": questionable. Fixed meal or car allowances paid to everyone are generally 통상임금 (my own knowledge, not checked online)

Cites 京劳社资发〔2003〕157号 and 〔2005〕94号 with no article numbers. It never gives art. 4, 15 or 16, and never gives the Beijing HRSS 2019 case. A reader cannot check the 'no approval means standard hours' claim.
「多くの場合、内訳を求められた時点で請求額は下がります」 is an unsupported prediction.
《劳动合同法》第26条未写项号，转述的是第（三）项“违反强制性规定”，不是键里的第（二）项“免除法定责任、排除权利”。结论仍对，属轻微不精确。
Mentions 소액체당금 only for a de facto bankrupt company, and not 간이대지급금 or 생계비 융자 (an omission, not a false claim)
Cites a payroll.org blog for the 2026 limits: a checkable link, but not the primary IRS source and not opened by me
“12개월 안에 신청해야”: does not distinguish the benefit-payment window from an application deadline, although it correctly urges prompt application.

"회사가 퇴직연금(IRP)에 가입한 경우에는 지급 방식이 조금 다르지만": wrong framing. A company does not join an IRP, and the key says mandatory IRP transfer (over 300만 원, under 55) applies to plain 퇴직금 too, not only to pension-plan members
"800元肯定不合法" is slightly overstated: if 800 is net pay, the minority reading leaves it uncertain (though the majority view supports it)
「7年住んでいる時点で、壁紙の残存価値はゼロです」: the guideline sets the residual value at 1円 (≒0), not exactly zero. Minor imprecision.
Padded and repetitive: a long multi-section answer with a closing one-sentence summary that repeats the body, and extra scenarios such as 补3–10月 for 8个月 (3,789.36, arithmetic correct).
“个别法院会结合岗位特点、劳动强度酌定……主流口径”：未给出支持这些裁判概括的具体案例，无法核实。
"Roll over the smallest of these three numbers" omits subtracting other IRA contributions. Step 8 partially repairs this for Roth contributions, but never addresses traditional IRA contributions.
7~9월 석 달이면 요건을 충족할 가능성이 높다: 날수 합계 60일 기준을 말하지 않고 석 달이라는 기간만 근거로 삼았다. 매달 며칠 늦었는지에 따라 부족할 수 있어 약간 과장이다. 가능성이 높다는 단서는 붙였다.
“All $1,900 is gone December 31” overlooks reimbursement of eligible expenses through the claims run-out period.
“14일을 넘기면 … 연 20%의 지연이자 … 붙습니다”: 합의나 법정 적용 제외 사유를 구분하지 않은 단정이다.

'to count for 2026 the money needs to land in the Roth by December 31, 2026' and 'a January arrival may count against 2027' treat December as the deadline. A rollover designated for 2026 can be made through April 15, 2027, though plans vary. Minor error.
"杭州的报销比例只看医院等级和费用段，不看连续缴了几年": not covered by the key and no specific source given; plausible but unverified.
「欠勤にすると、その日は丸ごと無給になります」: Unqualified; the packet does not establish the employer’s pay rules.
"All $1,900 is gone December 31" ignores the run-out period for submitting claims for eligible expenses already incurred.
“如果这7天每天超过8小时，超过部分另按150%主张”：错误统一使用150%；法定节假日延长工时仍按300%，休息日相应按200%。
“330만 ÷ 209 × 8”: assumes a 209-hour monthly schedule without establishing or explicitly stating that condition.
Says the Part B penalty 'applies to people who go without creditable coverage': imprecise. 'Creditable coverage' is a Part D term; the Part B penalty applies when there is no Part B and no SEP.
"열쇠를 받아 쓸 수 있으면 인도는 됩니다": not in the key. It is consistent with the usual reading of 인도, so I judge it plausible.
The claim that 差額ベッド代 and 健康診断 are excluded is generally right but stated flatly, with no key basis, and it depends on the individual case.
Does not state the basis for 21.75 (人社部发〔2025〕2号), though the 413.79 figure is right.
"连续缴费年限……它不影响退休": a mild overstatement, since 办法第八条 also requires paying in Hangzhou up to retirement (key: light deduction)
Moving dental work into December "uses 100% of the money" assumes an unspecified dental cost.
“通过‘浙里办’搜‘医保补缴’或‘灵活就业参保’”：the packet does not verify this application route for the requested retroactive payment.
「所得税5%で約850円」: states the refund as a fact without looking at the 2026 基礎控除 of 104万, the social insurance deduction or the 源泉徴収税額. The real refund is likely 0 (key: No.2030).
"운영시간을 놓치면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 확정일자로 대체하세요": the fallback has no caveat. An 인터넷등기소 확정일자 filed after 18시 is granted on the next working day, and the date of an after-hours 정부24 전입신고 is unconfirmed.

"운영시간을 놓치면 정부24 전입신고와 인터넷등기소 확정일자로 대체하세요" — offered as an equal substitute, but an internet-registry confirmed date requested after 18:00 Friday is granted on the next working day, 10-26 (Mon). The filing date for an out-of-hours 정부24 전입신고 is unverified, so this fallback can cost the same-day priority.
"补3–9月": wrong months. The key's gap is April to October 2026, since March was paid.
「7年住んでいるなら残存価値はゼロ、つまり…借主負担分は生じません」と日焼けの話に経過年数の計算を結び付けている: 日焼けは経過年数の計算以前に負担義務がない（ただし本文はまず日焼け=貸主負担と述べており軽微）
"회사가 사실상 도산했다면 근로복지공단 소액체당금": uses the old name (renamed 간이대지급금 in 2021), and the 도산 condition is wrong. 간이대지급금 does not require insolvency.
Suggests 近12个月平均应发工资 as the overtime base. This is an unsourced argument and may not match Beijing's rule of using the contract-agreed wage.
Car-plate lottery or house purchase “补缴一般不算连续”: outside the question and unverifiable
“0571-89583017”：给定材料无法核实该号码及其用途。

“公司是按最低线在发，能主张的差额会少很多” treats gross pay of about 2192元 as establishing compliance despite the unresolved deduction issue and the majority interpretation requiring the minimum after personal contributions.
"Some plans take two to four weeks" is unverifiable. Processing times vary by plan.

Refers the user to 住まいるダイヤル (0570-016-100). The number matches my own knowledge, but that service mainly handles disputes over buying and renovating homes, so it is a doubtful fit for a rental deposit dispute (my own knowledge, not checked on the web).
"이 기간은 회사 사정으로 늘어나지 않아요" is plausible but unverified. The 12-month period can be extended in some cases, such as illness.
The proskauer.com link is cited for "2025/2026 FSA limits". It cannot be checked against the key. B uses the 2025 figure for a 2026 plan year.

"the carryover only happens if you're still employed and still enrolled in the FSA in the new plan year": stated as a universal rule. The sources leave enrollment as a condition some plans set, so it should be framed as "some plans require it, check yours".
"法定节假日的工时不计入综合计算周期的总工时": not in the key and given no source. Plausible but unverified.
“休息日调休要有书面记录”把证据建议写成必备程序，答案键未提供该强制要求的依据。
「源泉徴収票で…基礎控除104万円が反映されているか確認」: 源泉徴収票には基礎控除額が単独では表示されず、確認すべき欄は「源泉徴収税額」。不正確

Adds about 54 yuan for 大病保险 and 长护险 on top of 3,315.69 and gives a total of about 3,370 yuan. The key says these are deducted from the personal account credited back, with no extra cash. The answer then says the net outlay is lower, which muddles it.
'第九条，只规定了病假工资的计算基数': incomplete. Per the key, article 9 also obliges the employer to pay sick-leave wages, which A itself cites in the HR message.

"at most $660 of your $1,900 survives... The March dental work does not get to spend the other $1,240": wrong under the grace-period branch, where the whole balance can pay for work done by the grace end. It also contradicts B's own later sentence, and the $1,240 comes from the wrong cap (it should be $1,220)
NTA keisan link is a 令和7年分 (2025) page, not 2026; it does support the 5% rule
“连续缴费年限……断缴3个月以上会重新计算”：把待遇中断概括为职工医保连续年限重算，标准答案不支持这一规则；杭州中断参保分界是超过3个月。
「民法621条ただし書きにより」: the ordinary-wear exclusion is in the main provision's parenthetical text, not its proviso.

"Enroll in Part D or a Medicare Advantage plan within 63 days if your drug coverage isn't creditable": the condition is inverted. The window after coverage ends applies when creditable coverage is lost; non-creditable drug coverage means Part D should have been taken earlier. The key says 2 full months.
'the 15-year clock restarts for the new beneficiary' (beneficiary change). Stated as settled, but the key says this is unresolved with no IRS guidance. Elsewhere it hedges with 'can restart'.
メール文で敷金10万円を「合意ができた後に精算」としており、全額返還を求めていない。減額交渉して合意額を払う案も示しており、日焼け分に借主負担を認める余地を残す。
メール案の「室内の写真は当方でも保管しております」: 利用者が写真を持っているとは限らない前提の挿入。
"10%-per-year lifetime penalty" is imprecise: the penalty is 10% per full 12 months without Part B.
目前仅支持线下办理，带身份证或市民卡去区医保经办机构 - unverifiable procedural claim.
"K-12 tuition (up to $10,000 a year)": out of date for 2026. OBBBA raised the K-12 limit to $20,000 a year from 2026 (checked by web search: JPMorgan, Chase and the SC Treasurer).
摇车牌、买房“补缴一般不算连续”：材料未核实这些不同事项的现行规则，且与本题补缴计算无关。
"The Summary Plan Description states all three" guarantees document contents without checking this plan's documents.
“基数要先按正常工资的70%计算”错误地增加统一折扣；因此4480元及补3680元虽算术正确，适用依据错误。
「具体的に説明し、借主が認識して合意したこと…が必要」 omits sufficiently specific written terms as an alternative recognized by the key.
“Check both forms in early 2027” assumes reporting availability that the packet does not establish.
"취업규칙이나 근로계약서에 한 달이라고 적혀 있어도 ... 인정되기 어렵습니다": plausible but unsourced.
Scenario B 「按这4天32小时全超时粗算约2,482.76元…有审批时这7天大约在3,724～6,207元之间」: gives a concrete 150% range, but the key says it cannot be computed; it is softened as a rough estimate

The HR message never asks whether 800 is the gross (应发) or net (实发) figure. It does not cite 309号第59条 or 沪人社规〔2026〕10号第九条 in the text itself, only in the source list at the end. It does not ask for a pay breakdown (工资清单).
Table says employee 连续缴费年限会重新计算 and that it 决定当前待遇. The key says Hangzhou's employee-insurance rules have no such reset; 重新计算 appears only in the resident-insurance rules.
Premium given as "roughly $185–$210/month" instead of the 2026 standard $202.90. Not wrong, but it skips the exact figure the key gives.
"Your 2004 account passes the 15-year test" assumes uninterrupted beneficiary history without establishing it.
"Most do by 2026, but not all" (plans supporting 529-to-Roth) is unverifiable.

'Apply for Part B during the 8-month SEP using CMS-40B' is given without conditioning on already having Part A, although the answer calls free Part A optional. CMS-40B is not the route for someone with no Part A.
"Sign up for Part D within 63 days": imprecise. The Part D SEP runs 2 full months after coverage ends; 63 days is the gap that triggers the penalty (minor).
“같은 법 제17조” incorrectly attributes the severance-payment delay interest rule; the key identifies Labor Standards Act Article 37 and Enforcement Decree Article 17.
'이미 늦게라도 받았다면 그 지연 사실 자체가 사유가 되고': overstated. Delays must add up to 60 days or more, so any delay at all does not qualify.
Says 连续缴费年限 "断缴3个月以上会重新计算" as a rule that affects the waiting period. The key ties "连续参保年数重新计算" to 居民医保, and Hangzhou's waiting period comes from 中断参保. The framing is loose and unverified for 职工医保.
'이 기간은 회사 사정으로 늘어나지 않아요' is an odd, unsupported phrasing; the claim is unverifiable as written.
A check paid to the son does not itself create an excess Roth contribution; that requires an IRA deposit exceeding his permitted contributions.
「2万円の追加請求になっている点も不自然」 is unsupported; a deposit is not a ceiling on legitimate tenant liabilities.
LINE text says 「来月11月」: this assumes today's month, which the request never states (minor, though it matches the run date).
大病保险等可能另计几十元 - contradicts the key. These premiums come out of the back-credited personal-account funds, and no extra cash is paid.
“퇴직금(2년 근무면 발생)”: omits the weekly working-hours qualification.
“제44조”, “3년 이하 징역 또는 3천만 원 이하 벌금”: 키에 따르면 현행 규정은 제43조의 5년 이하 징역 또는 5천만 원 이하 벌금이다.

"the carryover only happens if you're still employed and still enrolled in the FSA in the new plan year": whether you must enroll again depends on the plan (key: unverified, varies by plan), yet B states it as a universal rule.
Says SHIP counselors "deal with exactly this scenario constantly": unverifiable filler.
"confirm the office will charge before the 15th": the test is the date the service is provided, not the date it is charged, so this points to the wrong criterion.
